title: PUT /api/order-management/[businessId] crashes on every authenticated save (block-scoped `params` shadows the destructured route param, TDZ ReferenceError caught as 500)
description: The original claim's mechanism (module-level SyntaxError making the file unparseable) is FALSE and is refuted: I hit the live dev server's GET and PUT endpoints and both compiled fine ('✓ Compiled /api/order-management/[businessId] in 249ms (211 modules)') and returned normal 401 responses, and I inspected the actual .next SWC/webpack output which preserves the source verbatim with no error. The reason it compiles is that `const params: any[] = []` at line 250 sits inside the same `try { ... }` block as `const { businessId } = params` at line 227 (the whole PUT body is one big try/catch, lines 221-327); a `const` inside a Block is scoped to that Block, so it does NOT collide with the destructured function parameter `params` from lines 218-219 at the SYNTAX level - it legally shadows it for the rest of the try-block. HOWEVER this shadowing has a real runtime consequence: because `let`/`const` bindings are hoisted to the top of their block for TDZ purposes, the identifier `params` inside the try-block refers to the block-scoped `const` from the very first line of the block - including line 227, which executes BEFORE the `const params = []` on line 250 is reached. I verified this precisely with an isolated Node.js script reproducing the exact block/scope structure (try-block containing the same statement order): `const { businessId } = params` throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'params' before initialization`. Since this line runs unconditionally for every authenticated request (right after the auth check, before any business logic), and since it's inside the try/catch which returns `createErrorResponse('서버 내부 오류가 발생했습니다', 500)` on any caught error (and even if uncaught, the outer `withApiHandler` wrapper in lib/api-utils.ts also catches and returns 500), every single authenticated PUT request to this endpoint - regardless of businessId or body content - throws immediately and returns HTTP 500 before ever reaching the SQL update logic. The '저장' button in OrderDetailModal (handleSave) is completely non-functional for all users right now. (evidence: Live verification: curl GET and PUT to http://localhost:3002/api/order-management/00000000-... both returned normal 401 (auth-check reached, no compile error); dev log showed successful SWC compile of the module. Inspected .next/server/app/api/order-management/[businessId]/route.js: PUT body is `async (request, { params })=>{ try { ... const { businessId } = params; ... const updateFields = []; const params = []; ... } catch (error) {...}}` - byte-identical block structure to source lines 219-250. Isolated repro (/tmp/tdz_test.mjs during investigation, since discarded) confirmed `const { businessId } = params` inside a try-block that later declares `const params = []` in the same block throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'params' before initialization` at runtime. git show 7bcb6a6 confirms this collision was introduced in the Jan 6 2026 'Direct PostgreSQL migration' commit and is unchanged on HEAD.)
recommendation: Rename the local `const params: any[] = []` at route.ts L250 (and its later references) to e.g. `queryValues`, since it currently shadows the destructured route parameter `{ params }` used at L227 and, due to const/TDZ hoisting, throws a ReferenceError on every single authenticated PUT request — this is the single highest-priority fix in the list.

title: 영업비마감 지급명세 조회 API의 month 파라미터가 SQL 문자열에 그대로 삽입되어 SQL 인젝션 가능
description: monthClause를 `AND cp.payment_month = '${month}'` 형태로 이스케이프 없이 문자열 템플릿에 직접 삽입한 뒤 queryAll(sql)을 params 배열 없이 호출한다(29-51행). lib/supabase-direct.ts의 query()는 pool.query(text, params)를 그대로 호출하는데(62행) params가 undefined면 node-postgres가 simple query protocol을 사용해 세미콜론으로 구분된 다중 statement까지 실행 가능하다. permission_level 3 이상 유효 토큰만 있으면 month 파라미터에 스택드 쿼리를 주입해 임의 SQL을 실행할 수 있다. (evidence: summary/route.ts 29행 monthClause 문자열 템플릿 직접 삽입, 31-51행 queryAll(sql) 호출 시 params 인자 없음. lib/supabase-direct.ts 57-70행 query(text, params) 정의, 62행 pool.query(text, params)로 params undefined 시 그대로 전달.)
recommendation: Parameterize the month filter as `AND cp.payment_month = $1` and pass `[month]` through queryAll's params argument instead of interpolating month directly into the SQL string; treat this as top priority given the security severity even though the code change itself is small.

title: /api/meeting-departments has zero authentication and is also CSRF-exempt
description: GET/POST/DELETE never call getUserFromToken or any auth check (no jwt import even present in this file), unlike every sibling meeting-* route which all implement the same getUserFromToken() + 401 pattern. lib/security/csrf-protection.ts explicitly lists '/api/meeting-departments' and '/api/meeting-departments/*' in excludePatterns (lines 164-165) with comment '(JWT 인증 사용)' i.e. assumes the route authenticates via JWT, but it does not. I verified middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute() (lines 142-223) only performs rate-limiting, request-size validation, and CSRF checking for /api/* paths — it explicitly does NOT verify JWT/session for API routes (comment at line 260: '실제 검증은 페이지/API 레벨에서 수행'/'actual verification happens at page/API level'). Combined, this means POST/DELETE to /api/meeting-departments require no session cookie, no Bearer token, and no CSRF token — any unauthenticated request (even a bare curl/fetch from another origin) can add or delete rows in meeting_departments. (evidence: app/api/meeting-departments/route.ts lines 40-99: POST and DELETE handlers have no auth call before performing supabase inserts/deletes. lib/security/csrf-protection.ts lines 164-165 exempt this exact path from CSRF. middleware.ts lines 200-223 (protectAPIRoute) show CSRF is the only per-route gate for API paths; JWT structure checking only applies to page routes via checkPageAuthentication (lines 226-313), not to /api/* (line 333 calls protectAPIRoute, not checkPageAuthentication, for pathname.startsWith('/api/')).)
recommendation: Add the same getUserFromToken()+401 check used by every sibling meeting-* route to GET/POST/DELETE in meeting-departments/route.ts; existing callers already run same-origin with the session cookie so no frontend change is needed.

title: Reflected XSS in Google OAuth callback popup page via unescaped query params
description: code/error query params are interpolated unescaped into a JS string literal inside an inline <script> (`const code = "${code}";`). A URL like ?code=x";alert(document.cookie);// breaks out of the string literal and executes arbitrary JS on the app's own origin. Critically, this injection fires synchronously during initial HTML generation, before any token-exchange fetch runs -- so the payload executes for any anonymous visitor who simply loads the crafted URL, with zero dependency on a real OAuth code, a real Kakao/Google session, or any frontend button wiring it up. Since window.opener is referenced, this can forge SOCIAL_LOGIN_SUCCESS postMessage events to a real opener window, or exfiltrate the non-httpOnly 'auth_token' localStorage value used by TokenManager (lib/api-client.ts) elsewhere in the app. (evidence: Lines 9-11 read code/error from raw searchParams with no encoding/validation; lines 41-42 embed them directly inside a template-literal-built <script> block returned as text/html; the injection point is reached unconditionally on every GET regardless of whether `code` is a genuine OAuth code.)
recommendation: Replace the raw `"${code}"` / `"${error}"` interpolation in the inline <script> with `JSON.stringify(code)` / `JSON.stringify(error)` so query values can't break out of the string literal; single-file, mechanical templating fix.

title: Reflected XSS in Naver OAuth callback popup page via unescaped query params
description: Identical pattern to the Google callback: code/state/error are interpolated unescaped into an inline <script> string literal (`const code = "${code}";` etc.). Same exploit: a crafted URL breaks out of the string and runs arbitrary JS on the app origin for any visitor, independent of a real Naver login ever occurring. (evidence: Lines 9-12 read code/state/error from raw searchParams; lines 42-44 embed them directly into the inline <script> without escaping, identical structure to the Google callback bug.)
recommendation: Apply the same JSON.stringify() escaping to the code/state/error values embedded in the Naver callback's inline script; identical mechanical fix to the Google callback.

title: /api/data-history GET and POST have no authentication check at all
description: GET and POST handlers never read any Authorization header or cookie. GET returns full change history (old_data/new_data) for business_info, contract_history, etc. to any unauthenticated caller. POST { historyId, reason } calls DatabaseService.restoreFromHistory() to roll back arbitrary historical rows, also with zero auth. Contrast with app/api/access-logs/route.ts, which reads the Bearer/session_token cookie and calls verifyToken() before doing anything. (evidence: Read the full file (109 lines): no `request.headers.get('authorization')`, no cookie read, no auth import anywhere in GET (lines 11-44) or POST (lines 47-85). Confirmed middleware.ts does not perform real auth for /api/* routes either (see finding 1's evidence), so this route is genuinely open. Verified access-logs/route.ts does check a token before proceeding, for contrast.)
recommendation: Mirror access-logs/route.ts: read the Bearer/session_token cookie and call verifyToken() at the top of both GET and POST before touching DatabaseService.

title: commission-closing summary API — month 쿼리 파라미터 SQL 인젝션
description: month URL 파라미터를 이스케이프 없이 문자열 템플릿으로 SQL에 직접 삽입한 뒤(`AND cp.payment_month = '${month}'`) queryAll()로 실행한다. lib/supabase-direct.ts의 query()는 text를 그대로 pg Pool.query(text, params)에 전달하는 원시 실행 함수이므로 이스케이프 처리가 없다. 같은 폴더의 export/route.ts는 동일 패턴에 `.replace(/'/g, '')`로 작은따옴표 제거 방어를 하지만 summary/route.ts에는 그 방어조차 없다. (evidence: summary/route.ts 29행 `const monthClause = month ? `AND cp.payment_month = '${month}'` : '';` 및 31-51행 template literal SQL에서 monthClause를 그대로 삽입. lib/supabase-direct.ts 57-70행 query()가 `pool.query(text, params)`로 이스케이프 없이 실행함을 확인. export/route.ts 41행과 비교하면 동일 도메인 라우트 중 이 라우트에만 작은따옴표 제거 방어가 빠져 있음을 확인. month=`x' OR '1'='1`을 넣으면 WHERE절의 AND/OR 우선순위상 status IN (...) 필터가 무력화되어 전체 commission_payments 행이 노출되며, 파라미터화되지 않은 원시 실행 경로이므로 UNION 기반 임의 조회로 확장 가능하다.)
recommendation: Pass `month` as a bound parameter (e.g. `$1`) through queryAll's params array instead of string-interpolating it into the SQL text, mirroring a proper parameterized query rather than export/route.ts's incomplete quote-stripping workaround.

title: 견적서 DELETE API에 인증/권한 검증이 전혀 없음
description: 주석은 '권한 4 이상 필요'라고 명시하지만 DELETE 핸들러 본문(11-43행)에는 토큰 파싱, verifyTokenHybrid 호출, permissionLevel 비교 등 어떤 인증 코드도 없다. middleware.ts는 /api/ 경로에 대해 rate limit과 CSRF 검증만 수행하고(protectAPIRoute, 137-231행), 실제 서명 검증은 '페이지/API에서 수행됨'이라고 스스로 명시한다(286행 주석). CSRF 토큰은 인증 없이 GET /api/csrf-token으로 누구나 발급받을 수 있어(app/api/csrf-token/route.ts) 실질적 신원 확인이 되지 않는다. 따라서 CSRF 토큰만 있으면 어떤 사용자든 estimate_history의 임의 레코드를 하드 삭제할 수 있다. (evidence: app/api/estimates/[id]/route.ts:10-43 전체에 인증 코드 부재 확인. middleware.ts:288("실제 서명 검증은 페이지/API에서 수행됨") 및 app/api/csrf-token/route.ts:8-28(무인증 CSRF 토큰 발급)로 미들웨어가 대체 보호를 제공하지 않음을 확인.)
recommendation: Add the standard Bearer-token + token-verify + permissionLevel>=4 check (matching the route's own 'Level 4+' comment) to the DELETE handler, mirroring the auth pattern already used in app/api/installation-closing/transfers/route.ts.

title: 삭제한 사용자재가 DB에서 실제로 삭제되지 않음
description: removeMaterial()은 setMaterials(prev => prev.filter(...))로 로컬 state만 갱신하고 DELETE 요청을 전혀 보내지 않는다. handleSave()의 저장 루프는 현재 materials 배열만 순회하며 신규 항목(POST)과 기존 항목(PATCH)만 처리하고, 로드 시점엔 있었지만 배열에서 제거된 항목에 대한 DELETE 호출이 없다. (evidence: AsRecordModal.tsx:278-280 removeMaterial()이 filter로 로컬 state만 변경. handleSave()의 for(const mat of materials) 루프(417-448)는 mat.isNew||!mat.id 여부로 POST/PATCH만 분기하며 삭제 분기가 없음. /api/as-materials/[id]/route.ts에 DELETE 핸들러(69-98행, DELETE FROM as_material_usage)가 실제로 존재하지만 AsRecordModal.tsx 어디서도 호출되지 않음을 grep으로 확인.)
recommendation: Track the set of material IDs present when the record was loaded, and in handleSave()'s material loop, call DELETE /api/as-materials/[id] (endpoint already exists) for any of those IDs no longer present in the current materials array.

title: 단가표 삭제 시 AS건의 출동단가 참조를 확인하지 않아 하드 삭제로 과거 매출 데이터가 소급 손실됨
description: DELETE 핸들러의 usageCheck는 as_material_usage.price_list_id만 확인하고 as_records.dispatch_cost_price_id/dispatch_revenue_price_id는 조회하지 않는다. 신규 AS건은 등록 시 첫 번째 출동 단가표 항목을 자동 선택하므로 대다수 AS건이 이를 참조한다. 관리자가 해당 단가표 항목을 삭제하면 usageCount=0으로 판정되어 실제 DELETE가 실행되고, FK의 ON DELETE SET NULL로 인해 과거 AS건의 참조가 조용히 NULL로 초기화되어 매출/원가가 소급 0원 처리된다. (evidence: as-price-list/[id]/route.ts:86-90 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM as_material_usage WHERE price_list_id=$1 만 확인. AsRecordModal.tsx:132-142에서 신규건에 dispatchCostList[0]/dispatchRevenueList[0] 자동 선택 확인. database/add-as-revenue.sql:24-25 dispatch_cost_price_id/dispatch_revenue_price_id REFERENCES as_price_list(id) ON DELETE SET NULL 확인. 동일 파일 44-47행에 기본 출동비 50000/80000원 시드 데이터 존재 확인. as-revenue/route.ts:87,93은 참조가 NULL이면 COALESCE로 0원 처리.)
recommendation: Extend the usageCheck in as-price-list/[id]/route.ts's DELETE handler to also COUNT as_records referencing the price entry via dispatch_cost_price_id/dispatch_revenue_price_id, and block hard-delete (offering a deactivate/hide-from-list flag instead) when any reference exists.

title: Clicking '발주 완료' without first successfully saving permanently loses the user's entered step dates - and Save is currently 100% broken too (see TDZ bug above), so there is presently no way to persist step dates at all
description: handleComplete() (lines 284-336) validates 'no missing steps' purely against the local React state `stepDates` (lines 288-291), then calls only POST /api/order-management/[businessId]/complete (lines 309-316) - it never calls PUT to persist stepDates. I confirmed by reading app/api/order-management/[businessId]/complete/route.ts in full that the complete endpoint only ever touches business_info.order_date and order_management.status/completed_at/updated_by (lines 86-112) - it never writes layout_date/order_form_date/ip_request_date/greenlink_ip_setting_date/router_request_date. So a user who types all required dates and clicks '발주 완료' directly (without clicking '저장' first) gets a successful completion response, but the order_management date columns are never written. Once isCompleted is true, every date input is rendered with disabled={isCompleted} (lines 591, 606, 621, 631), so the entered dates can never be re-entered through this UI - the business shows '발주 완료됨' with permanently blank step dates. This is now even more severe than originally framed: given the PUT save endpoint is currently crashing on every call (separate confirmed bug above), there is currently NO successful path to ever persist these dates - not even by remembering to click '저장' first. (evidence: OrderDetailModal.tsx lines 284-336: handleComplete reads only local stepDates for validation and calls only POST .../complete, never PUT. app/api/order-management/[businessId]/complete/route.ts lines 86-112: only business_info.order_date and order_management.status/completed_at/updated_by are updated; no order_management date-step columns touched. Lines 591/606/621/631: disabled={isCompleted} on all date inputs.)
recommendation: In handleComplete() (OrderDetailModal.tsx L284-336), issue the same PUT save request used by handleSave and confirm it succeeds before calling POST .../complete, so entered step dates are guaranteed to be persisted before the record is marked completed and its date inputs become permanently disabled — this must land together with the item 12 fix since PUT is currently non-functional.

title: 문서 이력 삭제 API에 인증/권한 검증이 전혀 없음 (인증 우회로 임의 문서·계약서 삭제 가능)
description: DELETE 핸들러는 Authorization 헤더나 쿠키를 전혀 읽지 않고 verifyTokenString 등 어떤 인증 함수도 호출하지 않은 채 supabaseAdmin(SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)으로 곧바로 document_history를 조회·삭제하며, document_type이 'contract'이면 contract_history까지 연쇄 삭제한다. 같은 파일 계열의 app/api/document-automation/contract/route.ts DELETE 핸들러(라인 512-542)는 Bearer 토큰 검증과 permissionLevel>=4 체크를 명시적으로 수행하는 것과 극명히 대비된다. (evidence: route.ts 11-83행 전체에 토큰/권한 검증 코드가 전혀 없음을 직접 확인. middleware.ts의 protectAPIRoute()(142-227행)는 Rate Limit, 요청 크기, CSRF만 검사하고 실제 JWT 인증은 각 라우트에 위임한다(주석: '문서 자동화 API 전체 제외 (JWT 인증 사용)' - lib/security/csrf-protection.ts 138행에서 '/api/document-automation/*'가 CSRF 제외 패턴에 명시됨, 즉 이 경로군은 라우트 자체의 JWT 검증에 전적으로 의존). 이 DELETE 핸들러는 그 JWT 검증을 빠뜨렸으므로 인증 없이 임의 id로 DELETE 요청 시 200과 함께 실제 삭제가 수행된다.)
recommendation: Add the same Bearer-token verifyTokenString + permissionLevel check used in app/api/document-automation/contract/route.ts's DELETE handler (line 537, permissionLevel>=4) to this history DELETE route — both existing frontend callers (ContractManagement.tsx L417-421, page.tsx L224-229) already send an Authorization header, so this can be wired in without a frontend change, but confirm the intended permission threshold for non-contract document types before deploying.

title: POST /api/subsidy-crawler/manual has no authentication and is CSRF-exempt
description: The POST handler only checks that process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN is configured (line 32-43); it never validates a caller identity, bearer token, or session anywhere in the function. middleware.ts's isCSRFExemptAPI (line 118) whitelists the '/api/subsidy-crawler' prefix, which this route falls under, so CSRF protection is skipped too. Any unauthenticated client can POST to this endpoint and it will fire off three real GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch calls (subsidy-crawler-direct.yml, subsidy-crawler-phase2.yml, subsidy-crawler.yml), each of which runs paid Gemini AI analysis per announcement inside the triggered workflows. (evidence: manual/route.ts:28-118 — no jwt.verify, no Authorization header check, no CRAWLER_SECRET comparison anywhere in the function body, only `if (!githubToken)`. middleware.ts:118 lists '/api/subsidy-crawler' as CSRF-exempt (isCSRFExemptAPI uses startsWith), which matches this route's path. Contrast with app/api/subsidy-crawler/route.ts:510-511 which requires `authHeader !== 'Bearer ${CRAWLER_SECRET}'` to reject unauthenticated POSTs.)
recommendation: Require the same Bearer CRAWLER_SECRET check already used in app/api/subsidy-crawler/route.ts (line 510-511) in this manual/route.ts POST handler, remove '/api/subsidy-crawler' from middleware's CSRF-exempt prefix list (or scope the exemption more narrowly), and update the one caller in monitoring-dashboard/page.tsx (line 208-215) to send the required credential/token — this triggers real paid GitHub Actions runs so validate end-to-end before deploying.

title: PATCH /api/meeting-minutes/[id]/sections has no participant/organizer access check
description: The PATCH handler calls only getUserFromToken() (line 63) to confirm authentication, then fetches the meeting_minutes row (77-81) and mutates it (316-321) with no call to canAccessMeetingMinute/isFullAccessUser anywhere in the file (confirmed: no import of lib/meeting-minutes-access.ts, unlike [id]/route.ts and recurring-issues/route.ts which both import and call it). This is the endpoint app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/edit/page.tsx's handleSave() posts every bulk operation to (line 476/560: sectionUrl = `/api/meeting-minutes/${params.id}/sections`), and PresentationMode.tsx also PATCHes comments/summary to this same URL (lines 567, 595). Any authenticated employee who obtains a private meeting's UUID can PATCH {"section":"status","data":{"status":"archived"}} or a bulk payload rewriting agenda/business_issues/summary/participants with zero authorization check, completely bypassing the participant-based ACL enforced everywhere else in the domain (GET/PUT/DELETE/PATCH toggle in [id]/route.ts all call canAccessMeetingMinute). (evidence: Lines 62-66 only check `const user = await getUserFromToken(request); if (!user) {...401...}`. No canAccessMeetingMinute/isFullAccessUser call exists in the 333-line file (grep confirms), while the sibling app/api/meeting-minutes/[id]/route.ts calls canAccessMeetingMinute at lines 99, 154, 249, 337.)
recommendation: Import canAccessMeetingMinute/isFullAccessUser (as [id]/route.ts already does) into sections/route.ts and reject the PATCH with 403 before any section-mutation branch runs if the caller isn't organizer/creator/participant/full-access.

title: GET/POST /api/weekly-reports has no authentication check at all
description: GET (line 83) reads userId straight from searchParams and POST (line 394) reads userId straight from request.json() — neither ever reads an Authorization header, a cookie token, nor calls verifyToken. withApiHandler (lib/api-utils.ts:79-90) declares an unused `requiresAuth` option in its type signature but never checks it in the function body, so it performs no auth either. middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute (lines 139-215) only does rate limiting, request-size validation, and CSRF-token matching for non-GET methods — it does not verify JWT signatures for API routes (that Edge-runtime JWT structural check exists only in checkPageAuthentication, which runs for page navigations, not `/api/*`). Additionally lib/security/csrf-protection.ts:133 lists `/api/weekly-reports/*` in excludePatterns with the comment 'JWT 인증 사용' (JWT auth is used), which is false for this specific route, so even the POST write path skips CSRF too. Sibling routes admin/route.ts (lines 33-59) and realtime/route.ts (lines 97-115) both call verifyToken() and return 401 without a token, confirming the pattern this route is missing. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/route.ts:83-95 (GET) and :394-403 (POST) contain no authHeader/token/verifyToken logic anywhere in the file; lib/api-utils.ts:79-90 shows withApiHandler never references options.requiresAuth; middleware.ts:139-215 (protectAPIRoute) has no verifyToken call for API paths; lib/security/csrf-protection.ts:133 exempts '/api/weekly-reports/*' citing JWT auth that this file doesn't implement.)
recommendation: Add the same verifyToken(Authorization header or auth_token cookie) check used in app/api/weekly-reports/admin/route.ts and realtime/route.ts to both GET and POST handlers, returning 401 on failure; the only live caller (app/admin/weekly-reports/[userId]/page.tsx) already sends a Bearer token so this should be a drop-in fix, but scan for any other untracked callers (cron/internal scripts) before deploying.

title: Stored XSS via unauthenticated wiki node content modification (+ JWT theft path)
description: PATCH /api/wiki/nodes/[id] has zero authentication/authorization check. It reads the body, loops over allowedFields = ['title','content_md','tags','is_published','sort_order','metadata'] and writes whatever the caller sends directly to supabaseAdmin.from('wiki_nodes').update(...), and supabaseAdmin is instantiated with the Supabase service-role key (lib/supabase.ts getSupabaseAdmin, uses supabaseServiceKey), so it bypasses RLS entirely — there is no other gate. Node IDs are discoverable via GET /api/wiki/search (also unauthenticated), which returns raw `id` per result (search/route.ts line 55). components/wiki/WikiContent.tsx builds `html` by doing regex substitutions directly on `content_md` (never HTML-escaping `<`, `>`, `&`) and renders the result via dangerouslySetInnerHTML (lines 13-23, 36-39). app/wiki/admin/page.tsx line 76 confirms the app stores the session JWT under `localStorage.getItem('auth_token')`, so injected script can exfiltrate it. (evidence: app/api/wiki/nodes/[id]/route.ts lines 30-55: PATCH handler has no cookie/JWT check anywhere before the Supabase update call, unlike the sibling guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts DELETE handler which does `jwt.verify` + permission_level>=4 check. app/api/wiki/search/route.ts line 55 returns `id: node.id` with no auth required (GET has no auth check either). components/wiki/WikiContent.tsx lines 13-23 build `html` via .replace() chains on raw `content` with no escaping step, then line 38 injects via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: ... }}`. app/wiki/admin/page.tsx line 76: `localStorage.getItem('auth_token')`. middleware.ts protectAPIRoute() (lines 142-223) only does rate-limiting, request-size check, and CSRF — never JWT/session verification for API routes; and lib/security/csrf-protection.ts line 173 exempts `/api/wiki/*` from even CSRF checks.)
recommendation: Add the same JWT + permission_level>=4 check used in app/api/wiki/guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts to the PATCH handler (no current frontend caller relies on it being open, so this is safe to add), and separately HTML-escape content_md's `<`, `>`, `&` in WikiContent.tsx before applying the markdown regex replacements, since that component renders on every wiki page.

title: /api/users/employees has zero authentication on GET/POST/PUT
description: GET/POST/PUT are only wrapped in withApiHandler(handler,{logLevel:'debug'}); withApiHandler's body (lib/api-utils.ts:79-125) never reads options.requiresAuth or checks any token. middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute (lines 142-217) only does rate-limiting, request-size checks, and CSRF matching for /api/* -- there is no JWT/session verification for API routes anywhere in the middleware chain, confirmed by reading protectAPIRoute end-to-end and the top-level middleware() function which routes all /api/* through protectAPIRoute only. POST hardcodes is_active:true (line 196) with an attacker-supplied permission_level. CSRF is not a real barrier since GET /api/csrf-token (app/api/csrf-token/route.ts) is itself unauthenticated and hands a valid token to anyone. (evidence: lib/api-utils.ts:79-125 shows withApiHandler's only logic is try/catch + logging, no auth branch; app/api/users/employees/route.ts:139,217,302 pass only {logLevel:'debug'}; middleware.ts:142-217 protectAPIRoute has no jwt.verify/session check; app/api/csrf-token/route.ts:8-29 issues tokens with no auth.)
recommendation: Wire the existing requireAuth() helper from lib/auth/require-auth.ts into GET (minLevel=1, matching the pattern already used elsewhere) and a higher minLevel into POST/PUT of app/api/users/employees/route.ts before it touches is_active/permission_level, then smoke-test AdminManagerPicker, MultiAssigneeSelector, and the meeting-minutes create/edit pages since they call this route via same-origin cookie auth with no explicit Authorization header.

title: change-password allows changing password with no proof of the old one
description: currentPassword is checked only 'if (currentPassword && existingUser.password_hash)' -- omitting currentPassword in the request body skips verification entirely, so any request bearing a valid JWT (however obtained) can silently change the account's password with only {newPassword}. (evidence: Lines 87-96: `if (currentPassword && existingUser.password_hash) { ...compare... }` -- no else branch requiring it; the rest of the handler proceeds to hash and persist newPassword unconditionally once past this optional block.)
recommendation: This needs a coordinated frontend+backend change: add a '현재 비밀번호' input to app/profile/page.tsx's password form (it currently sends only {newPassword}, confirmed at L252) and include it in the request, then make change-password/route.ts L87-96 require currentPassword whenever existingUser.password_hash is non-null, leaving the null-hash path (app/set-password/page.tsx) unaffected.

title: checkUserPermission() in organization members API is a fake auth stub — any non-empty Bearer token grants full admin
description: checkUserPermission() only checks that the Authorization header starts with 'Bearer ' and unconditionally returns { authorized: true, user: { id: 'admin-user', permission_level: 3, name: '관리자' } } with no token verification. The middleware (middleware.ts protectAPIRoute) only does rate-limiting/size/CSRF for /api/* — it explicitly defers real auth to the page/API level, so nothing else covers this route. Sibling routes app/api/organization/departments/route.ts and teams/route.ts correctly call verifyTokenHybrid(token). Any request with header `Authorization: Bearer x` is treated as a permission_level 3 admin. (evidence: Read lines 9-23: checkUserPermission never parses/verifies the token value, just checks the 'Bearer ' prefix and returns a hardcoded admin object. Confirmed middleware.ts lines 141-220 (protectAPIRoute/checkPageAuthentication) do not validate API bearer tokens — JWT signature checking is explicitly deferred ('실제 서명 검증은 페이지/API에서 수행됨'). Confirmed departments/route.ts and teams/route.ts call verifyTokenHybrid(token) instead.)
recommendation: Replace checkUserPermission()'s hardcoded admin object with a real verifyTokenHybrid(token) call, copying the pattern already used correctly in the sibling app/api/organization/departments/route.ts and teams/route.ts files; single file but gates live position_level/member-mutation endpoints so verify the frontend already sends real Bearer tokens before deploying.

title: /api/organization/members and /api/organization/task-assignments allow full org mutation with a forged Bearer header
description: Because checkUserPermission() (identical stub, duplicated in this file) never validates the token, a forged `Authorization: Bearer x` header is treated as permission_level 3 admin. POST /api/organization/members with action='promote' directly updates employees.position_level (line ~231, `.update({ position_level: new_position_level, ... })`) with no further check. POST /api/organization/task-assignments sends personal notifications/push/telegram and writes organization_changes_detailed for arbitrary employee IDs supplied in the body. (evidence: Read task-assignments/route.ts lines 11-25: identical fake stub. Read members/route.ts lines 228-244: the 'promote' case updates `employees.position_level` keyed only on the request body's employee_id/new_position_level, gated solely by the broken checkUserPermission().)
recommendation: Apply the identical verifyTokenHybrid(token) fix to task-assignments/route.ts's checkUserPermission(), ideally extracting one shared helper used by both this file and members/route.ts to prevent the same stub from drifting back in later.

title: verifyAuth() stub from lib/auth.ts makes /api/tasks/[id]/comments effectively unauthenticated and crashes POST
description: Route imports verifyAuth from @/lib/auth (a 9-line stub: `export function verifyAuth() { return true }`) instead of @/lib/auth/middleware used by sibling routes app/api/tasks/route.ts and app/api/tasks/[id]/route.ts. `const { user, error: authError } = await verifyAuth() as any` destructures the primitive `true`, giving user=undefined, authError=undefined. GET: `if (authError)` never triggers, so comment listing has no real auth check — any caller gets a 200 with data. POST: `user.id` is accessed inside the object literal passed to `.insert(...)` at line 122, throwing TypeError before the insert executes; this is caught by the outer catch (line 161-167) and returned as a generic 500, so every comment-creation request fails. (evidence: Read lib/auth.ts (verifyAuth returns bare `true`, no params). Read app/api/tasks/[id]/comments/route.ts lines 1-8 (import), 16 and 62 (destructuring verifyAuth() result), 118-125 (insert object literal referencing user.id before insertion), 140-154 (processMentions(..., user.id) and mentioned_user_id:user.id also depend on undefined user). Confirmed via grep that only this route in app/api/tasks/ imports from '@/lib/auth' while others use '@/lib/auth/middleware'.)
recommendation: Switch the import in app/api/tasks/[id]/comments/route.ts from the stub in @/lib/auth to verifyAuth(request) in @/lib/auth/middleware, matching the sibling routes app/api/tasks/route.ts and app/api/tasks/[id]/route.ts, and verify GET/POST both use the returned AuthResult correctly.

title: 캘린더 이벤트 CRUD API 전체(PUT/DELETE/POST)에 인증/권한 검증이 없음
description: PUT(53-186행)과 DELETE(194-249행) 핸들러 모두 요청자의 토큰을 검증하지 않는다. 같은 도메인의 app/api/calendar/route.ts POST(109-236행)도 author_id/author_name을 body에서 그대로 신뢰하며 인증 검증이 없다. 주석(51행 'Level 1+ 수정 가능', 107행 'Level 1+ 쓰기 가능')만 있을 뿐 실제 레벨 체크 코드는 없다. estimates DELETE와 동일하게 middleware는 CSRF/rate-limit만 수행하므로, 누구나(무인증 상태에서 GET /api/csrf-token으로 토큰만 얻으면) 임의 이벤트를 수정/삭제하거나 타인 이름으로 이벤트를 생성할 수 있다. (evidence: app/api/calendar/[id]/route.ts:53-249에서 PUT/DELETE 전체를 확인, verifyTokenHybrid나 permissionLevel 체크 없음. app/api/calendar/route.ts:109-236 POST에서도 author_id/author_name이 body에서 검증 없이 그대로 INSERT됨(164-179행).)
recommendation: Add the Bearer-token + permissionLevel check to PUT/DELETE in calendar/[id]/route.ts and POST in calendar/route.ts, and also add the Authorization header to the corresponding fetch calls in CalendarModal.tsx/CalendarBoard.tsx (they currently send no token at all) — server-only enforcement without the client change will break calendar writes for every user.

title: 계산서 발행 레코드(재무 데이터) CRUD API에 인증이 전혀 없음
description: POST(26-179행)/PUT(185-305행)/DELETE(311-353행) 모두 토큰 검증 코드가 없다. 특히 middleware.ts의 isCSRFExemptAPI 목록에 '/api/invoice-records'가 '쿠키 인증'이라는 주석과 함께 CSRF 예외로 등록되어 있는데(middleware.ts:120행), 실제로는 CSRF 검증도 건너뛰고 쿠키 기반 인증 로직도 라우트 코드에 전혀 구현되어 있지 않다. 이는 다른 CSRF-exempt 라우트들(delivery-addresses 등)이 checkUserPermission으로 verifyTokenHybrid를 호출하는 것과 대조된다. 결과적으로 인증 없이 계산서 발행일·금액·입금일을 조작하거나 삭제할 수 있다. (evidence: app/api/invoice-records/route.ts 전체(26-353행)에서 verifyTokenHybrid/토큰 파싱 부재 확인. middleware.ts:120 '/api/invoice-records' // 계산서 레코드 CRUD API (쿠키 인증) — CSRF조차 면제되어 있으나 실제 쿠키 인증 코드가 라우트에 없음을 대조 확인.)
recommendation: Implement real auth (Bearer token + permissionLevel check matching sibling revenue-closing routes) on invoice-records POST/PUT/DELETE and add the Authorization header in the 5 consuming components (InvoiceRecordForm, InvoiceRevisionForm, ExtraInvoiceForm, ExtraInvoiceList, InvoiceTabSection), which currently call fetch() with no auth header at all — then correct or remove the stale '쿠키 인증' comment in middleware.ts's CSRF-exempt list.

title: 대부분의 시설(facility) API 라우트에 인증 검사가 없어 미인증 접근으로 데이터 조회/변조 가능
description: middleware.ts:326-343 confirms API routes only get CSRF+rate-limit checks and explicitly skip checkPageAuthentication (the comment literally says '페이지 인증 체크 건너뛰기'). I opened every listed route file and none of them call any session/JWT verification helper (contrast with app/api/router-inventory/*.ts and app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts, which both call checkUserPermission/verifyTokenHybrid before doing anything). I also verified app/api/csrf-token/route.ts issues a valid CSRF token with zero authentication, so an attacker only needs one unauthenticated GET to obtain a token, then can freely POST/PUT/DELETE any of these endpoints (delete facility photos, delete discharge/prevention facilities, edit measurement devices, edit business survey/install info) without ever logging in. (evidence: middleware.ts lines 326-343 (API branch returns after protectAPIRoute, before checkPageAuthentication); app/api/csrf-token/route.ts GET has no auth call and issues token unconditionally; each of the 16 files above has zero occurrences of session_token/verifyAuth/checkUserPermission/getServerSession, confirmed by direct read of every file's GET/POST/PUT/DELETE handlers.)
files: app/api/facility-management/route.ts, app/api/facility-measurement/route.ts, app/api/facility-detail/route.ts, app/api/facility-stats/route.ts, app/api/facility-photos/route.ts, app/api/facility-photos/[photoId]/route.ts, app/api/facility-photos/download-zip/route.ts, app/api/outlet-facility/route.ts, app/api/outlet-gateway/route.ts, app/api/gateway-devices/route.ts, app/api/measurement-devices/route.ts, app/api/equipment-field-checks/route.ts, app/api/equipment-field-checks/sync/[checkId]/route.ts, app/api/facilities-supabase/[businessName]/route.ts, app/api/facility-tasks/advance/route.ts, app/api/facility-tasks/[id]/history/route.ts:whole-file GET/POST/PUT/DELETE handlers
recommendation: Apply the existing checkUserPermission/verifyTokenHybrid helper (already used in app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts and app/api/router-inventory/*) to all 16 routes one file at a time, verifying first whether any (e.g. equipment-field-checks, called from field devices) need a service token issued rather than a browser session before enforcing 401.

title: Primary air-permit CRUD API has zero authentication/authorization
description: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE go straight from request.json()/searchParams to raw SQL via lib/supabase-direct with no identity check anywhere in the file. (evidence: Read the entire file: only imports `queryOne, queryAll, query` from '@/lib/supabase-direct' (line 3) — no verifyToken/verifyTokenHybrid/getServerSession/checkUserPermission import or call in GET(33-213), POST(216-417), PUT(420-710), or DELETE(713-781). middleware.ts protectAPIRoute() (142-223) only does rate-limit/size/CSRF for /api/* and returns null (comment at line 290: '실제 서명 검증은 페이지/API에서 수행됨'), so it doesn't fill the gap. Additionally lib/security/csrf-protection.ts explicitly lists '/api/air-permit' in its CSRF excludePaths with the comment '대기필증 관리 API (JWT 인증 사용)' — falsely claiming JWT auth is used, when it isn't — so this route has neither CSRF nor auth. Contrast with app/api/air-permit/update/route.ts, which correctly calls checkUserPermission()/verifyTokenHybrid (lines 40-73). An unauthenticated DELETE /api/air-permit?id=<uuid> soft-deletes any permit; unauthenticated PUT/POST mutates/creates any business's permit data.)
recommendation: Add the same checkUserPermission/verifyTokenHybrid guard already used in app/api/air-permit/update/route.ts to every handler in this file, verify the admin UI and EstimatePreviewModal already send auth_token, then correct the false '/api/air-permit ... JWT 인증 사용' comment in csrf-protection.ts's excludePaths.

title: Legacy air-permits (plural) [id] API is unauthenticated and exposes an irreversible hard-delete
description: GET/PUT/DELETE perform no auth check; DELETE with ?hard=true issues a genuine hard delete on air_permit_info with no identity check and no undo path. (evidence: Read the full file: no auth check appears anywhere in GET(12-117), PUT(120-201), or DELETE(204-254). DELETE reads `hardDelete = url.searchParams.get('hard') === 'true'` (line 211) and when true runs `adminClient.from('air_permit_info').delete().eq('id', id)` (lines 219-222) — an unrecoverable delete, versus the soft-delete branch (228-238) used otherwise. No caller identity is checked before either path.)
recommendation: Add auth requiring an elevated permission level specifically for the `hard=true` DELETE branch, and first check whether this legacy plural 'air-permits/[id]' route is still called anywhere — if not, delete the route instead of patching it.

title: 본마감 자동 트리거가 예측마감 기지급액을 차감하지 않고 확정액 전액(final) + 차액(adjustment)을 이중 생성함
description: calculateFinalDiff()가 반환하는 diff_details[].final_amount는 finalBreakdown의 절대값(lib/installation-closing.ts 119-141행)인데, auto-trigger는 이를 그대로 payment_type='final' actual_amount로 INSERT하면서(93-112행) 동시에 동일 항목의 diff(=final-forecast)도 payment_type='adjustment'로 별도 INSERT한다(114-136행). 예측마감으로 이미 100만원이 paid된 사업장의 확정액이 120만원이면 final=120만+adjustment=20만=140만원이 신규 pending으로 쌓이고, 이후 final/process가 이를 모두 paid로 전환한다. 이 트리거는 app/api/business-info-direct/route.ts 1063행에서 installation_date가 새로 설정될 때마다 자동 호출되는 라이브 경로이며, summary/transfers 화면과 결재 모달(installation-closing/page.tsx 1299행 finalBusinesses.final_total 합산)이 이 과다 금액을 그대로 노출한다. (evidence: lib/installation-closing.ts 124-125행: final_amount는 finalBreakdown.base_installation_cost 절대값. auto-trigger/route.ts 93-112행에서 이 절대값을 final로 INSERT, 114-136행에서 diff를 adjustment로 추가 INSERT. business-info-direct/route.ts 1062-1068행에서 installation_date 신규 설정 시 자동 호출 확인. installation-closing/page.tsx 351행/1299행에서 final_total(절대값)을 결재 총액으로 그대로 사용 확인.)
recommendation: Redesign the auto-trigger insert logic so it records only the diff amount per category (not final_amount plus diff again) — e.g. drop the separate 'final' full-amount insert loop and keep only the diff-based 'adjustment' insert, which already equals the full amount when no forecast was paid — then write a one-off script to identify and correct/cancel already-duplicated pending records created by the current code.

title: 영업비마감 결재 상신 실패가 무시되어 commission_payments가 pending_approval에 영구 고착됨
description: 트랜잭션(116-153행)에서 approval_documents(draft)와 commission_payments(pending_approval)를 이미 커밋한 뒤 /api/approvals/[id]/submit을 호출하고(156-163행), submitData.success 값과 무관하게 항상 success:true와 고정 성공 메시지를 반환한다(166-174행). submit 라우트는 요청자 role 기준 필수 결재자가 비어있으면 400을 반환하는데(approvals/[id]/submit/route.ts 174-185행), 프런트엔드(commission-closing/page.tsx 387-434행)는 ceo_id만 검증하고 team_leader_id 등은 검증하지 않으며, data.success만 확인해(419행) 실패를 인지하지 못한다. cancel API(commission-closing/cancel/route.ts 37-40행)는 status='eligible'만 대상으로 하므로 pending_approval에 고착된 레코드는 취소도 불가능하다. (evidence: approval/route.ts 156-174행: submitData.success 미확인, 항상 success:true 반환. approvals/[id]/submit/route.ts 174-185행: needTeamLeader/needExecutive/needVicePresident 미충족 시 400. commission-closing/page.tsx 387-391행 ceo_id만 검증, 419행 data.success만 체크. cancel/route.ts 37-40행 WHERE status='eligible' 확인, pending_approval 미포함.)
recommendation: Check submitData.success after the /submit call and, on failure, run a compensating update reverting commission_payments back to 'eligible' and marking/deleting the draft approval_documents row instead of unconditionally returning success:true; also add a cleanup pass for any records currently stuck in pending_approval from this bug.

title: 설치비마감 결재 상신 실패도 동일하게 무시되어 installation_payments가 pending에 고착됨
description: commission-closing/approval과 동일 패턴. 트랜잭션(71-121행)에서 approval_documents(draft)와 installation_payments(status='pending')를 이미 커밋한 뒤 submit을 호출하고(124-131행), submitData.success와 무관하게 항상 success:true를 반환한다(134-144행). 프런트엔드(installation-closing/page.tsx 356-403행)도 data.success만 확인한다. (evidence: approval/route.ts 134-144행: submitData 값 미확인, 고정 success:true 및 메시지 반환. installation-closing/page.tsx 371행 data.success만 체크, team_leader_id 등 별도 필수값 검증 없음(365행에서 undefined로 전달 가능).)
recommendation: Apply the same fix as item 15 to installation-closing/approval/route.ts (check submitData.success, revert installation_payments to prior status on failure) since both routes share the identical broken pattern.

title: Stored XSS via unsanitized rich-text agenda description rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML
description:
Agenda item description (rich HTML persisted via PATCH /api/meeting-minutes/[id]/sections, 'agenda'/'agenda-add'/bulk cases) is rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML after only being passed through sanitizeLegacyEscapedHtml() (lib/rich-text.ts, lines 57-88). I read that function fully: it only unescapes HTML entities and reflows `

` into paragraph breaks — it contains no tag/attribute stripping and no allowlist. I confirmed via grep there is no DOMPurify or sanitize-html usage anywhere near the meeting-minutes rendering path (sanitize-html is used elsewhere, in lib/services/gmail-api.ts, but never imported by meeting-minutes code). The sections PATCH route (app/api/meeting-minutes/[id]/sections/route.ts, 'agenda'/'agenda-add'/bulk cases at lines 122-143, 251-260) merges client-supplied data.description straight into the stored agenda array with no server-side sanitization either. Same unsanitized dangerouslySetInnerHTML pattern also exists in components/meeting-minutes/PresentationMode.tsx line 270. Any authenticated employee can PATCH the sections endpoint directly (bypassing the Tiptap editor UI) with description containing `` and it will execute in the browser of any other user (including admins) who later opens the meeting detail page or Presentation Mode. (evidence: lib/rich-text.ts lines 57-88 (sanitizeLegacyEscapedHtml: only entity-unescaping and

reflow, no tag stripping) combined with app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/page.tsx lines 345-351 (`const desc = sanitizeLegacyEscapedHtml(item.description); ... dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: desc }}`); grep for DOMPurify/sanitize-html usage in the meeting-minutes code path returned no results.)
recommendation: Introduce an allowlist-based HTML sanitizer (e.g. isomorphic-dompurify) applied server-side when agenda descriptions are persisted via sections/route.ts and defensively again before both dangerouslySetInnerHTML call sites ([id]/page.tsx and PresentationMode.tsx), choosing the allowed tag/attribute set carefully to avoid breaking existing rich-text formatting.

title: DPF API 라우트 전체에 인증/인가가 없어 PII 무인증 조회 및 무인증 CRUD 가능
description: app/api/dpf 아래 모든 route.ts는 supabaseAdmin(서비스 키)만 사용하고 session_token/JWT 검증 코드가 전혀 없다(grep 결과 session_token/jwt/verifyToken/requireAuth/Authorization 매칭 0건). middleware.ts 327-343행을 직접 확인한 결과, API 경로는 protectAPIRoute()(rate-limit·요청크기·CSRF만 검사)를 통과하면 340행에서 즉시 NextResponse.next()로 응답하며, 페이지용 checkPageAuthentication()은 API 경로에서 호출되지 않는다(339행 주석 'API 보호 통과 시 여기서 종료 — 페이지 인증 체크 건너뛰기'가 이를 명시). 게다가 csrf-protection.ts 172행에 '/api/dpf/*'가 excludePatterns에 등록되어 있어 GET뿐 아니라 POST/PUT/DELETE도 CSRF 검사 자체가 완전히 면제된다. 그 주석('DPF 차량 관리 API 전체 제외 (JWT 인증 사용)')은 사실과 다르다 — 실제로는 어떤 JWT 인증도 라우트 코드에 존재하지 않는다. (evidence: middleware.ts:333-343 (API 통과 시 checkPageAuthentication 미호출), csrf-protection.ts:172 ('/api/dpf/*' CSRF 전체 제외), app/api/dpf/search/route.ts:19-46 (supabaseAdmin만 사용, 인증 검사 없음), app/api/dpf/vehicles/[vin]/route.ts 전체 PUT/DELETE/GET에 인증 없음. grep -rn 'session_token|verifyToken|jwt|requireAuth|Authorization' app/api/dpf/ → 결과 없음.)
recommendation: Add the same verifyToken(Authorization/auth_token cookie) check used elsewhere in the app to all 13 app/api/dpf/**/route.ts handlers (ideally via a shared middleware/wrapper to avoid repeating it 13 times), remove the false 'JWT 인증 사용' CSRF exclusion comment and correct the exclusion to only apply once auth is actually enforced, and add authorization checks for the write endpoints (PUT/DELETE) since this exposes PII with zero current gating.

title: PUT/DELETE /api/notifications have zero authentication — any caller can mark-read or delete any user's notifications
description: Neither the PUT handler (line 675) nor the DELETE handler (line 728) calls getUserFromToken() or checks any Authorization header — they trust `user_id`/`userId` taken straight from the request body/query string and run `.eq('user_id', user_id)` updates/deletes with the service-role supabaseAdmin client. withApiHandler (lib/api-utils.ts:79-125) accepts a `requiresAuth` option but never reads it anywhere in its body, so it provides no protection either. This is not theoretical: components/sections/BusinessProgressSection.tsx:197-208 (rendered live on app/business/[businessName]/page.tsx via BusinessContent.tsx) calls `fetch('/api/notifications', {method:'PUT', body: {notification_ids, user_id: user?.id}})` with NO Authorization header at all, and contexts/TierNotificationContext.tsx:287-327/330-365 (markAsRead/markAllAsRead, live via app/admin/notifications/page.tsx's TierNotificationProvider) send the user_id from client-side state. Anyone who can reach the API can supply an arbitrary user_id/userId and mark-read or delete another employee's notifications. (evidence: route.ts lines 675-725 and 728-822 contain no getUserFromToken()/auth check (contrast with GET at line 117 and POST at line 462, which do call it). lib/api-utils.ts:79-125 withApiHandler never reads options.requiresAuth. components/sections/BusinessProgressSection.tsx:197-208 sends this exact PUT with no Authorization header, proving the endpoint is live and exploitable through the app's own code path.)
recommendation: Add getUserFromToken() to both PUT and DELETE, derive the acting user's id from the verified JWT instead of trusting body/query user_id (or at minimum assert the supplied user_id === token user's id before running the update/delete), and update BusinessProgressSection.tsx and TierNotificationContext.tsx to send an Authorization header — coordinate the backend and both frontend call sites together since this endpoint is actively used by real users.

title: lib/secure-jwt.ts permanently trusts a hardcoded, source-visible JWT secret with no time-based cutoff
description: OLD_JWT_SECRET = 'your-secret-key-change-this-in-production' is a literal in the repo. verifyTokenHybrid() and the synchronous verifyToken() both fall back to jwt.verify(token, OLD_JWT_SECRET) if the current-secret check fails, unconditionally. MIGRATION_PERIOD_DAYS=7 is declared and re-exported (line 245) but never read anywhere in the file to reject old-secret tokens after the window -- confirmed by scanning the whole file for the identifier, it only appears in its declaration and the export list. This module is imported broadly (getUserFromToken/verifyTokenHybrid) across many live, auth-gated API routes, so anyone who can sign a token with the hardcoded string is accepted indefinitely. (evidence: Line 7 hardcoded secret; lines 76-92 catch-fallback to OLD_JWT_SECRET with no expiry check; lines 225-239 verifyToken() has the identical fallback; MIGRATION_PERIOD_DAYS (line 9) never referenced in any conditional in the file.)
recommendation: Use the already-declared MIGRATION_PERIOD_DAYS to reject OLD_JWT_SECRET-signed tokens once the window has elapsed (or force a one-time global re-login), then drop the OLD_JWT_SECRET fallback entirely, and roll this out as a coordinated release since verifyTokenHybrid/getUserFromToken gate most of the app's authenticated API surface.

title: set-password lets anyone set a password on any social-only employee account with no ownership proof
description: Origin validation passes unconditionally when the Origin header is absent (lines 45-46: `if (!origin) isOriginAllowed = true`), trivially bypassed by curl/fetch without a browser. If the Authorization header is missing or its JWT fails verification, the catch block at line 73-75 silently falls through to trusting the request body's `email` field directly, with no additional ownership check (no email verification link/token). If that employee is is_active and has no password_hash yet (i.e. a social-only account), the handler sets whatever password the caller supplied and immediately returns a working JWT + auth_token cookie -- full account takeover of any colleague's not-yet-password-protected account by anyone who knows their email address. (evidence: Lines 45-46 origin bypass when Origin absent; lines 67-76 JWT verify wrapped in try/catch that falls back to body.email on any failure (including simply not sending an Authorization header); lines 132-142 gate only on employee.is_active && !employee.password_hash, no ownership/verification check; lines 178-224 issue a fresh JWT + httpOnly cookie immediately after.)
recommendation: Remove the 'no Origin ⇒ allow' bypass and the JWT-failure fallback that trusts body.email, and require actual proof of account ownership (e.g. a time-limited emailed verification token) before letting a password be set on a social-only account — this needs a product decision on how first-time password-setting should prove identity, not just a validation tweak.

title: Kakao social login POST approval gate is completely non-functional -- every new email is auto-approved regardless of policy
description: getEmailDomainPolicy() returns auto_approve:true as the default for any domain lacking an explicit social_auth_policies row, despite a comment calling it 'the most restrictive default'. Worse, even when an explicit policy has auto_approve:false, the else-branch (517-611) is labeled '수동 승인 필요하지만 임시로 자동 승인 처리(테스트용)' and creates the employee with is_active:true, permission_level from the policy anyway -- there is no code path in this file that ever leaves an account in a pending state. By contrast, the sibling app/api/auth/social/google/route.ts:145-225 correctly writes a pending row to social_auth_approvals and returns 202 APPROVAL_REQUIRED when auto_approve is false, confirming this is a real regression specific to the Kakao path and not an intentional design choice. (evidence: Lines 142-148: default policy object literal has `auto_approve: true` despite the '가장 제한적' comment; lines 517-611 (the `else` branch reached when policy.auto_approve is explicitly false) still calls supabaseAdmin.from('employees').insert({..., is_active: true, ...}) with a TODO admitting the approval system was never built; app/api/auth/social/google/route.ts:145-225 shows the correct contrasting implementation.)
recommendation: Flip the default policy to auto_approve:false and replace the 'temporary auto-approve' else-branch with the real pending-approval flow (insert into social_auth_approvals, return 202) already implemented correctly in google/route.ts, but roll out only after admins pre-configure policies for domains that currently rely on Kakao auto-login, since flipping the default could otherwise lock out real users mid-flow.

title: All /api/settings/* mutation endpoints have no auth check — withApiHandler() never enforces its own requiresAuth option
description: withApiHandler() (lib/api-utils.ts lines 79-122) accepts a `requiresAuth?: boolean` option but the returned handler never reads it — it only measures duration and catches errors. None of manufacturers/route.ts, manufacturers/reorder/route.ts, progress-categories/route.ts, progress-categories/migrate/route.ts, progress-categories/reorder/route.ts, task-stages/route.ts, task-stages/reorder/route.ts, task-stages/seed/route.ts, or delay-criteria/route.ts do their own auth check (grep for auth-related tokens found zero matches in any of the eight files). POST /api/settings/progress-categories/migrate performs an unauthenticated bulk UPDATE across business_info, rewriting progress_status for every matching row. (evidence: Read lib/api-utils.ts lines 79-122: `options.requiresAuth` is destructured nowhere; only `logLevel` is used. Read progress-categories/migrate/route.ts in full: GET/POST wrapped in withApiHandler with only {logLevel:'debug'}, no auth. Grepped all 8 named route files for 'auth|Authorization|verifyToken|checkUserPermission|requiresAuth' — zero matches in any of them.)
recommendation: Decide the required auth/permission model for /api/settings/* first, then implement enforcement inside withApiHandler's requiresAuth branch and opt in the 8 settings routes one by one, testing each after the change since withApiHandler is shared by 52 route files.

title: AnnouncementBoard의 userLevel이 하드코딩(3)되어 있고 서버 API도 권한 검증이 전혀 없어 Level 3+ 제한이 완전히 무력화됨
description: `const [userLevel, setUserLevel] = useState<number>(3);`로 하드코딩되어 있어 컴포넌트 주석의 'Level 3+ (SUPER_ADMIN) 작성/수정/삭제 가능' 요구사항과 반대로 모든 방문자에게 항상 userLevel>=3이 참이 된다(line 180). handleAnnouncementClick(line 86-90)도 권한 체크 없이 클릭 즉시 modalMode를 'edit'로 설정한다. 게다가 서버측 app/api/announcements/route.ts의 POST와 app/api/announcements/[id]/route.ts의 PUT/DELETE 핸들러를 직접 읽어본 결과 어떤 권한/역할 검증 코드도 없으며(요청 body 필수값 체크만 존재), middleware.ts의 protectAPIRoute(line 142-223)도 rate-limit·요청크기·CSRF만 검사하고 인증/권한 검사(checkPageAuthentication)는 API 경로에 대해서는 아예 호출되지 않는다(line 327-343 참고, 페이지 경로에만 적용). 즉 클라이언트 하드코딩뿐 아니라 서버에도 이중 안전장치가 전혀 없어, 로그인한 어떤 사용자든(권한 레벨 무관) 공지사항을 생성/수정/삭제할 수 있는 상태다. (evidence: components/boards/AnnouncementBoard.tsx:36 (userLevel=3 하드코딩), :180 (userLevel>=3 체크), :86-90 (권한 체크 없이 edit 모드 진입); app/api/announcements/route.ts POST 핸들러 전체에 권한 검증 코드 없음; app/api/announcements/[id]/route.ts PUT/DELETE 핸들러에도 권한 검증 없음; middleware.ts:327-343에서 API 경로는 protectAPIRoute만 통과하면 즉시 응답, checkPageAuthentication 미호출)
recommendation: Fix both sides together: replace the hardcoded userLevel=3 with a real value from the auth/session context in AnnouncementBoard, and add server-side role/permission checks to the announcements POST/PUT/DELETE handlers so client-side state can't be bypassed.

title: Production Postgres password hardcoded in git-tracked source file
description: getDirectConnection() builds the pg Pool with a literal password string 'chlansgh35855#' instead of reading from an environment variable such as SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD. This is a direct Postgres superuser-level connection (Transaction Mode pooler, port 6543) that bypasses Supabase RLS entirely. (evidence: Read lib/supabase-direct.ts line 30: `password: 'chlansgh35855#',` is a literal string, no process.env reference anywhere in the file. Verified with `git ls-files lib/supabase-direct.ts` (tracked) and `git check-ignore -v lib/supabase-direct.ts` (exit code 1, not ignored) that the file is committed to the repo history (last touched at commit de5d4f4). Anyone with repo read access gets full read/write DB credentials outside RLS.)
recommendation: Rotate the leaked Postgres password immediately, move the new credential to SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD (already used elsewhere per project memory) read via process.env in lib/supabase-direct.ts, and purge the old literal from git history.

title: business-info-direct route has zero authentication on GET/POST/PUT/DELETE (full CRUD on business_info)
description: None of the four exported handlers call verifyToken/verifyTokenHybrid, check a session cookie, or check an Authorization header as a gate. Grep across the entire file confirms the only token usage is at lines 1052-1084, where an incoming bearer token is optionally forwarded to a downstream installation-closing trigger endpoint -- this is a pass-through, not an authorization check (absence of a token simply skips the trigger silently). Verified middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute() (called for all /api/* paths) only performs rate limiting, request-size validation, and CSRF checks -- it explicitly returns early for API routes and skips checkPageAuthentication() (comment at line 339: 'API 보호 통과 시 여기서 종료 (페이지 인증 체크 건너뛰기)'), so no upstream layer supplies authentication either. Additionally, csrf-protection.ts explicitly excludes this exact path from CSRF checks on the stated (and here false) assumption that the route uses 'JWT 인증' (comment: '/api/business-info-direct — 사업장 정보 직접 API (JWT 인증 사용)'), removing even that weak barrier for state-changing requests. (evidence: Direct grep for verifyToken|Authorization|authorization|requireAuth|getServerSession over the file returns only the pass-through Bearer-forwarding code at lines 1052-1084 for a downstream trigger call, not a gate on any handler. GET (line 140), PUT (line 493), POST (line 1137), and DELETE (line 1853) all begin processing the request body/query immediately with no auth check. DELETE (lines 1853-1921) soft-deletes any business_info row by id with no credential required. GET's selectFields (lines 171-252) includes greenlink_pw and all invoice/payment columns, exposed to any unauthenticated caller.)
recommendation: Add the same auth gate used elsewhere (verifyTokenHybrid/session check) to all four handlers in business-info-direct/route.ts, remove it from csrf-protection.ts's exclusion list, and regression-test every page that calls this route since it's core to business detail/list views.

title: business-invoices route has zero authentication and is actively used to read/write live payment data
description: Neither the GET handler (line 15) nor the PUT handler (line 394) checks a token, session cookie, or Authorization header anywhere in the file (confirmed by full read -- no auth-related code exists). csrf-protection.ts explicitly excludes '/api/business-invoices' from CSRF checks with the comment '계산서 조회 API (쿠키 인증)' (cookie-based auth), which is false -- no cookie is ever inspected in the route. The route is actively wired into live production code: components/business/InvoiceDisplay.tsx, components/business/InvoiceFormInput.tsx, components/business/invoices/InvoiceTabSection.tsx, app/admin/business/page.tsx, app/admin/revenue/page.tsx, and app/admin/tasks/page.tsx all reference '/api/business-invoices', confirming this is the live production path for reading/writing invoice and payment data, not dead code. (evidence: Full file read of app/api/business-invoices/route.ts (501 lines) shows GET (lines 15-388) builds and returns full invoice/payment history for any business_id passed in the query string with no auth check, and PUT (lines 394-500) directly executes an UPDATE on business_info's payment/invoice columns (lines 424-475) keyed only by a client-supplied business_id, again with no auth check. grep -rl 'business-invoices' across app/components/lib confirms 6 live-referencing files beyond the route itself.)
recommendation: Add auth checks to GET/PUT in business-invoices/route.ts and fix the false csrf-protection.ts exclusion comment; test InvoiceDisplay, InvoiceFormInput, InvoiceTabSection, admin/business, admin/revenue, and admin/tasks pages since all six actively call this route.

title: Facility/outlet delete-error rollback fetches the wrong shape and corrupts permitDetail state
description: The rollback fetch after a failed delete omits &details=true, so the API returns an array of all permits instead of one permit object; a later edit calls prev.outlets.map with no guard and throws. (evidence: deleteFacility's catch (line 1089) and deleteOutlet's catch (line 1129) both call `fetch(\`/api/air-permit?id=${urlParams.permitId}\`)`. In app/api/air-permit/route.ts GET, the single-permit branch requires `if (permitId && includeDetails)` (line 43); without `details=true` it falls through the businessId branch (skipped, no `businessId` param present) to the 'all permits' branch (lines 182-204) returning `{ data: allPermits }`, an array. `setPermitDetail(data.data)` (lines 1092, 1132) then stores an array. handleFacilityEdit's `prev.outlets.map(outlet => ...)` at line 285 has no `?.` guard — `.outlets` is undefined on an array, so `.map` throws a TypeError on the next edit.)
recommendation: Add `&details=true` to the rollback fetch URLs in both deleteFacility's and deleteOutlet's catch blocks (lines 1089 and 1129), and add an optional-chaining guard on `prev.outlets?.map` in handleFacilityEdit as defense-in-depth.

title: 결재 상세 페이지 handleSubmit()의 자체 검증 로직이 ceo role을 제외하지 않아 대표이사가 재상신을 못함
description: handleSubmit()이 lib/approval-line.ts의 getRequiredApprovalSteps()를 쓰지 않고 자체 조건식으로 재구현하는데, `role !== 'ceo'`를 어디에도 포함하지 않는다. 반면 같은 페이지에서 실제 UI 렌더링을 담당하는 ApproverSelector.tsx의 getRequiredSteps()(37-39줄)와 서버측 lib/approval-line.ts의 getRequiredApprovalSteps()(10-12줄)는 모두 `role === 'vice_president' || role === 'ceo'`일 때 세 단계 전부 불필요로 처리한다. (evidence: app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx 308-310줄: `needTeamLeader = requesterRole !== 'executive' && requesterRole !== 'team_leader' && requesterRole !== 'vice_president'` 등 3개 식 모두 'ceo' 비교 없음을 확인. lib/approval-line.ts 10-12줄과 components/approvals/ApproverSelector.tsx 37-39줄은 `role === 'vice_president' || role === 'ceo'` 조건으로 세 select를 모두 숨김을 확인. 결과: approval_role='ceo' 사용자가 상세 페이지를 열면 editTeamLeader/editExecutive/editVicePresident는 빈 문자열로 남고(select 자체가 렌더링되지 않으므로), handleSubmit()의 311줄 조건 `(needTeamLeader && !editTeamLeader) || ...`가 항상 true가 되어 '팀장, 중역, 부사장을(를) 선택해 주세요' alert만 반복되고 fetch 자체가 호출되지 않음.)
recommendation: Add `&& requesterRole !== 'ceo'` to the needTeamLeader/needExecutive/needVicePresident checks in handleSubmit() (app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx), matching the role exclusion already used in lib/approval-line.ts and ApproverSelector.tsx.

title: 신규 문서 작성 페이지 validateApprovers()도 동일하게 ceo role을 제외하지 않아 대표이사가 신규 상신을 못함
description: validateApprovers()가 getRequiredApprovalSteps()를 쓰지 않고 role 비교를 직접 나열하며 'ceo'를 제외 목록에서 빠뜨렸다. ApproverSelector가 role==='ceo'일 때 팀장/중역/부사장 select를 숨기므로 해당 ID들은 빈 값으로 남고, validateApprovers()는 이를 필수값으로 요구한다. (evidence: app/admin/approvals/new/page.tsx 216-218줄: `requesterRole !== 'executive' && requesterRole !== 'team_leader' && requesterRole !== 'vice_president' && !teamLeaderId` 등 3줄 모두 'ceo' 제외 없음을 확인. role='ceo'인 경우 teamLeaderId가 항상 빈 문자열(ApproverSelector가 숨김)이므로 첫 조건이 항상 true → '팀장을 선택해 주세요' 반환, handleSubmit()의 223-227줄에서 alert 후 즉시 return되어 handleSave()/제출 API 호출 자체가 발생하지 않음.)
recommendation: Add the same `role !== 'ceo'` exclusion to validateApprovers() in app/admin/approvals/new/page.tsx so CEO-authored documents don't require a team leader/executive/vice-president selection that the UI never renders.

title: AS 등록 모달의 사업장 검색 자동완성이 API 응답 구조 불일치로 전혀 표시되지 않음
description: GET /api/businesses?search=... 는 createSuccessResponse({businesses, count, search, metadata})로 감싸져 최종 응답이 { success, data: { businesses: [...], ... } } 형태다. searchBusiness()는 setBusinessSuggestions(json2.data || [])로 배열이 아니라 래퍼 객체 전체를 상태에 저장하므로 businessSuggestions.length는 undefined가 되어 항상 false, 드롭다운이 절대 렌더링되지 않는다. (evidence: AsRecordModal.tsx:182-185 setBusinessSuggestions(json2.data || []). app/api/businesses/route.ts:43-52 createSuccessResponse({businesses: results, count, search, metadata}) 확인. lib/api-utils.ts:55-58 createSuccessResponse가 { success:true, data: <인자> } 형태로 감싸는 것 확인. AsRecordModal.tsx:578 showSuggestions && businessSuggestions.length > 0 조건으로 렌더링 게이트됨을 확인.)
recommendation: Change `setBusinessSuggestions(json2.data || [])` to `setBusinessSuggestions(json2.data?.businesses || [])` in AsRecordModal.tsx L184 to match the actual {success,data:{businesses}} shape returned by GET /api/businesses.

title: AS건 저장 시 자재 추가/수정 API 응답을 확인하지 않아 실패해도 사용자에게 알리지 않고 모달이 닫힘
description: handleSave는 기본정보 저장(PATCH/POST /api/as-records)은 json.success를 확인해 실패 시 alert를 띄우지만, 뒤이은 자재 저장 루프는 await fetch(...) 결과를 변수에 담거나 파싱/검사하지 않는다. price_list_id가 유효하지 않아 POST가 400을 반환하거나 다른 세션에서 이미 삭제된 자재에 대한 PATCH가 404를 반환해도 무시되고 다음 자재로 넘어가며, 결국 onSave가 호출되어 모달이 성공한 것처럼 닫힌다. (evidence: AsRecordModal.tsx:417-448 for(const mat of materials){ ... await fetch(...) ... } 블록에서 POST(420-432)/PATCH(434-446) 어느 쪽도 응답을 캡처하거나 .json() 파싱, success 체크를 하지 않음을 라인 단위로 확인. /api/as-records/[id]/materials/route.ts:55-57에서 price_list_id가 유효하지 않으면 400 반환, /api/as-materials/[id]/route.ts:54-56에서 대상이 없으면 404 반환하는 실제 실패 경로가 존재함을 확인.)
recommendation: In the materials save loop (AsRecordModal.tsx L417-448), capture and parse each fetch response, collect any entries with !json.success, and if any failed show an alert and skip calling onSave() so the modal stays open for retry instead of silently closing.

title: PUT handler doesn't trim business.manufacturer before mapping it, unlike every other read path in this codebase (currently unreachable in practice because the TDZ crash above happens first, but a real, separate defect)
description: GET (line 143) does `business.manufacturer?.trim() || ''` before the MANUFACTURER_MAP lookup, and all four branches of app/api/order-management/route.ts (lines 282, 364, 416, 467) do the same trim before their own MANUFACTURER_MAP lookups. The PUT handler instead does `MANUFACTURER_MAP[business.manufacturer] || business.manufacturer as Manufacturer` with no trim at line 297. Since five other call sites in this codebase defensively trim this exact column, real business_info.manufacturer values with padding are implied to exist; for such a business, MANUFACTURER_WORKFLOWS[manufacturerKey] would be undefined and PUT would return 400 '제조사 정보가 올바르지 않습니다' even though the same business loads and displays fine via GET. Note: this line is currently unreachable in production because execution never gets past line 227's ReferenceError crash (confirmed bug above) - but it becomes an active, real bug the moment that earlier crash is fixed. (evidence: Line 143 (GET) vs line 297 (PUT) diff confirmed by direct read. app/api/order-management/route.ts lines 282, 364, 416, 467 all show `bi.manufacturer?.trim() || ''` before MANUFACTURER_MAP lookup, confirming the trim is a known necessity elsewhere in this same file/route family.)
recommendation: Add `?.trim() || ''` to `business.manufacturer` at route.ts L297 before the MANUFACTURER_MAP lookup, matching the pattern already used at L143 (GET) and in app/api/order-management/route.ts (L282/364/416/467).

title: 발주 목록의 '최종 업데이트' 표시와 정렬이 항상 깨짐 (필드명 불일치: order.updated_at 참조하지만 실제 키는 last_updated)
description: GET 핸들러의 4개 분기 모두 각 order 객체를 `last_updated: ...` 키로 생성한다 (268, 313, 374, 426, 477행에서 직접 확인). 그런데 orderList 매핑 단계(510-527행)에서 line 519가 `last_updated: order.updated_at` 로 읽는데, order 객체에는 updated_at이라는 키가 존재하지 않아 항상 undefined가 된다. node로 직접 검증한 결과 `new Date(undefined).toLocaleDateString('ko-KR')`은 'Invalid Date' 문자열을 반환하고(프런트 508/572행에서 그대로 노출), sort 콜백 `new Date(b.last_updated).getTime() - new Date(a.last_updated).getTime()`은 NaN - NaN = NaN이 되어 Array.sort가 사실상 원래 순서를 그대로 유지한다(node 실측 확인). '사업장명순'만 이 필드를 참조하지 않으므로 정상 동작한다. (evidence: route.ts 268/313/374/426/477행: 모든 order 생성 지점이 `last_updated:` 키만 사용. 519행: `last_updated: order.updated_at` (존재하지 않는 키 참조). node로 직접 실행 확인: new Date(undefined).toLocaleDateString('ko-KR') === 'Invalid Date', comparator가 항상 NaN을 반환하면 배열 순서가 원본 그대로 유지됨을 재현.)
recommendation: Change route.ts L519 from `last_updated: order.updated_at` to `last_updated: order.last_updated` to match the field actually set by all four query branches (L268/313/374/426/477), fixing both the displayed date and the '최신순'/'수정순' sort which currently no-ops on NaN comparisons.

title: url-health page crashes on load: undefined.toFixed() from missing API field
description: app/api/subsidy-crawler/url-health/route.ts's GET builds `stats` (lines 53-65) with only total_urls, healthy_urls, unhealthy_urls, avg_success_rate, avg_relevance_rate, urls_with_failures, critical_urls — avg_response_time_ms is never included. The page unconditionally renders `${data.statistics.avg_response_time_ms.toFixed(0)}ms` with no optional chaining or fallback, so on every successful load this throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed'), crashing the page (the earlier `if (!data)` early-return at line 121 does not protect this since `data` itself is populated, only the nested field is missing). (evidence: url-health/route.ts:53-65 — stats object literal has no avg_response_time_ms key. url-health/page.tsx:151 — `value={\`${data.statistics.avg_response_time_ms.toFixed(0)}ms\`}` with no guard, inside the unconditional render path after the `if (!data)` check at line 121-137 has already passed.)
recommendation: Add avg_response_time_ms to the stats object in url-health/route.ts (average healthMetrics[].avg_response_time_ms, same reduce pattern already used for avg_success_rate at line 57-59), and defensively guard the page.tsx render at line 151 with optional chaining and a fallback (e.g. `data.statistics.avg_response_time_ms?.toFixed(0) ?? '-'`) in case any row's field is null.

title: POST /api/subsidy-crawler/runs has no authentication, letting anyone fabricate crawl_runs entries
description: The POST handler reads run_id, trigger_type, github_run_id, total_batches straight from the request body and inserts a row into crawl_runs with status 'running' — there is no Authorization/CRAWLER_SECRET check anywhere in the function, unlike the main crawler's POST in app/api/subsidy-crawler/route.ts (lines 510-511) which requires `Authorization: Bearer ${CRAWLER_SECRET}`. This path also falls under middleware's '/api/subsidy-crawler' CSRF-exempt prefix. Combined with the also-unauthenticated PATCH /api/subsidy-crawler/runs/[runId] (verified separately, no auth check in that handler either), an anonymous caller can create and then mutate arbitrary crawl_runs rows, polluting the monitoring data shown on /admin/subsidy/monitoring-dashboard. (evidence: runs/route.ts:106-156 POST handler — no jwt/session/secret check anywhere before the `supabase.from('crawl_runs').insert(...)` call. Contrast with subsidy-crawler/route.ts:510-511 `if (authHeader !== 'Bearer ${CRAWLER_SECRET}') return 401`. runs/[runId]/route.ts PATCH handler (lines 106-199) similarly has no auth check before updating crawl_runs by run_id.)
recommendation: Add the same `Authorization: Bearer ${CRAWLER_SECRET}` check used in app/api/subsidy-crawler/route.ts to POST /api/subsidy-crawler/runs and PATCH /api/subsidy-crawler/runs/[runId]; the GitHub Actions callers already send this header (confirmed in subsidy-crawler-direct.yml L56-58), so no caller-side change is needed.

title: 설치비 환수(refund) API에 권한 레벨 체크가 없어 최하위 권한자도 지급 취소·차감 처리 가능
description: POST 핸들러는 토큰 유효성만 확인할 뿐(17-25행) permissionLevel 체크가 없다. 같은 디렉토리의 forecast/process, transfers, transfers/[id]/reconcile 라우트는 모두 permissionLevel < 3 체크를 갖고 있는 것과 대비된다. business_id만 있으면 해당 사업장의 paid 상태 예측마감 기록을 전부 cancelled로 바꾸고 차기월 음수 adjustment를 생성한다(49-90행). business-info-direct/route.ts가 정상 흐름으로 사용자 자신의 토큰을 실어 이 API를 호출하지만(1071-1077행), 엔드포인트 자체는 독립 노출되어 있어 permission_level 1인 직원도 유효 토큰만으로 임의 business_id를 넣어 직접 호출 가능하다. (evidence: refund/route.ts 15-33행에 permissionLevel 체크 없음(토큰 유효성만 확인). 대조: forecast/process/route.ts 35-36행, transfers/route.ts 24-25행/108-109행, transfers/[transferId]/reconcile/route.ts 27-28행 모두 permissionLevel < 3 체크 존재.)
recommendation: Add the same `permissionLevel < 3` check used in the sibling forecast/process and transfers routes to POST /api/installation-closing/refund before it processes any business_id.

title: 서브이력 PUT/DELETE 라우트가 vin과 record id의 소속 차량 일치 여부를 검증하지 않음
description: installations/[id], inspections/[id], subsidies/[id], calls/[id]의 PUT/DELETE 핸들러는 모두 .eq('id', params.id)만으로 대상을 특정하고 URL의 params.vin은 전혀 사용하지 않는다(POST 핸들러는 vin으로 차량을 조회해 vehicle.id로 insert를 스코프하지만 PUT/DELETE는 그렇게 하지 않음). 따라서 '/api/dpf/vehicles/{vinA}/installations/{idB}'처럼 vin과 id가 다른 차량에 속하더라도 서버는 이를 감지하지 못하고 그대로 수정/삭제를 수행한다. 4개 서브리소스 라우트(installations, inspections, subsidies, calls) 모두 동일한 패턴으로 확인됨. (evidence: app/api/dpf/vehicles/[vin]/installations/[id]/route.ts:25-32,44-49 (.eq('id', params.id)만 사용, params.vin 미사용), inspections/[id]/route.ts:26-33,44-49 동일 패턴, subsidies/[id]/route.ts:26-33,44-49 동일 패턴, calls/[id]/route.ts:21-28,39-44 동일 패턴; 대조: installations/route.ts POST 15-24행은 vin으로 vehicle 조회 후 vehicle.id로 스코프함.)
recommendation: In each of installations/[id], inspections/[id], subsidies/[id], calls/[id] PUT/DELETE handlers, first resolve the vehicle by params.vin (as the sibling POST handlers already do) and add `.eq('vehicle_id', vehicle.id)` to the update/delete query so a record can't be mutated via a mismatched vin.

title: Unpublished/draft wiki nodes are readable via slug lookup, bypassing is_published filter
description: The slug-lookup branch (used by /wiki/[slug]) queries wiki_nodes by slug alone with no `.eq('is_published', true)` filter and no auth check, while the tree-listing branch two lines below (line 33) does filter is_published=true, and search/route.ts line 22 also filters it. app/wiki/[slug]/page.tsx fetches `/api/wiki/nodes?slug=${slug}` directly and renders whatever comes back (only filters is_published on the `children` array for the sidebar list, not on the fetched node itself), so a caller who knows/guesses an unpublished node's slug gets its full content_md. (evidence: app/api/wiki/nodes/route.ts lines 16-27 (slug branch) vs line 33 (`.eq('is_published', true)` only in the tree-listing branch). app/wiki/[slug]/page.tsx lines 17-24 fetch by slug and set `node` directly from the response without checking `node.is_published`; only children are filtered by `c.is_published` at line 70.)
recommendation: Add `.eq('is_published', true)` to the slug-lookup query in app/api/wiki/nodes/route.ts (mirroring the tree-listing branch two lines below) so unpublished nodes 404 for normal callers; no admin preview flow currently depends on the unfiltered behavior.

title: POST /api/wiki/reindex has no auth check despite its own comment claiming 'admin only'
description: File header comment says '관리자 전용' (admin only), but the POST handler (lines 12-73) performs no JWT/session/permission check. Any unauthenticated caller can trigger a full-wiki re-embedding pass (maxDuration=300, 1s delay per chunk at line 64) that calls the paid Gemini embedding API repeatedly for every chunk of every published node. (evidence: app/api/wiki/reindex/route.ts line 2 comment vs. lines 12-14 showing POST starts directly by parsing the body with no auth check anywhere before the DB/embedding work; line 64 `await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000))` confirms the per-chunk throttle described.)
recommendation: Add the same JWT + permission-level check (reuse the pattern from guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts) at the top of the POST handler in app/api/wiki/reindex/route.ts before it starts the paid embedding pass.

title: POST /api/wiki/upload-guideline has no authentication check
description: The upload handler (lines 15-73) never checks for a session/JWT before accepting a multipart PDF upload, creating a storage bucket if missing, uploading the file, inserting a guideline_uploads row, and kicking off the async Gemini analysis (which per the bug above ends with auto-published wiki content). Any unauthenticated caller can repeatedly POST PDFs, consuming Gemini API budget with no login required. (evidence: app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts lines 15-24: POST handler reads formData and proceeds directly to bucket/storage/DB operations with no auth check anywhere in the function.)
recommendation: Add an auth/permission check (same JWT pattern as guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts) before accepting the multipart upload in app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts.

title: Unauthenticated Q&A leaks internal announcements/messages that the memo search explicitly gates behind login
description: POST /api/wiki/qa has no authentication requirement. The memo search block (lines 154-185) explicitly checks `isAuthenticated` before querying memos, with a comment stating memo content is sensitive and login-gated. Two steps later, announcements and messages are fetched unconditionally via Promise.all (lines 216-230) with no isAuthenticated check, and unconditionally folded into `boardContext` (lines 236-247) which is injected into the LLM prompt (line 289) regardless of whether the caller is logged in. (evidence: app/api/wiki/qa/route.ts lines 156-159 define `isAuthenticated` and lines 171-185 gate the memo RPC call behind `if (isAuthenticated)`. Lines 216-230 fetch `announcements` and `messages` via `Promise.all` with no such gate, and lines 236-247 build `boardContext` from that data unconditionally, then line 289 injects it into the prompt sent to the LLM regardless of auth state.)
recommendation: Wrap the announcements/messages fetch (or at minimum the boardContext assembly) in app/api/wiki/qa/route.ts inside the same `if (isAuthenticated)` gate already used for the memo search two blocks above.

title: GET /api/wiki/nodes/[id] has no auth check and no is_published filter, exposing unpublished/draft node content by ID
description: The GET handler fetches a wiki_nodes row (and its children) purely by params.id, with no auth check and no `.eq('is_published', true)` filter — a second, independent path to the same class of exposure as the slug-lookup bug, reachable by direct node UUID. (evidence: app/api/wiki/nodes/[id]/route.ts lines 12-17: `.from('wiki_nodes').select('*, children:...').eq('id', params.id).single()` — no is_published filter, no auth check anywhere in the GET function (lines 8-28).)
recommendation: Add getUserFromToken auth check plus .eq('is_published', true) to the GET query (bypassing the published filter only for permission_level>=4 editors), mirroring the fix needed for the sibling slug-lookup endpoint.

title: createTierNotification/getTierSpecificNotifications reference nonexistent 'created_by' column (should be 'created_by_id'), breaking tier-notification creation and retrieval
