description: The notifications table's creator column is created_by_id (sql/create_notifications_base_tables.sql:60, sql/notifications_schema.sql:45), and every other file in this same feature area uses created_by_id correctly (app/api/notifications/[id]/route.ts:101,207,219; app/api/notifications/cleanup/route.ts:162). But route.ts's createTierNotification() INSERT (line 614: `created_by,`) and getTierSpecificNotifications() SELECT (line 380: `created_by,`) both reference a column named `created_by` that does not exist. This is live: app/admin/notifications/page.tsx wraps its content in TierNotificationProvider and calls createNotification (POST /api/notifications with notification_tier set) on the '새 알림 생성' form, and calls refreshNotifications() on mount, which does `fetch('/api/notifications?tier=${tier}')` (TierNotificationContext.tsx:115). Both paths hit the invalid column and Postgres/PostgREST rejects the query, so creating any tier notification fails with a 500, and GET ?tier=personal|team|company also fails with a 500 instead of returning data. (evidence: route.ts:380 and :614 both use `created_by,` where the schema (sql/create_notifications_base_tables.sql:60) and sibling files ([id]/route.ts:101,207,219; cleanup/route.ts:162) consistently use `created_by_id`. git blame shows both lines introduced together in commit 3f4579f3. Reachability confirmed via app/admin/notifications/page.tsx (TierNotificationProvider + useTierNotifications) and TierNotificationContext.tsx:115,459.)
recommendation: Rename `created_by` to `created_by_id` in the SELECT at line 380 and the INSERT at line 614, matching the schema and the pattern already used consistently in [id]/route.ts and cleanup/route.ts.

title: 필터패널 '오늘/어제/이번주/이번달/지난달' 빠른 필터가 toISOString() UTC 절단으로 KST 자정~오전9시 하루 어긋남
description: 5개 빠른 필터 버튼 모두 로컬 Date 객체를 만든 뒤 .toISOString().split('T')[0]으로 날짜 문자열을 생성한다. KST 자정~오전 8:59 사이에는 UTC 날짜가 전날이므로 이 시간대에 버튼을 누르면 startDate/endDate가 실제보다 하루 이전으로 설정되어 매출/미수금/설치/영업인입 4개 차트 전체에 잘못된 기간이 전달된다. (evidence: FilterPanel.tsx L129-131: '오늘' 버튼 `const today = new Date(); const todayStr = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];`. L145-149 '어제', L163-174 '이번주', L188-197 '이번달', L210-220 '지난달' 버튼도 동일하게 Date 생성 후 toISOString()으로 절단.)
recommendation: Replace all five toISOString().split('T')[0] occurrences in FilterPanel.tsx (L129-131, 145-149, 163-174, 188-197, 210-220) with the same KST-safe date helper used to fix item 2, since each is an isolated, mechanical substitution within one file.

title: lib/auth.ts's verifyAuth()/getUser() are hardcoded stubs, breaking the live comment edit/delete feature
description: verifyAuth() unconditionally returns the primitive `true`; getUser() returns a fake user. app/api/comments/[id]/route.ts does `const { user, error: authError } = await verifyAuth() as any;` -- destructuring off `true` yields user=undefined, authError=undefined (falsy, so the auth gate silently passes), then `comment.user_id !== user.id` throws TypeError on undefined.id, caught by the outer catch and returned as a generic 500. Verified components/tasks/TaskComments.tsx:110-141 actively calls PUT/DELETE /api/comments/[commentId] from the live UI, so comment editing and deletion are completely non-functional today. Also imported identically by app/api/tasks/[id]/comments/route.ts (confirmed via grep), so the blast radius is real, not speculative. `@/lib/auth` resolves to this file (lib/auth.ts), not the sibling lib/auth/ directory, since Node's file-first resolution takes precedence and lib/auth/ has no index.ts. (evidence: lib/auth.ts:1-10 body; app/api/comments/[id]/route.ts:16,56 (destructure + user.id use); components/tasks/TaskComments.tsx:110-141 shows the live caller; grep confirmed lib/auth/ directory contains no index.ts, and only two files import '@/lib/auth' project-wide (comments/[id] and tasks/[id]/comments).)
recommendation: Replace the two stub functions in lib/auth.ts with a real check (e.g. delegate to getUserFromToken/verifyTokenHybrid in lib/secure-jwt.ts) that returns the {user, error} shape the two callers (comments/[id] and tasks/[id]/comments routes) already destructure; blast radius is just those two files and the feature is currently 100% broken so there's nothing working to regress.

title: E-PTO results filter forwards the result-name value to the external API under the bid-status query key
description: `if (pbancRsltNm) params.set('pbancSttsNm', pbancRsltNm)` sends the incoming result filter (낙찰/유찰 etc.) to the government API under the key `pbancSttsNm`, which is the bid-status field name used by the sibling bids endpoint, not a result-name parameter. parseItems() in this same file only parses `pbancRsltNm` from the XML response (never pbancSttsNm), confirming the correct upstream key should be pbancRsltNm. (evidence: Read results/route.ts line 75 and bids/route.ts line 86 side by side — bids/route.ts correctly does `params.set('pbancSttsNm', pbancSttsNm)` from its own pbancSttsNm query param, while results/route.ts reuses the same literal key 'pbancSttsNm' but feeds it the pbancRsltNm value. Confirmed via grep that app/admin/e-pto/page.tsx sends resultStatus under query key `pbancRsltNm` to this endpoint (line 408/439), and results/route.ts's own parseItems() (line 35) only ever reads `pbancRsltNm` from the XML, never pbancSttsNm.)
recommendation: Change `params.set('pbancSttsNm', pbancRsltNm)` to `params.set('pbancRsltNm', pbancRsltNm)` on line 75 to match the key parseItems() actually reads from the XML response.

title: 데이터 복구 실행 시 API 응답 필드명 불일치로 이력 배열에 undefined가 삽입되어 페이지 크래시
description: handleRestore()는 성공 응답에서 result.historyEntry를 읽어 낙관적으로 추가해둔 임시 항목을 교체하지만, 실제 API(app/api/data-history/route.ts POST)는 { message, historyId, restoredAt }만 반환하고 historyEntry 필드를 내려주지 않는다. 복구가 성공할 때마다 history 배열의 해당 항목이 undefined로 치환되고, 이후 재계산되는 stats(useMemo, h.operation 접근)와 historyWithId(useMemo, item.id 접근)가 undefined 항목에 접근하며 렌더링이 크래시된다. (evidence: handleRestore 197-199행: `setHistory(prev => prev.map(item => item.id === restoreEntry.id ? result.historyEntry : item))`를 직접 읽음. data-history/route.ts POST(66-70행)가 `{ message, historyId, restoredAt }`만 반환함을 직접 확인, historyEntry 필드 없음. stats useMemo(59-70행)가 `history.filter(h => h.operation === 'INSERT')` 형태로 h.operation에 바로 접근함을 확인, historyWithId useMemo(273-278행)가 `item.id || ...`로 item에 바로 접근함을 확인 — 두 곳 모두 undefined 항목에서 TypeError를 낼 수 있는 구조.)
recommendation: Have the POST handler in data-history/route.ts return a historyEntry object (fetch or construct the updated row) alongside message/historyId/restoredAt so handleRestore's map() doesn't insert undefined into history.

title: 공지사항 모달이 실제 로그인 사용자 대신 하드코딩된 가짜 작성자 정보를 저장함
description: handleSubmit 내부에 `const authorId = 'temp_user_id'; const authorName = '관리자';`가 하드코딩되어 있어 실제 로그인 사용자와 무관하게 모든 생성/수정 요청에 동일한 고정값이 author_id/author_name으로 전송된다(POST body: line 208-209). 동일 디렉토리의 CalendarModal.tsx는 `useAuth()`로 실제 user.id/user.name을 사용하며(line 78, 498-499), 로그인 여부까지 확인하는 것과 대비된다. 결과적으로 서로 다른 관리자가 작성해도 DB상 author_id/author_name이 구분되지 않는다. (evidence: components/modals/AnnouncementModal.tsx:195-196 authorId/authorName 하드코딩 확인, :208-209에서 그대로 POST body에 전송; components/modals/CalendarModal.tsx:78 `const { user } = useAuth();`, :498-499 `const authorId = user.id; const authorName = user.name;`로 대비되는 정상 패턴 확인)
recommendation: Import and call useAuth() in AnnouncementModal.tsx (mirroring CalendarModal.tsx) to replace the hardcoded authorId/authorName with the real logged-in user.id/name, and guard submission if the user isn't authenticated.

title: MessageModal이 실제 로그인 사용자 대신 하드코딩된 'temp_user_id'/'사용자'를 작성자로 저장
description: handleSubmit()의 create 분기에서 `const authorId = 'temp_user_id'; const authorName = '사용자';`를 그대로 POST /api/messages의 body(author_id, author_name)에 실어 보낸다. app/api/messages/route.ts:123-141의 POST 핸들러는 author_id/author_name을 필수 존재 여부만 검사하고(126행) 그대로 `INSERT INTO messages (title, content, author_id, author_name) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)`에 사용하며(134-141행), 실제 세션 사용자로 override하는 로직이 전혀 없다. MessageModal은 components/boards/MessageBoard.tsx(app/page.tsx 홈 화면에 렌더링됨)에서 실제 사용되고 있어, 홈 화면에서 전달사항을 작성하는 모든 사용자의 글이 DB상 작성자 'temp_user_id'/'사용자'로 저장된다. (evidence: MessageModal.tsx 77-79행에 `const authorId = 'temp_user_id'; const authorName = '사용자';` 하드코딩 확인, 89-90행에서 이 값을 그대로 fetch body에 포함, app/api/messages/route.ts 123-141행에서 세션/JWT 검증 없이 body의 author_id/author_name을 그대로 INSERT에 사용함을 확인.)
recommendation: Read the current user from the app's AuthContext/useAuth (already used elsewhere) and send its real id/name as author_id/author_name instead of the hardcoded 'temp_user_id'/'사용자' literals; existing rows keep the placeholder value unless separately backfilled.

title: AnnouncementModal도 동일하게 하드코딩된 'temp_user_id'/'관리자'를 작성자로 저장
description: handleSubmit()에서 `const authorId = 'temp_user_id'; const authorName = '관리자';`를 POST /api/announcements의 body로 그대로 전송한다. app/api/announcements/route.ts:88-136 POST 핸들러는 필수 필드 존재 여부만 검증 후(95행) 그대로 INSERT하며(103-110행), 실제 인증 사용자로 override하지 않는다. AnnouncementModal은 components/boards/AnnouncementBoard.tsx(app/page.tsx 홈 화면)에서 사용되므로, 공지사항을 작성하는 모든 관리자의 글이 DB상 작성자 'temp_user_id'/'관리자'로 저장되어 실제 작성자 추적이 불가능하다. (evidence: AnnouncementModal.tsx 195-196행에 하드코딩 확인, 208-209행에서 fetch body에 포함, app/api/announcements/route.ts 88-136행에서 인증/세션 검증 없이 body 값을 그대로 INSERT함을 확인.)
recommendation: Same fix as MessageModal: source author_id/author_name from the authenticated session via AuthContext instead of the hardcoded 'temp_user_id'/'관리자' literals.

title: 나이스페이 결제 거래내역 조회 API가 인증 없이 배포됨
description: 파일 상단 TODO 주석(14-16행)이 '인증 없이 결제 거래 내역을 조회할 수 있다'고 스스로 명시하는데, 실제 GET 핸들러(23-144행)에는 어떤 인증 코드도 없다. GET 요청은 middleware의 CSRF 검증에서도 safeMethods로 제외되므로(protectCSRF, GET/HEAD/OPTIONS 스킵) CSRF 토큰조차 필요 없이 누구나 결제 거래 상세를 조회할 수 있다. (evidence: app/api/nicepay/transactions/route.ts:14-16 TODO 주석과 23-144행 GET 핸들러 전체에 인증 코드 부재 확인. lib/security/csrf-protection.ts의 protectCSRF가 GET 요청을 CSRF 검증에서 제외함을 확인.)
recommendation: Add the Bearer-token + permissionLevel>=3 check exactly as the file's own TODO already specifies, mirroring app/api/admin/monthly-closing/route.ts; no active frontend caller was found, so this is a low-risk isolated change.

title: 댓글 API가 더미 verifyAuth를 사용 - GET은 인증 우회, POST는 항상 500 크래시
description: line 3에서 '@/lib/auth'를 import하는데, 이는 lib/auth.ts(디렉터리 lib/auth/middleware.ts의 실제 구현과 별개)의 더미 함수로 인자 없이 항상 true를 반환한다. GET(line 16)과 POST(line 62) 모두 `const { user, error: authError } = await verifyAuth() as any`로 boolean true를 구조분해하므로 user와 authError가 모두 undefined가 되고, `if (authError)` 체크가 항상 통과되어 GET은 어떤 토큰 없이도 댓글을 조회할 수 있다(인증 우회). POST는 이후 line 122 `user_id: user.id`에서 user가 undefined라 TypeError가 발생, 바깥 catch에 걸려 항상 500 '서버 오류가 발생했습니다'를 반환한다. 이 API를 호출하는 유일한 컴포넌트 TaskComments.tsx는 앱 어디에서도 import/렌더링되지 않아 현재 UI를 통한 정상 접근 경로는 없지만, 라우트 자체는 URL을 아는 누구나 직접 호출 가능한 live 엔드포인트다. (evidence: lib/auth.ts:1-5 `export function verifyAuth() { return true }` (인자 없음, no-op); app/api/tasks/[id]/comments/route.ts:3 `import { verifyAuth } from '@/lib/auth'` (middleware가 아닌 더미 버전); line 16,62 구조분해 결과 user/authError 모두 undefined; line 122 `user_id: user.id` → TypeError. 대조: app/api/tasks/route.ts와 app/api/tasks/[id]/route.ts는 '@/lib/auth/middleware' 또는 실제 JWT 검증을 사용해 올바르게 구현됨. TaskComments.tsx 사용처 grep 결과 없음(현재 UI에서 도달 불가).)
recommendation: Change the import from `@/lib/auth` to `@/lib/auth/middleware` in `app/api/tasks/[id]/comments/route.ts`, matching the correct pattern already used by sibling routes `tasks/route.ts` and `tasks/[id]/route.ts`.

title: 사업장명 조회 쿼리에 is_deleted 필터/정렬이 없어 이름 재사용 시 삭제된 사업장 데이터가 반환될 수 있음
description: Both GET and POST resolve the business via `SELECT ... FROM business_info WHERE business_name = $1` with no is_deleted filter and no ORDER BY, then call queryOne (lib/supabase-direct.ts:91-94, which is literally `result.rows[0] || null`). The very next query in the same GET handler (air_permit_info, line 100) correctly filters `is_deleted = false`, showing the developer knew the pattern but missed it here. supabase/migrations/20260427_business_name_partial_unique.sql confirms the DB constraint was deliberately changed to a partial unique index on business_name WHERE is_deleted = false specifically to allow reusing a soft-deleted name for a new active business. (evidence: app/api/facilities-supabase/[businessName]/route.ts lines 58-66 (GET) and 664-667 (POST) have no is_deleted filter; lib/supabase-direct.ts lines 91-94 show queryOne = rows[0] with no ordering guarantee; supabase/migrations/20260427_business_name_partial_unique.sql explicitly creates `business_info_business_name_active_unique ... WHERE is_deleted = false`, confirming duplicate names across deleted/active rows are an intended, expected state.)
recommendation: Add `.eq('is_deleted', false)` to both the GET (line ~58-66) and POST (line ~664-667) business_info lookups, matching the pattern already used one query later for air_permit_info (line 100).

title: 시설관리 정보 조회/저장 API가 business_name 조회 시 is_deleted 필터 누락
description: Both GET (`businessQuery.eq('business_name', businessName).single()`) and PUT (`updateQuery.eq('business_name', businessName)...select().single()`) omit is_deleted, unlike the partial-unique-index design (see migration above) which permits a soft-deleted and an active business_info row to share the same business_name. Supabase's `.single()` throws when more than one row matches, so this errors out for legitimately active businesses whose name was reused after a prior soft-delete. (evidence: app/api/facility-management/route.ts line 30 `businessQuery.eq('business_name', businessName)` (GET) and line 193 `updateQuery.eq('business_name', businessName)` (PUT), both followed by `.single()` with no is_deleted filter anywhere in the file.)
recommendation: Add `is_deleted = false` (or `.eq('is_deleted', false)`) to the business_name lookup in both the GET (line 30) and PUT (line 193) handlers before `.single()`.

title: Measuring-device update crashes for any business with more than one air permit
description: .maybeSingle() errors when the business_id filter matches more than one active air_permit_info row, which is a normal, supported state in this domain. (evidence: Lines 92-97: `.from('air_permit_info').select('id').eq('business_id', business_id).eq('is_deleted', false).maybeSingle()`. app/admin/air-permit/page.tsx line 1146 displays `{airPermits.length}개 대기필증` per business, and handleCreatePermit (861-950) has no duplicate-permit check, confirming multiple active permits per business are normal. When that happens, `.maybeSingle()` errors, `airPermitError` is set, and the handler returns a misleading 404 '대기필증 정보를 찾을 수 없습니다' (lines 99-102) even though permits exist, permanently blocking this endpoint (called from EstimatePreviewModal.tsx:256) for that business.)
recommendation: Replace `.maybeSingle()` with a query that accepts an explicit permit_id from the caller (EstimatePreviewModal already knows which permit it's editing) instead of matching on business_id alone, which breaks as soon as a business has more than one active permit.

title: Measuring-device update matches facilities only by facility_number across ALL outlets of a permit
description: facility_number is only unique per-outlet, but the update loop does air_permit.emission_facilities?.find(f => f.facility_number === facility.facility_number) against a flat array spanning every outlet, so it can silently write one outlet's data onto another outlet's same-numbered facility. (evidence: Lines 137-139 and 180-182 use `.find(f => f.facility_number === facility.facility_number)` against `air_permit.emission_facilities`/`prevention_facilities`, which per the `AirPermit` interface (lines 30-37) is a flat array, not grouped by outlet. app/api/create-tables/route.ts seed data (lines 86-100) confirms facility_number restarts at 1 per outlet: outlet 1 has facility_number 1-5, outlet 2 has 1-3, outlet 3 has 1-3. EstimatePreviewModal.tsx (the only caller, per grep) also builds `emission_facilities`/`prevention_facilities` as flat, non-outlet-grouped arrays (lines 25-39, 938-1030). Updating outlet 1's facility #1 will `.find()` the first array match regardless of which outlet it actually belongs to, silently overwriting the wrong facility.)
recommendation: Have EstimatePreviewModal (the only caller, per grep) send outlet_number alongside facility_number, and change the `.find()` in air-permit/update/route.ts to match on the compound (outlet_number, facility_number) key instead of facility_number alone.

title: handleSave silently swallows non-2xx responses from the air-permit PUT/POST
description: The only follow-up check on the PUT/POST response is `if (airPermitResponse && airPermitResponse.ok)` with no else branch; fetch() doesn't throw on HTTP error status so the try/catch never fires on server-side failure, leaving the user with no error feedback and unsaved edits. (evidence: Read handleSave in full (485-887): line 679 `if (airPermitResponse && airPermitResponse.ok) { ... }` closes at line 868 with no `else`/`!ok` handling anywhere in the function. The catch block (874-883) only triggers on thrown JS exceptions (e.g. network failure), which a 4xx/5xx HTTP response does not produce. On non-2xx: isSaving resets to false in `finally` (885), no toast/alert, permitDetail/originalPermitDetail are never refreshed or rolled back.)
recommendation: Add an else branch after `if (airPermitResponse && airPermitResponse.ok)` that surfaces the error response to the user (toast/alert) and keeps the form dirty, instead of silently falling through as if the save succeeded.

title: Outlet numbering collision after delete-then-add produces duplicate outlet_number in permit edit page
description: addOutlet assigns outlet_number from the current array length rather than the max existing number; deleting a middle outlet then adding a new one produces a duplicate outlet_number that collides with a still-present outlet, and the silent-save-failure bug hides the resulting DB error. (evidence: Line 966: `outlet_number: (permitDetail.outlets?.length || 0) + 1`. deleteOutlet (1099-1136) just filters the array (`prev.outlets.filter(outlet => outlet.id !== outletId)`, line 1110) with no renumbering. Scenario: outlets [1,2,3], delete #2 → array [1,3] length 2 → addOutlet assigns outlet_number=3, colliding with existing outlet #3; UI renders two '배출구 #3' cards (line 1592 confirms the render template `배출구 #{outlet.outlet_number}`). database/schema.sql:84 and database/unified-extensible-schema.sql:119 both declare `UNIQUE(air_permit_id, outlet_number)` on discharge_outlets. Combined with the already-confirmed silent-save-failure bug (handleSave), a resulting constraint violation on save gives the user no error indication.)
recommendation: Compute the new outlet_number as `Math.max(0, ...outlets.map(o => o.outlet_number)) + 1` instead of `length + 1` in addOutlet, and fix this together with item 18's silent-save-failure so a resulting UNIQUE constraint violation is no longer hidden from the user.

title: Same outlet_number collision in the 'new permit' creation modal causes partial, orphaned DB rows on save
description: addOutlet/removeOutlet in the create-permit modal use the identical array-length-based numbering bug; on submit, POST /api/air-permit inserts outlets one-by-one with no transaction, so a mid-loop unique-constraint failure leaves the air_permit_info row and earlier outlets/facilities committed despite a generic failure message. (evidence: Lines 606-620 (addOutlet: `newOutletNumber = newPermitData.outlets.length + 1`) and 623-630 (removeOutlet: plain index-based filter, no renumbering) mirror the detail-page bug. app/api/air-permit/route.ts POST (216-417) inserts air_permit_info first (267-297) then loops `for (const outlet of outlets)` issuing individual `pgQuery` INSERTs (300-364) with no surrounding transaction. lib/supabase-direct.ts exports a `transaction()` helper (line 73) that this handler never calls. A colliding outlet_number INSERT throws mid-loop; the outer catch (410-416) returns a generic 500 '대기필증 생성에 실패했습니다', but the air_permit_info row and any outlets/facilities inserted before the failure remain committed.)
recommendation: Wrap the outlet/facility insert loop in POST /api/air-permit with the existing lib/supabase-direct.ts transaction() helper so a mid-loop unique-constraint failure rolls back the whole permit, and fix addOutlet/removeOutlet in the create modal to renumber by max(outlet_number)+1 instead of array length.

title: 결재 문서 상세조회의 총무팀 폴백 접근권한 체크가 팀-부서 실제 소속관계를 검증하지 않음
description: 작성자/결재선 포함자가 아닌 사용자에 대한 폴백 체크(`mgmtMember` 쿼리)가 `JOIN teams t ON t.name = e.team`와 `JOIN departments d ON d.name = e.department`를 서로 연결 없이 각각 이름으로만 매칭한다. `t.department_id = d.id` 검증이 전혀 없어, department 조인은 사실상 아무 필터링도 하지 않는 사문화된 조인이다. 같은 파일 옆의 app/api/approvals/route.ts(68-70줄, 169-171줄)는 동일 목적의 체크에서 `JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id ... WHERE d.name = $1 AND t.name = $2`로 올바르게 부서-팀 관계를 검증하고 있어, 이 파일의 [id]/route.ts만 패턴이 다르다. (evidence: app/api/approvals/[id]/route.ts 64-77줄: `JOIN teams t ON t.name = e.team JOIN departments d ON d.name = e.department WHERE e.id = $1 AND t.is_management_support = TRUE` — t와 d 사이에 어떤 조건절도 없음을 직접 확인. 대조군인 app/api/approvals/route.ts 66-76줄, 165-176줄은 `JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id` 후 `WHERE d.name = $1 AND t.name = $2`로 정확히 검증함을 확인. 실패 시나리오: A부서의 '지원팀'(is_management_support=FALSE) 소속 직원이, 이름이 같은 B부서의 '지원팀'(is_management_support=TRUE)이 존재하면 GET /api/approvals/[id]에서 mgmtMember가 non-null이 되어 자신과 무관한 타 부서 문서(작성자 아님, 결재선 미포함)를 열람 가능.)
recommendation: Add `t.department_id = d.id` to the JOIN condition in approvals/[id]/route.ts's mgmtMember fallback query, mirroring the already-correct pattern in approvals/route.ts (JOIN departments d ON d.id = t.department_id).

title: 결재 상세 FormViewer가 commission_closing(영업비마감) 문서 유형을 처리하지 않음
description:
FormViewer의 switch문에 commission_closing case가 없어 default 분기('알 수 없는 문서 유형')로 떨어진다. app/api/commission-closing/approval/route.ts가 document_type='commission_closing'인 approval_documents를 실제 생성해 정상적으로 결재 프로세스에 태우므로, 이 문서를 받은 결재자는 상세 페이지에서 내용을 전혀 볼 수 없다. (evidence: app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx 71-111줄의 switch문에 'expense_claim'|'purchase_request'|'leave_request'|'business_proposal'|'overtime_log'|'installation_closing'|'business_trip_report'|'inspection_report' case만 있고 'commission_closing' 없음을 확인, default는 110줄 `
알 수 없는 문서 유형
`. app/api/commission-closing/approval/route.ts 1-58줄에서 document_type: commission_closing인 approval_documents가 실제로 생성되어 승인 요청에 사용됨을 확인.)
recommendation: Add a `commission_closing` case to FormViewer's switch statement in app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx, building a small viewer component for the commission_closing payload shape (mirroring installation_closing's form) so approvers can actually see the content.

title: 전결(express-approve) 처리 시 commission_closing 문서는 approve와 달리 commission_payments 상태를 자동 전환하지 않음
description: approve/route.ts는 installation_closing과 commission_closing 두 블록 모두 존재해 관련 레코드를 자동 전환하지만, express-approve/route.ts는 installation_closing 블록만 있고 commission_closing에 대응하는 commission_payments 상태 전환 블록이 없다. (evidence: app/api/approvals/[id]/express-approve/route.ts 424-444줄에 installation_closing 블록만 존재(commission_closing 언급 없음, 파일 전체 458줄에도 commission_payments 관련 코드 없음)함을 확인. 대조군 app/api/approvals/[id]/approve/route.ts 429-449줄에는 동일 목적의 commission_closing 블록이 존재해 `UPDATE commission_payments SET status='approved' ... WHERE status='pending_approval'`을 수행함을 확인. 실패 시나리오: 영업비마감 결재를 중역/부사장이 '전결'로 처리하면 approval_documents.status='approved'로 완료되지만 commission_payments.status는 'pending_approval'에 그대로 남음.)
recommendation: Copy the commission_closing → commission_payments status-transition block from approve/route.ts into express-approve/route.ts so 전결 processing also flips commission_payments.status from pending_approval to approved.

title: 자비(self_pay) 계약서 템플릿의 '페이지3' 컨테이너가 비어있어 PDF 3페이지 본문(제5~9조)이 통째로 누락/오배치됨
description:
272-273행의 `

(evidence: SelfPayContractTemplate.tsx의 div 개폐를 라인 단위로 프로그램적으로 검증: 177행
가 345행
에서야 닫히며, 그 사이 272-273행의

recommendation: Move the .page-3 wrapping div to actually enclose the 제5조~제9조 content (lines ~279-344) instead of closing it empty at line 273, and close the .page-2 div right before that content starts; re-verify contractPdfGenerator.ts's page-2/page-3 canvas capture and maxHeight scaling against the corrected markup before shipping (contract-generation output is customer-facing).

title: 협의사항(네고)이 차감이 아니라 가산되어 착공신고서 사업장 보관용 계약서 총액이 부풀려짐
description: totalSupplyAmount(72행) = government_notice_price + additional_cost + negotiation_cost, totalDeposit(78행) = depositAmountIot + additionalCostTotal + negotiationCostTotal로 negotiation_cost(할인 성격의 값)를 가산하고 있다. 반면 같은 코드베이스의 lib/receivables-engine.ts(42행 `revenue -= negotiation`)와 app/api/revenue/business-summary/route.ts(585행 `adjustedRevenue = totalRevenue + additionalCost - negotiationDiscount`)는 동일한 negotiation 값을 명확히 차감한다. ConstructionReportManagement.tsx 58행 주석에도 '협의사항 (할인)'이라 명시되어 있어 이 값이 할인액임이 확인된다. (evidence: ContractBusinessTemplate.tsx 68-78행에서 negotiationCostTotal이 totalSupplyAmount/totalDeposit에 '+'로 더해짐을 직접 확인. lib/receivables-engine.ts 39-42행과 app/api/revenue/business-summary/route.ts 584-585행에서 동일 필드가 '-'로 차감됨을 대조 확인. ConstructionReportManagement.tsx 58행 주석 '협의사항 (할인)'으로 의미 확인.)
recommendation: Change the '+' to '-' for negotiationCostTotal in both totalSupplyAmount (line 72) and totalDeposit (line 78), matching the subtraction already used in lib/receivables-engine.ts and business-summary/route.ts; this affects the printed/contracted total on a customer-facing document so cross-check a sample generated contract against the revenue-engine figure before shipping.

title: PDF 사진 리포트에서 페이지 분할 시 이미지 y좌표가 새 페이지 기준으로 리셋되지 않아 다수 사진이 페이지 밖으로 밀려 사라짐
description: calculateImagePosition(index,...)의 y좌표(41행)는 전체 누적 index 기준 row로만 계산되고 현재 페이지 내 상대 위치가 아니다. 페이지 하단 초과 시 addPage()를 호출(186-189, 236-239행)하지만 그 직후에도 동일한(이미 계산된) 큰 y값을 그대로 사용해 이미지를 그린다. row=3(13~15번째 이미지, includeUserCaption=false 기준 y=236mm)에서 페이지 브레이크가 발생하지만 y=236mm는 새 페이지에서도 여전히 유효 범위 내이나, row=4(y=288mm)부터는 이미지 높이(42mm)를 더하면 330mm로 A4 297mm를 넘어서 이미지가 페이지 밖으로 밀려 렌더링되지 않는다. (evidence: 30-44행에서 y = margin(20) + 60 + row * actualRowHeight(52 또는 58)로 계산됨을 확인. 186-189행/236-239행에서 addPage() 호출 후 x,y를 재계산하지 않고 193/243행에서 동일 y로 doc.addImage()를 호출함을 확인. row=4일 때 y=288(또는 312)이 되어 image 높이(42)를 더하면 페이지 높이(297)를 초과함을 수치로 검증.)
recommendation: In calculateImagePosition, recompute row/col relative to the current page (e.g. track imagesOnCurrentPage and reset the row counter to 0 right after each addPage() call) instead of using the global cumulative index, and add a regression check for photo reports with >12-15 images across the two callers (178-207 and 228-257) since both branches share the same off-by-page-break bug.

title: PATCH /api/subsidy-announcements has zero authentication/authorization
description: GET and PATCH both build a service-role Supabase client at module scope and PATCH never checks any session/JWT/Authorization header before applying `{status, is_read, notes}` updates keyed only by client-supplied `id`. middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute() (lines 142-223) only does rate-limiting, request-size checks, and CSRF validation for API routes — it never verifies identity, deferring that to 'the page/API level' per its own comments. Worse, middleware's CSRF exclusion list explicitly whitelists this exact path: lib/security/csrf-protection.ts lines 153-154 list '/api/subsidy-announcements' and '/api/subsidy-announcements/*' as CSRF-exempt with the comment '보조금 공고 목록 API (Supabase Admin 인증 사용)' even though no such auth actually exists in this file. The sibling app/api/subsidy-announcements/manual/route.ts by contrast verifies a JWT and employees.permission_level on every PATCH/DELETE/POST (verified lines 21-118). (evidence: route.ts:5-8 builds supabase client with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY at module scope; PATCH handler (110-166) reads body.id/status/is_read/notes and writes directly via supabase.update() with no auth check anywhere in the function. middleware.ts:142-223 protectAPIRoute only rate-limits/CSRF-checks; csrf-protection.ts:153-154 explicitly exempts '/api/subsidy-announcements' and its subpaths from even CSRF protection. Any unauthenticated fetch('/api/subsidy-announcements', {method:'PATCH', body:{id,status,notes}}) succeeds.)
recommendation: Add the same TokenManager.getToken() + Authorization Bearer header + permission_level check used for /api/subsidy-announcements/manual PATCH (already implemented in this same file at lines 356-368 and manual/route.ts lines 21-118) to both the PATCH handler in app/api/subsidy-announcements/route.ts and its two callers in app/admin/subsidy/page.tsx (lines 207-211 and ~240), and remove it from the CSRF-exempt list in lib/security/csrf-protection.ts since the exemption comment's stated justification ('Supabase Admin 인증 사용') is false — this needs coordinated frontend+backend changes but has a working precedent already in the same files.

title: Compound Korean '억+만원' budget strings are inflated ~10,000x by parseBudget/formatBudget
description: parseBudget strips all non-digit characters into one concatenated string, then if the original string contains '억' anywhere, multiplies the ENTIRE concatenated digit string by 100,000,000 without separating the '억' portion from any smaller unit like '만원'. For '3억5,000만원' (=350,000,000원), digit extraction yields '35000', and since '억' is present the function returns 35000 * 100,000,000 = 3,500,000,000,000 — off by exactly 10,000x. formatBudget then displays '35000억원' and the same wrong number drives budget sort order. (evidence: ActiveAnnouncementsModal.tsx:109-118 parseBudget — `budgetStr.replace(/[^\d]/g,'')` concatenates all digits regardless of unit boundary, then `if (budgetStr.includes('억')) return parseInt(numbers) * 100000000;` applies the multiplier to the whole concatenated number. Traced '3억5,000만원' → numbers='35000' → returns 3.5e12 instead of 3.5e8. Used at lines 284-286 for sort and lines 723/725 for display via formatBudget.)
recommendation: Rewrite parseBudget to split the string on '억' first, parse the 억-portion and the remaining 만원/원 portion separately (multiplying by 1e8 and 1e4 respectively) and sum them, then unit-test it against '3억5,000만원', '5억원', '3,500만원', and plain '원' cases before reuse.

title: formatNumber() destroys Korean compound currency units (억/만), displaying grant amounts off by orders of magnitude
description: formatNumber strips every non-digit character from the raw budget/support_amount string and re-adds a trailing '원' only if the original string contained '원' — it never converts or preserves '억'/'만' magnitude. For '5억원' (500,000,000원), `value.replace(/[^\d]/g,'')` yields only '5' (억 and other non-digit chars are discarded, not converted), and since the original contains '원' the function returns '5원', displaying 500 million won as 5 won. The identical bug is independently reimplemented in components/subsidy/AnnouncementDetailModal.tsx (lines 26-34), which additionally drops the '원' suffix entirely. Crawled/AI-extracted budget strings commonly use this compound format per the regex in fetchGECDetail's budgetPatterns (subsidy-crawler/route.ts:997, matching 백만원/억원/천만원/만원/원). (evidence: page.tsx:440-449 `formatNumber` — `numbers = value.replace(/[^\d]/g,'')` strips 억/만/원; only re-appends literal '원' text if present in source, no magnitude conversion. Used at page.tsx:824 for displaying announcement.budget. Duplicate logic at AnnouncementDetailModal.tsx:26-34, same digit-stripping with no '원' suffix restoration at all. subsidy-crawler/route.ts:997 confirms crawled budget strings use formats like '억원'/'천만원'/'만원'.)
recommendation: Replace formatNumber in page.tsx and the duplicated logic in AnnouncementDetailModal.tsx with the same compound-unit-aware Korean currency parser used to fix item 1, applied consistently in all three call sites.

title: 영업비마감 대상 조회의 미수금 계산이 추가계산서 청구금액을 기준금액에 반영하지 않아 미수금을 과소 산정함
description: computeReceivable()은 totalPayments에 extra_payment_total(추가계산서 입금액)을 더하지만(46-54행), 기준금액 contractAmount는 calculateContractAmount()로 순수 장비필드+추가공사비-협의사항으로만 계산되고 추가계산서 청구액이 전혀 반영되지 않는다(19-37, 56행). lib/receivables-engine.ts의 computeBusinessReceivableNow는 동일 상황에서 contractAmountWithExtra = contract_amount + extraSupplyTotal*1.1로 기준금액을 보정한다(154-160행). 결과적으로 추가계산서가 발행·입금된 사업장은 미수금이 실제보다 낮게 계산되고 0으로 clamp되면(64행) on_hold→eligible 자동전환(255-259행)이 조기에 발생한다. (evidence: eligible/route.ts 40-65행: totalPayments는 extraPayment 포함(42, 46-54행)하나 contractAmount(56행 calculateContractAmount, 19-37행)는 extra 계산서 미반영. receivables-engine.ts 154-160행에서 contractAmountWithExtra로 extraSupplyTotal을 명시적으로 더하는 것과 대조.)
recommendation: Replace the duplicated computeReceivable/calculateContractAmount in eligible/route.ts with a call to lib/receivables-engine.ts's computeBusinessReceivableNow (which already folds extraSupplyTotal into the base amount), consistent with the prior receivables-calculation unification.

title: Cross-meeting issue-completion propagation is dead code due to issue_content/issue_description field mismatch
description: The fallback match `issue.business_id === business_id && issue.issue_content === issue_content && issue.is_completed === false` reads issue.issue_content, but I confirmed in types/meeting-minutes.ts (line 51) that BusinessIssue objects only ever have an issue_description field — issue_content does not exist on stored records, so issue.issue_content is always undefined. The caller (app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/page.tsx line 641) always sends a non-empty issue_content string, so `undefined === '<string>'` is always false, and this OR-branch can never match. Only issue.id === issue_id can succeed, which only matches the exact record in the exact meeting being toggled. Since imported recurring issues get a brand-new random id (separate confirmed finding), the confirm() dialog's promise ('모든 회의록에서 동일한 이슈가 완료로 표시됩니다') is never fulfilled for any issue that wasn't manually toggled meeting-by-meeting. (evidence: types/meeting-minutes.ts line 51 defines only `issue_description: string` on BusinessIssue (no issue_content field exists anywhere in the type). app/api/meeting-minutes/business-issues/complete/route.ts line 130 reads `issue.issue_content` which is therefore always undefined on real records.)
recommendation: Change the fallback comparison in business-issues/complete/route.ts from issue.issue_content to issue.issue_description, but be aware this newly activates cross-meeting propagation for any matching business_id+text pair so verify it doesn't produce false-positive matches across unrelated recurring issues.

title: Edit page defines full business-issue CRUD but never renders the corresponding UI
description: handleAddBusinessIssue (412), handleRemoveBusinessIssue (426), handleUpdateBusinessIssue (437), and handleToggleComplete (450) are fully defined and businessIssues state is loaded/migrated (218, 264-282, 439), but I confirmed via grep that none of these four handlers are referenced anywhere else in the file — there is no businessIssues.map(...) render block and no button wired to any of them. The JSX only renders 기본 정보, 참석자, 안건 (908-1134), and 회의 요약 (1136-1198) sections; there is no '사업장별 이슈' section between them. Once a meeting minute with business issues is created (on the create page, which does have the full section) and saved, there is no way through the edit UI to add a new issue, fix a typo in an existing one, or remove one — the only post-save mutation path is the read-only detail page's completion-toggle checkbox. (evidence: grep of app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/edit/page.tsx for handleAddBusinessIssue/handleRemoveBusinessIssue/handleUpdateBusinessIssue/handleToggleComplete/businessIssues.map returns only their four definitions (lines 412, 426, 437, 450) with no other usages; the file's JSX (lines 682-1229) contains agenda (908-1134) and summary (1136-1198) sections directly adjacent with nothing for business issues.)
recommendation: Add a '사업장별 이슈' section to app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/edit/page.tsx JSX (mirroring the create page's business-issue list) and wire it to the already-defined handleAddBusinessIssue/handleRemoveBusinessIssue/handleUpdateBusinessIssue/handleToggleComplete handlers.

title: Legacy string `assignee` tasks get a non-UUID user_id and are silently dropped by the permission filter
description: extractAssigneeInfo() falls back to `{ userId: task.assignee, userName: task.assignee }` (lines 53-59) whenever a task's `assignees` array is missing or empty — using the employee's NAME string as userId. The permission filter for non-admins at line 338 does `reports.filter(r => r.user_id === userId)` where `userId` is the real UUID from the JWT (confirmed via lib/secure-jwt.ts:162-163, `userId: user.id`). A name string can never equal a UUID, so any report keyed this way is silently dropped for that non-admin user, showing an empty/incomplete report even though real tasks exist for them that week. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/realtime/route.ts:52-59 (string-assignee fallback sets userId=name) and :336-338 (`permissionLevel >= 3 ? reports : reports.filter(r => r.user_id === userId)`); lib/secure-jwt.ts:162-163 confirms JWT userId is the employees.id UUID, not a name.)
recommendation: In extractAssigneeInfo's no-assignees fallback, resolve the employee UUID by looking up the name against the employees table (or better, stop persisting name-only assignee fallbacks at task-write time) instead of using the name string as user_id, so the permission filter's `r.user_id === userId` comparison works correctly for affected non-admin users.

title: SQL column collision on completed_at breaks per-stage completion indicator in status_transitions
description: The statusHistories SQL is `SELECT tsh.*, ft.task_type, ..., ft.completed_at, ...` — `tsh.*` already includes task_status_history's own `completed_at` column (confirmed in sql/task_status_history.sql: 'completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ' with comment '해당 단계 완료 시각 (null이면 진행 중)'), and the same SELECT list re-selects `ft.completed_at` (facility_tasks' overall completion) unaliased afterward. node-postgres (lib/supabase-direct.ts uses `pg`'s Pool directly) maps duplicate unaliased column names to a single JS object key, with the later column in the SELECT list winning — so `h.completed_at` used at line ~267 (`completed_at: h.completed_at, is_completed: !!h.completed_at`) actually holds the task's overall completed_at, not the per-stage value from task_status_history. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/realtime/route.ts:162-164 SQL selects both `tsh.*` and unaliased `ft.completed_at`; sql/task_status_history.sql confirms the table has its own `completed_at` column; lines 266-268 consume `h.completed_at` to set `is_completed`, which node-postgres's row-object mapping will have overwritten with facility_tasks.completed_at.)
recommendation: Alias the duplicate column in the SQL (e.g. `ft.completed_at AS task_completed_at`) and update the consuming code at ~line 267 to read the aliased field for is_completed/completed_at, leaving `tsh.completed_at` (via `tsh.*`) as the per-stage value; verify no other field in `ft.*`/`tsh.*` collides the same way before shipping.

title: Back-filled tasks (created before this week, status-changed this week) get the earliest, not the latest, status of the week
description: statusHistories is fetched `ORDER BY tsh.started_at ASC` (line 170). The back-fill loop (lines 190-208) only adds a task the FIRST time its id is encountered (`!taskIds.has(h.task_id)`), and since the array is ascending, that first encounter is the earliest transition of the week, not the latest — despite the inline comment claiming it's 'the last status' ('이력의 마지막 status'). A task that moved site_survey -> document_preparation -> subsidy_payment this week but was created earlier gets back-filled with the Monday (site_survey) status instead of the true current subsidy_payment, so isTaskCompleted() wrongly excludes it from completed_tasks/completion_rate. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/realtime/route.ts:170 `ORDER BY tsh.started_at ASC`; lines 190-208 `if (!taskIds.has(h.task_id) && !h.is_deleted) { taskIds.add(...); tasks.push({..., status: h.status /* 이력의 마지막 status */ ...}) }` — first-match-wins on an ascending-ordered array captures the earliest, not latest, status.)
recommendation: Change the statusHistories query to `ORDER BY tsh.started_at DESC` (or keep ASC but overwrite on every matching id instead of skipping already-seen ones) so back-filled tasks pick up the week's latest status, not the earliest; re-verify completion_rate numbers for previously back-filled tasks after the fix.

title: 재업로드 시 이전 챕터 wiki_nodes가 정리되지 않고 그대로 게시 상태로 남음
description: createWikiNodes()는 루트 노드를 slug 기준 upsert하고 이번 분석에서 나온 챕터들만 upsert할 뿐, 같은 루트 아래 이전 업로드에서 생성됐으나 이번 분석 결과에는 없는 챕터 wiki_nodes를 삭제하거나 is_published=false로 내리는 로직이 전혀 없다. 동일 version_label로 재업로드 시 챕터 수가 줄어들면(예: 10개→8개) 구버전 chapter-9, chapter-10이 is_published:true로 영구히 남아 위키 트리·검색·AI Q&A에 계속 노출된다. (evidence: app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts lines 205-263: createWikiNodes()는 rootNode를 upsert(onConflict:'slug')한 뒤(209-221) `for (let i = 0; i < chapters.length; i++)` 루프로 이번 분석 결과 챕터만 upsert(244-255)하며, 이전 실행에서 생성된 chapter slug 목록을 조회하거나 diff 삭제/unpublish하는 코드가 파일 전체에 없다.)
recommendation: In createWikiNodes(), before upserting the new chapter set, query existing chapter wiki_nodes under the same root slug and unpublish (is_published=false) any whose slug is not in the current analysis result, rather than deleting rows outright, to avoid breaking internal references.

title: 3-tier notification filter (personal/team/company) is computed but never applied to the query
description: getTierSpecificNotifications() builds a `whereClause` string from the `tier` argument (personal → target_user_id match, team → target_team_id/target_department_id match, company → notification_tier='company') at lines 342-366, but the Supabase query built at lines 368-402 never references `whereClause` or filters on notification_tier/target_user_id/target_team_id/target_department_id at all — it only applies `.eq('user_notifications.user_id', user.id)` plus expires_at/unreadOnly filters. This is a genuine, verified dead-code defect. Note: in the current codebase this specific query also selects the nonexistent `created_by` column (see the companion finding above), so today the actual observed symptom for GET ?tier=X is an outright 500 error rather than 'all three tabs silently return identical wrong data' — but once that column bug is fixed, the tier filter will still not be applied and the three tabs will show identical, unpartitioned results. (evidence: route.ts:342-366 builds whereClause per tier; the query at :368-402 (`.eq('user_notifications.user_id', user.id).or(expires...).order(...).limit(...)`) never uses whereClause or any tier-scoping field. Confirmed live via app/admin/notifications/page.tsx → TierNotificationContext.tsx:115 GET /api/notifications?tier=personal|team|company.)
recommendation: Replace the unused string-built `whereClause` with actual Supabase query builder calls (`.eq('notification_tier', tier)` plus `.eq('target_user_id', user.id)` / `.or(team+department conditions)` / tier='company' as appropriate) so each tab is genuinely scoped; verify against the fix for the created_by column bug since both live in the same query.

title: Notification detail GET endpoint has no ownership check (IDOR) — any authenticated employee can read any other user's private notification
description: GET /api/notifications/[id] only requires a valid JWT (any active employee, any permission_level) via getUserFromToken; after that it fetches `.from('notifications').select('*, user_notification_reads!left(...)').eq('id', notificationId).single()` with no check that the notification's target_user_id/target_team_id/target_department_id/notification_tier corresponds to the requester. Any low-privilege employee who knows or enumerates another user's notification UUID can retrieve its full title/message/metadata/relatedUrl, including personal notifications addressed to admins/executives. (evidence: [id]/route.ts:49-55 only checks `if (!user) return 401` (any valid employee JWT passes); the query at :60-70 has no filter tying the row to `user.id`, `target_user_id`, or tier/team/department membership. No frontend caller of this GET was found in the repo, but the route is directly reachable via HTTP with any employee's token, independent of frontend wiring.)
recommendation: After fetching the notification, verify the requester is authorized to view it (target_user_id === user.id for personal tier, team/department membership for team tier, or notification_tier === 'company') and return 403/404 otherwise, reusing the same tier-membership logic needed for finding #8.

title: Daily monitor endpoints (GET/POST/PATCH) have zero authentication, exposing internal task data and per-user notification stats, and allow triggering RPCs
description: None of GET (risk-task overview), POST (runs check_task_deadlines RPC), or PATCH (per-user notification stats) call any auth/JWT check, and middleware.ts's protectAPIRoute (lines 142-210) only does rate-limiting, request-size validation, and CSRF — it performs no session/JWT verification for API routes. So any unauthenticated caller can GET ?details=true to read business_name/title/due_date/assignees of upcoming and overdue tasks, POST repeatedly to trigger check_task_deadlines, or PATCH with an arbitrary {userId} to read that specific employee's private notification counts/type breakdown. No frontend caller was found for this route, but as a live, deployed API route it is directly reachable over HTTP regardless of frontend usage, and no CRON_SECRET or similar gate exists in vercel.json or the route itself. (evidence: daily-monitor/route.ts has no getUserFromToken/jwt.verify call anywhere in GET (:56-126), POST (:9-53), or PATCH (:129-173). middleware.ts:142-210 (protectAPIRoute) confirmed to only perform rate limiting/CSRF/size checks for /api/* routes, not authentication. vercel.json has no cron/secret configuration referencing this route.)
recommendation: Decide whether this route is cron-only or user-facing: if cron-only, gate all three handlers behind a shared-secret header (e.g. CRON_SECRET) checked against an env var; if user-facing, add getUserFromToken() and, for PATCH, ignore the client-supplied userId and use the authenticated user's own id.

title: 기본 4주/8주 기간 계산이 toISOString() UTC 절단으로 KST 자정~오전9시 사이 하루 당겨짐
description: resolvePeriodParams의 4w/8w 분기가 `new Date()`(로컬 시각) 값을 `.toISOString().split('T')[0]`(UTC 날짜)로 변환한다. KST(UTC+9)에서 로컬 00:00~08:59 사이에는 UTC 날짜가 로컬 날짜보다 하루 이르므로 startDate/endDate가 모두 하루 당겨진다. 이 값이 각 API의 installation_date<=endDate 등 부등호 필터에 그대로 쓰이므로 실제 오늘 설치/등록된 레코드가 쿼리 결과에서 제외된다. (evidence: chart-kit.tsx L51-55: `const end = new Date(); const start = new Date(); start.setDate(start.getDate()-days); params.startDate = start.toISOString().split('T')[0]; params.endDate = end.toISOString().split('T')[0]`. toISOString()은 항상 UTC 반환. installations/route.ts L49: `AND installation_date <= $`+endDate 파라미터로 그대로 사용됨.)
recommendation: Replace the toISOString().split('T')[0] calls in chart-kit.ts L51-55 (resolvePeriodParams, shared by Revenue/Receivable/Installation/MonthlyLeads charts) with a KST-safe date formatter and verify all four consuming charts' default 4w/8w windows still align after the change.

title: resolvePeriodParams가 filters.months(최근 N개월 드롭다운)를 전혀 읽지 않아 드롭다운이 무동작
description: FilterPanel의 '최근 기간' 드롭다운(months: 3/6/12/24/36)을 바꿔도 4개 차트 컴포넌트는 반응하지 않는다. resolvePeriodParams는 filters.periodMode, startDate/endDate, year만 검사하고 filters.months는 함수 내 어디에서도 참조되지 않는다. periodMode가 'recent'이고 startDate/endDate가 없으면 각 차트 자신의 periodPreset(기본 '8w') 값에 따라 임의로 6개월/12개월만 fallback으로 사용된다. (evidence: chart-kit.tsx L27-64 함수 전체를 확인한 결과 filters.months 또는 filters?.months 참조가 존재하지 않음. L58-60: `const monthsFallback = periodPreset === '4w' || periodPreset === '6m' ? 6 : 12; params.months = String(monthsFallback);`로 filters.months 대신 로컬 periodPreset만 사용.)
recommendation: In chart-kit.ts's resolvePeriodParams (L27-64), read filters?.months and pass it through as params.months when periodMode is 'recent' with no explicit date range, instead of deriving monthsFallback from the local periodPreset alone -- verify against all 4 consuming charts since this changes actually-displayed ranges, not just formatting.

title: Kakao webhook signature verification is a stub that always returns true, and is skipped entirely when no signature header is sent
description: verifyWebhookSignature() unconditionally returns true, and is only invoked inside `if (signature && !verifyWebhookSignature(...))` -- an absent x-kakao-signature header makes signature '' (falsy), skipping the check altogether. Any anonymous POST with {event_type:'user.revoke', user_id:<any>} deletes that row from social_accounts; user.unlink flips employees.social_login_enabled to false. Downgraded from the claimed 'critical' because this data-integrity/DoS impact does not itself grant account takeover or privilege escalation, and (per separate investigation) no frontend code currently wires up any social login button, so it doesn't currently disrupt live password-based sessions -- but it remains an unauthenticated destructive write on a production table reachable by direct HTTP POST. (evidence: Lines 18-22 verifyWebhookSignature body is literally `return true;`; line 102 `if (signature && !verifyWebhookSignature(body, signature))` only runs when signature is truthy; handleUserRevoke (71-88) unconditionally deletes from social_accounts by provider_id.)
recommendation: Since no frontend social-login flow currently calls this webhook, block the endpoint outright (404/410) until real verification is designed, because Kakao's unlink callback has no documented HMAC-signature contract to trivially implement -- don't just flip verifyWebhookSignature() to a guessed check.

title: Kakao social login POST endpoint never receives or validates a state parameter (login CSRF)
description: The POST handler destructures only `{ code }` from the body; `state` is never read or checked anywhere in exchangeCodeForToken or the handler. An attacker who completes their own Kakao OAuth flow to obtain a valid code can craft an external page that auto-POSTs that code to this endpoint from a victim's browser, logging the victim's session into the attacker's Kakao-linked employee account with no CSRF token required, since this is a direct fetch/XHR from an attacker-controlled page and does not depend on any button existing inside this app's own UI. (evidence: Line 220 `const { code } = body;` is the only field destructured; grepping the whole POST handler (202-642) and exchangeCodeForToken (51-111) for `state` finds no usage at all, unlike the CSRF-relevant state check present in the Naver callback flow (sessionStorage comparison).)
recommendation: Generate and store a random state value when the Kakao login flow is initiated and validate it in this POST handler before exchanging the code, mirroring the state-check already used in the Naver flow; spans the initiating client code plus this route so needs coordinated testing, not a single isolated file.

title: Kakao/Google/Naver 'simple' callback routes create active permission_level-1 accounts with zero domain-policy check
description: createUserDirectly() in all three -simple routes (kakao-simple, google-simple, naver-simple) inserts a new employee with is_active:true, permission_level:1 whenever no existing account is found, with no query against social_auth_policies at all (confirmed via grep -- the string 'social_auth_policies' does not appear in any of the three files). This completely bypasses whatever require_admin_approval policy an admin configured for a domain via the 'proper' google/route.ts or naver/route.ts flows, which do check that table. Note this interacts with the confirmed redirect_uri domain-typo bug (below) in the same files -- if the typo'd 'bluon-iot.com' domain is not actually registered as an allowed redirect URI with the OAuth provider, the token exchange these routes depend on would fail in production regardless, which would currently mask this bypass's exploitability without eliminating the underlying code defect. (evidence: app/api/auth/social/kakao-simple/route.ts:171-195, google-simple/route.ts:160-189, naver-simple/route.ts:169-198 all set is_active:true/permission_level:1 unconditionally; `grep -n social_auth_policies` across all three files returns zero matches, versus google/route.ts:145 and naver/route.ts which do query that table before deciding auto_approve.)
recommendation: Add the same social_auth_policies lookup used in google/route.ts and naver/route.ts to all three -simple routes (kakao-simple, google-simple, naver-simple) before auto-provisioning an active employee, and first confirm via logs/telemetry whether these -simple endpoints are actually reachable in production given the separate redirect_uri typo (item 17) that may currently be masking the exposure.

title: 알림 생성 화면의 대상 사용자/팀/부서 목록이 실제 API 대신 하드코딩된 가짜 데이터
description: loadInitialData()는 실제 직원/팀/부서 API를 호출하지 않고 users=[{id:'1',name:'김철수',...}], teams=[{id:1,...}], departments=[{id:1,...}]를 그대로 setState한다(주석: '실제 구현에서는 API에서 가져와야 함'). handleCreateNotification이 이 가짜 id를 target_user_id로 그대로 createNotification()에 전달하므로, 개인 알림 기능이 실제 직원과 무관한 값을 서버로 보낸다. (evidence: 39-70행을 직접 읽음: setUsers/setTeams/setDepartments가 하드코딩된 배열이고 주석에 '실제 구현에서는 API를 통해 데이터를 가져와야 함'이라고 명시됨. 90-99행에서 createForm(target_user_id 포함)이 그대로 createNotification(createForm)에 전달되는 것을 확인함.)
recommendation: Replace the hardcoded users/teams/departments arrays in loadInitialData() with calls to the existing employees/teams/departments APIs, verifying the id/name fields match what createNotification expects.

title: 업무 담당자 변경 알림이 information_schema 존재확인 오류로 인해 항상 발송되지 않음
description: notifyTaskAssignmentChange()는 `supabase.from('information_schema.tables').select('table_name').eq('table_name', 'notifications').single()`로 notifications 테이블 존재 여부를 확인한 뒤 `if (tableExists)` 블록 안에서만 알림 insert 및 sendWebPushToUser/sendTelegramToUser를 호출한다. supabase-js의 `.from()`은 PostgREST 기본 스키마(public) 내 릴레이션만 조회하므로 'information_schema.tables'라는 이름의 테이블은 존재하지 않아 이 쿼리는 항상 오류를 반환하고 tableExists는 항상 null/undefined가 된다. 담당자 배정/재배정/해제가 발생해도 인앱/웹푸시/텔레그램 알림이 한 번도 발송되지 않는다(조직 히스토리 기록은 이 if문 밖에 있어 정상적으로 남음). 동일한 패턴이 app/api/test-database/route.ts, app/api/debug/table-info/route.ts에도 존재함을 확인. (evidence: 47-51행을 직접 읽음: `.from('information_schema.tables')...single()`. 53-120행에서 모든 알림 insert/push/telegram 호출이 `if (tableExists) { ... }` 블록 안에 있고, 122-132행의 organization_changes_detailed insert만 이 블록 밖에 있음을 확인. grep으로 app/api/test-database/route.ts, app/api/debug/table-info/route.ts에서도 동일하게 `.from('information_schema.tables'/'.columns')` 패턴이 재사용됨을 확인.)
recommendation: Remove the broken information_schema.tables existence check (supabase-js .from() can't query it) and call the notification insert/push/telegram logic unconditionally, but fix bug #16 in the same pass since enabling this dead code path will immediately expose it.

title: Estimate DELETE endpoint has no server-side permission check despite documented 'level 4+' requirement
description: The DELETE handler performs `supabase.from('estimate_history').delete().eq('id', id)` with the service-role client, with zero inspection of any auth cookie/header/token before executing. The '권한 4 이상 필요' comment on line 10 is not enforced anywhere server-side. (evidence: Read the full file: no import of any auth/JWT verification helper, no call to checkUserPermission/verifyTokenHybrid or similar, request object isn't even used to read headers/cookies. Also read middleware.ts protectAPIRoute() (lines 142-223): it only performs rate limiting, request-size validation, and CSRF token checks — it never validates authorization/permission level for any API route. So any client with a valid CSRF token (any logged-in session, or any request replayed via devtools/curl bypassing the UI's client-side `canDelete` check in EstimateManagement.tsx) can permanently delete any estimate_history row regardless of actual permission level.)
recommendation: Add a server-side permission check (verifyTokenHybrid/checkUserPermission consistent with other protected routes) requiring level 4+ at the top of the DELETE handler in app/api/estimates/[id]/route.ts before it touches the DB.

title: fetchTasks is not defined – ReferenceError crashes bulk-upload success handler and swallows duplicate-delete refresh
description: Component defines only loadTasks (line 259) and refreshTasks (line 645); no fetchTasks exists anywhere. Line 3680 (BulkUploadModal onSuccess, no try/catch) throws an uncaught ReferenceError after every successful Excel bulk upload, so the list never refreshes. Line 394 (inside deleteDuplicates, wrapped in try/catch) has the ReferenceError silently caught, causing deleteDuplicates to report success:0/failed:taskIds.length back to DuplicateTasksModal even though result.success > 0 meant the server already deleted the duplicates — UI shows delete as failed and the list is stale until manual reload. (evidence: grep across the whole file confirms no `fetchTasks` definition exists. Read lines 380-401 (deleteDuplicates: result.success>0 check at 393 then `await fetchTasks()` at 394 inside try/catch that returns `{success:0,failed:...}` on error) and lines 3674-3683 (BulkUploadModal onSuccess calling `fetchTasks()` at 3680 with no surrounding try/catch).)
recommendation: Replace both undefined fetchTasks() calls (lines 394, 3680) with refreshTasks(), which is the existing function already used elsewhere in the file for post-action refresh, and wrap the bulk-upload onSuccess call in try/catch for safety.

title: AnnouncementBoard의 하드코딩된 userLevel=3으로 작성 버튼이 항상 노출되고, 서버(API)도 Level 3 권한을 전혀 검증하지 않음
description: `const [userLevel, setUserLevel] = useState<number>(3)`로 초기화된 뒤 어디서도 갱신되지 않아 180행 `{userLevel >= 3 && (<button onClick={handleCreateClick}>작성</button>)}`이 항상 참이 되어 모든 사용자에게 작성 버튼이 노출된다. 클라이언트 문제뿐 아니라 서버도 무방비인데, app/api/announcements/route.ts POST 핸들러(88-100행)는 제목/내용/작성자 필드 존재 여부만 검사하며 role/permission_level 검증이 전혀 없다. middleware.ts의 protectAPIRoute(142-199행)도 rate limit·요청크기·CSRF만 검사할 뿐 인증/권한 검사는 페이지 라우트에만 적용되고(346-352행, checkPageAuthentication) API 라우트에는 적용되지 않는다(339-342행에서 API는 protectAPIRoute 통과 시 바로 종료). 따라서 코드 주석이 명시한 'Level 3+(SUPER_ADMIN) 쓰기 가능'이라는 정책이 클라이언트·서버 어느 쪽에서도 실질적으로 강제되지 않아, 낮은 권한의 로그인 사용자도 POST 요청으로 공지사항을 생성할 수 있다. (evidence: AnnouncementBoard.tsx 36행 `useState<number>(3)` 및 180행 `userLevel >= 3` 조건 확인. app/api/announcements/route.ts 88-100행에서 role 검증 부재 확인. middleware.ts 141-199행(protectAPIRoute: rate limit/size/CSRF만 수행)과 326-343행(API 경로는 protectAPIRoute 통과 즉시 종료, 페이지 전용 checkPageAuthentication 미적용)을 확인해 서버측 권한 검증 완전 부재를 재확인.)
recommendation: Initialize `userLevel` from the real authenticated user's permission_level via AuthContext instead of a hardcoded 3, and add a server-side `permission_level >= 3` check to the POST handler in app/api/announcements/route.ts — do both together, since a client-only fix leaves the API still open to direct calls.

title: 업무 상세조회/수정/삭제 권한 체크가 permissionLevel>=1(모든 로그인 직원)이면 무조건 통과
description: GET(hasAccess, line 153-156), PUT(canEdit, line 259-262), DELETE(canDelete, line 460-462) 모두 담당자/생성자 여부와 무관하게 `decodedToken.permissionLevel >= 1` 조건으로 통과시킨다. lib/auth/AuthLevels.ts 기준 permissionLevel 1은 AuthLevel.AUTHENTICATED, 즉 로그인한 일반 직원의 최저 레벨이므로(0=게스트만 미달) 사실상 로그인한 모든 직원이 다른 부서 업무를 열람·수정·소프트삭제할 수 있다. 같은 파일이 속한 도메인의 목록 API(app/api/tasks/route.ts GET, line 70-71)는 permissionLevel 1/2 사용자를 department_id로 제한하는 것과 명백히 대비된다. 다만 이 라우트를 호출하는 /admin/tasks/[id], /admin/tasks/[id]/edit 페이지는 사이드바 내비게이션(AdminLayout.tsx)에 링크가 없는 별도의 orphaned 서브시스템으로, task id를 직접 아는 경우에만 도달 가능하다. (evidence: app/api/tasks/[id]/route.ts:153-156 `task.assigned_to === decodedToken.userId || task.created_by === decodedToken.userId || decodedToken.permissionLevel >= 1`; 동일 패턴 line 259-262, 460-462; lib/auth/AuthLevels.ts:12 `AUTHENTICATED = 1` (일반 직원 최저 레벨); 대비 app/api/tasks/route.ts:70-71에서는 permissionLevel 1/2를 department_id로 제한.)
recommendation: Replace the blanket `permissionLevel >= 1` fallback in GET/PUT/DELETE with department-scoped access mirroring the existing list API pattern (`tasks/route.ts` GET), reserving unrestricted access for a genuinely elevated permission level.

title: Success/error feedback overwhelmingly uses blocking native alert() instead of the mounted toast system
description: react-hot-toast is globally mounted via components/providers/ClientProviders.tsx, and components/ui/Toast.tsx's own docstring states it exists to 'replace alert with a non-blocking notification' — yet per-domain audits show native `alert()` is the dominant feedback mechanism almost everywhere, and a repo-wide grep confirms 44 files under app/admin alone still call alert(). Examples: business-core hand-builds its own DOM toast via `document.createElement('div')` in BusinessContent.tsx rather than using either shared system; facility's ExportDialog uses alert() for failures; air-permit's list page (app/admin/air-permit/page.tsx) never imports Toast at all while its sibling detail page does; tasks, as-management (implicitly, no toast import anywhere in the domain), order-management, document-automation, subsidy, revenue-closing, meeting-minutes, weekly-reports (explicitly noted despite Toast/InAppNotificationToast existing in the shared library), and wiki all rely exclusively on alert(); approvals and admin-misc's dev-work-log each build their own bespoke one-off toast markup instead of reusing either shared component. The shared-ui review independently confirms Toast.tsx is used in exactly one place (air-permit-detail) and InAppNotificationToast is wired to exactly one context (notifications).
recommendation: Pick one toast system as canonical — react-hot-toast is the strongest candidate since it's already mounted app-wide with zero extra wiring — and replace alert() call sites domain by domain, starting with the highest-frequency ones (tasks, order-management, document-automation). Retire the ad-hoc DOM-toast in BusinessContent.tsx and the dev-work-log custom toast in favor of it.

title: Success/error feedback: canonical Toast/InAppNotificationToast/react-hot-toast exist but native alert() dominates almost every domain
description: The app has three legitimate toast mechanisms (components/ui/Toast.tsx, components/ui/InAppNotificationToast.tsx for the notification system, and a globally-mounted react-hot-toast in ClientProviders), yet the shared-ui audit counts 50+ native alert()/confirm() call sites across the codebase. This is visible even within a single domain: air-permit-detail/page.tsx uses components/ui/Toast for save feedback, while air-permit/page.tsx (the list page in the same domain) uses alert() exclusively for the same class of success/error messages. Nearly every other domain reviewed defaults straight to alert(): facility, tasks, approvals (which instead builds its own local useState+setTimeout toast div), as-management, order-management, document-automation, subsidy, revenue-closing, meeting-minutes, weekly-reports, wiki, dashboard, auth-session, admin-misc (dev-work-log hand-rolls its own toast), and blueon-ai-misc.
recommendation: Pick one canonical toast (components/ui/Toast.tsx, since it's already the one used successfully in air-permit-detail) as the standard for transactional success/error feedback, and replace alert() call sites domain by domain starting with air-permit/page.tsx (to fix the intra-domain inconsistency with air-permit-detail) and approvals/dev-work-log (which already built bespoke local toast logic that can be deleted in favor of the shared component).

title: Date input: canonical components/ui/DateInput.tsx has a literal duplicate elsewhere that regressed a bug fix, plus scattered native/inline reimplementations
description: components/ui/DateInput.tsx (a 3-field YYYY/MM/DD widget) is used correctly in shared/business-admin contexts and in blueon-ai-misc's CalendarModal. But document-automation ships its own app/admin/document-automation/components/DateInput.tsx — same name, same YYYY/MM/DD design, used in ConstructionReportManagement — which is missing the isInternalChange guard that the canonical version has, meaning it can reset mid-edit when the external value prop changes (a regression of a fix already present upstream). Separately, order-management's OrderDetailModal builds yet another inline 3-field year/month/day widget rather than reusing either DateInput, while RouterEditModal/RouterShippingModal in the same domain instead use raw native <input type="date">, so the domain itself is inconsistent on top of not reusing the canonical component. Nearly all other domains reviewed (business-core, air-permit, tasks, approvals, as-management, subsidy, meeting-minutes, weekly-reports, dpf, dashboard) simply use native <input type="date">/type="month"> instead of the canonical component; revenue-closing instead built a separate PaymentDateCell (createPortal-based) for its one date-picking need.
recommendation: Delete app/admin/document-automation/components/DateInput.tsx and repoint ConstructionReportManagement at components/ui/DateInput.tsx — this immediately fixes the missing isInternalChange guard rather than requiring it to be re-patched twice. Replace order-management's inline 3-field widget in OrderDetailModal with the canonical component so the domain's three modals stop disagreeing on date-input UX.

title: 시설 정보 저장 시 전체 삭제 후 재삽입으로 facility ID가 매번 바뀌어 측정기기 수정이 조용히 실패
description: POST deletes all discharge_facilities/prevention_facilities rows for the business_name (lines ~696-706: DELETE ... WHERE business_name = $1) then bulk-INSERTs new rows without ever supplying the old id, so Postgres assigns brand-new UUIDs on every save. The GET handler explicitly hands facility.id back to the client with the comment '시설 ID 추가 (측정기기 업데이트용)' at multiple points (lines 205, 244, 278, 306, 373, 387), and I confirmed app/api/facility-measurement/route.ts PUT (.eq('id', id)) and app/api/facility-detail/route.ts PUT (via DatabaseService.updateDischargeFacility/updatePreventionFacility, both using .eq('id', id)) key their updates strictly off that id. GET responses are also cached via memoryCache.set(cacheKey, resultData, 10) (10-minute TTL, line 603). (evidence: app/api/facilities-supabase/[businessName]/route.ts DELETE queries with no id preservation followed by INSERT statements that omit the id column; lib/database-service.ts updateDischargeFacility/updatePreventionFacility both do `.eq('id', id).single()`; GET response comments at lines 205/244/278/306/373/387 confirm the id is meant for later measurement-device PUT calls.)
recommendation: Replace the delete-then-bulk-insert in the POST handler with an upsert that matches existing rows by (business_name, outlet_number, facility_number) and updates in place, preserving id so measurement-device links in facility-measurement/facility-detail PUTs keep working.

title: Collection-level air-permits API (list/create) has no authentication and exposes business PII
description: GET/POST are wrapped in withApiHandler without requiresAuth, verifyToken is imported but never called, and the code comments admit auth was intentionally removed. (evidence: Line 5 imports `verifyToken` from '@/utils/auth' but it is never invoked anywhere in the file. Line 14 comment: '임시로 인증 체크 제거 (테스트용)'; line 115 comment: '인증 확인 (추후 활성화)'. lib/api-utils.ts withApiHandler (79-82) only auth-gates when `requiresAuth` is passed in options, and this file's `{ logLevel: 'info' }` options (lines 111, 167) never set it. GET with `include_business=true` joins business_info selecting manager_name/manager_contact/address (lines 43-50), so any unauthenticated caller can enumerate this PII and can also POST to create arbitrary air_permit_info rows for any business_id (lines 126-146).)
recommendation: Re-enable the already-imported but unused `verifyToken` check (the '임시로 인증 체크 제거 (테스트용)' comment at line 14 confirms it was deliberately disabled) on both GET and POST, after confirming the admin UI already sends the auth token.

title: Outlet gateway/VPN API is unauthenticated
description: GET/PUT/DELETE on discharge_outlets by outletId perform no auth check before reading or mutating gateway_number/vpn_type. (evidence: Read the full file: GET(10-52), PUT(55-129), DELETE(132-181) go straight from `params.outletId`/`request.json()` to `supabaseAdmin.from('discharge_outlets')` calls with no session/token check anywhere. Any caller who knows or enumerates an outlet UUID can reassign or null out its gateway/VPN config with an unauthenticated PUT/DELETE.)
recommendation: Add the same auth guard used in air-permit/update/route.ts to GET/PUT/DELETE in this outlet-gateway route before any gateway_number/vpn_type read or mutation is allowed.

title: Gateway assignment is stored in two different, non-synchronized places
description: This route and components/sections/EnhancedFacilityInfoSection.tsx persist gateway info into discharge_outlets.gateway_number/vpn_type columns, while app/admin/air-permit-detail/page.tsx and app/admin/air-permit/page.tsx exclusively read/write outlet.additional_info.gateway, and the actively-used PUT /api/air-permit never touches gateway_number/vpn_type at all. (evidence: sql/add_outlet_gateway_columns.sql adds `gateway_number`/`vpn_type` columns to discharge_outlets. components/sections/EnhancedFacilityInfoSection.tsx lines 110-119, 540-570 call `PUT /api/air-permits/outlets/${outletId}` reading/writing `outlet.gateway_number`/`outlet.vpn_type`. In contrast, app/admin/air-permit-detail/page.tsx's handleSave builds outlets with `additional_info: { ...outlet.additional_info, gateway: gatewayAssignments[outlet.id] }` (lines 528-541, 600) and app/admin/air-permit/page.tsx's handleCreatePermit sets `additional_info: { gateway: '' }` (line 888-890); the PUT it calls, app/api/air-permit/route.ts (lines 530-560), only ever writes `additional_info` JSON, never gateway_number/vpn_type columns. Assigning a gateway on one screen is invisible on the other.)
recommendation: Pick one canonical location for gateway assignment (recommend additional_info.gateway, since both admin pages already read/write it), migrate any existing gateway_number/vpn_type data into it, and update EnhancedFacilityInfoSection.tsx to use the same field instead of the separate columns.

title: 결재자 후보 API의 본인 제외 필터가 대표이사를 자기 문서 결재라인에서 영구히 선택 불가능하게 만듦
description: GET /api/approvals/approvers가 `AND id != $1`을 모든 role(팀장/중역/부사장/대표이사)에 무차별 적용한다. 대표이사 select는 role과 무관하게 항상 노출되고 항상 필수(submit/route.ts 183-185줄)인데, 회사에 대표이사가 1명뿐인 구성에서 그 대표이사 본인이 작성자이면 자기 자신이 제외되어 ceoList가 빈 배열이 된다. (evidence: app/api/approvals/approvers/route.ts 24-35줄: `WHERE is_active = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE AND role IN (...) AND id != $1`이 role 구분 없이 전체에 적용됨을 확인. app/api/approvals/[id]/submit/route.ts 183-185줄에서 `if (!doc.ceo_id) return '대표이사를 선택해 주세요'`로 모든 role에 대해 ceo_id가 항상 필수임을 확인. ApproverSelector.tsx 86-90줄의 '대표이사 1명이면 자동 선택' 로직도 `ceoList.length === 1` 조건이 0으로 실패해 발동하지 않음을 확인. CEO가 유일한 대표이사 계정이면 ceo_id를 채울 방법이 없어 어떤 문서도 상신 불가.)
recommendation: This needs a product decision before coding: either auto-skip/auto-fill the ceo_id slot when the requester's own role is 'ceo' (mirroring how team_leader/executive/vice_president steps are already skipped for those roles), or change the approvers API's self-exclusion to not apply to the ceo role — get sign-off on the intended behavior first, since it currently blocks all CEO submissions.

title: AS 매출관리(as-revenue)가 미등록 사업장의 delivery_date_override를 무시해 유상 건을 무상으로 계산
description: is_free/material_cost/material_revenue/revenue_adjustment/cost_adjustment CASE 식과 담당자 지급 집계 모두 ar.is_paid_override와 bi.delivery_date만 참조하고 ar.delivery_date_override는 전혀 사용하지 않는다. business_id가 없는 미등록 사업장 건에서 delivery_date_override를 과거 날짜로 입력해도 bi.delivery_date가 NULL이므로 is_free=true로 오판정되어 자재원가/매출·조정금액·인센티브가 전부 0으로 처리된다. (evidence: as-revenue/route.ts:76-83 is_free CASE, 98-141 material_cost/material_revenue CASE, 144-169 revenue_adjustment/cost_adjustment CASE, 342-356 담당자 지급 집계 CASE 모두 ar.is_paid_override와 bi.delivery_date만 검사. grep 결과 파일 전체에 'delivery_date_override' 문자열이 한 번도 등장하지 않음을 확인. 반면 as-records/route.ts:144-149의 is_paid 계산 컬럼은 is_paid_override > delivery_date_override > bi.delivery_date 순으로 폴백함을 대조 확인.)
recommendation: Extract a single reusable SQL expression implementing the is_paid_override > delivery_date_override > bi.delivery_date precedence (already correct in as-records/route.ts L144-149) and use it consistently in place of every is_free/material_cost/material_revenue/adjustment CASE and the manager-pay aggregation in as-revenue/route.ts, then re-validate historical monthly totals against as-records before shipping since this changes previously-reported financial figures.

title: 본마감 직접 처리(final/process) 시에도 예측마감 있는 사업장에서 전체금액(final)+차액(adjustment) 이중 생성
description: 기존 pending final/adjustment 레코드가 없을 때(updatedCount===0) diff.final_breakdown의 전체 현재 금액으로 final 레코드를 새로 생성(94-122행)한 뒤, diff.forecast_total > 0 && diff.diff_total !== 0 이면 diff_details의 차액만큼 adjustment 레코드까지 추가로 생성한다(125-137행). 예측 100 + final 150(전액) + adjustment 50(차액) = 300만원이 쌓여 실제 150만원과 어긋난다. 코드베이스 검색 결과 이 라우트를 호출하는 프런트엔드는 없어 현재 UI 경로에서는 미발현이지만, permission_level 3 이상 토큰으로 직접 호출 가능한 라이브 엔드포인트다. (evidence: final/process/route.ts 82-138행 확인: updatedCount===0 분기에서 94-122행 final 레코드(절대값) 생성 후 125-137행에서 diff.forecast_total>0 조건 시 adjustment(차액)까지 추가 생성. grep 결과 이 라우트를 호출하는 프런트엔드 파일 없음(자기 자신 외 참조 없음).)
recommendation: Fix in lockstep with item 9 by reusing the same corrected diff-only insert logic (this route currently has no frontend caller, so ship the shared fix first and verify this endpoint against it rather than patching independently).

title: 매출 재계산 API가 트랜잭션 없이 기존 계산 기록을 먼저 삭제한 뒤 재계산해, 실패 시 데이터가 영구 소실됨
description: 개별 재계산(186-189행 DELETE → 200-221행 fetch 재계산)과 전체 재계산(59-62행 전체 DELETE → 94-135행 배치 재계산) 모두 삭제와 재계산이 트랜잭션으로 묶여있지 않다. calculateResult.success가 false면(215-220행, 113-114행) 이미 삭제된 revenue_calculations 행은 복구되지 않고 failedBusinesses 배열에만 기록된다(122-129행). (evidence: 59-62행: 전체 DELETE 먼저 실행. 94-135행: 배치별 fetch 실패 시 failCount만 증가, 삭제된 데이터 복구 로직 없음. 186-189행: 개별 DELETE 후 200-221행에서 fetch 실패 시 500 반환하지만 삭제는 이미 커밋됨.)
recommendation: Wrap each delete-then-recalculate unit (per-business and per-batch) in a single DB transaction via lib/supabase-direct.ts's transaction() helper so a failed recalculation rolls back the delete instead of leaving revenue_calculations rows permanently missing.

title: PUT /api/meeting-minutes/business-issues/complete has no per-meeting access check before writing to other meetings
description: This handler checks only getUserFromToken() (line 74), then fetches ALL non-archived '정기회의' rows system-wide (lines 93-97, no participant/organizer filter) and writes updated content to any matching row (lines 152-160). I confirmed this file never imports lib/meeting-minutes-access.ts (no canAccessMeetingMinute/isFullAccessUser call anywhere), unlike the sibling PATCH toggle_business_issue handler in app/api/meeting-minutes/[id]/route.ts which does call canAccessMeetingMinute (line 249) before mutating. A participant of Meeting A can trigger a write into private Meeting B (which they cannot even view) simply by toggling completion on an issue in Meeting A that happens to share the same business_id/issue_description text as an issue in Meeting B. (evidence: Lines 71-80 only check getUserFromToken; lines 93-97 query with `.eq('meeting_type', '정기회의').neq('status', 'archived')` and no participant filter; lines 152-160 issue an update to every meeting.id with hasChanges=true regardless of the caller's access to that meeting.)
recommendation: Get a product decision on intended scope (should cascade-completion only touch meetings the caller can access, or is org-wide propagation by design for shared recurring issues?) before adding a canAccessMeetingMinute-based filter to the meetings this endpoint is allowed to update.

title: "완료" (completed) task definition diverges between /api/weekly-reports and /api/weekly-reports/realtime
description: route.ts classifies completed as only status==='subsidy_payment' (lines 208-210) and explicitly buckets 'document_complete' into inProgressTasks (lines 213-216); generate-all/route.ts mirrors this. realtime/route.ts's isTaskCompleted() (lines 65-71) instead treats 'document_complete', 'subsidy_payment', AND 'as_completed' all as completed. A self-pay task at status document_complete therefore shows completed/green with a higher completion_rate on /admin/weekly-reports/admin and /weekly-reports (both backed by realtime.ts) but shows in-progress/미완료 on /admin/weekly-reports/[userId] (backed by route.ts) for the same user/week. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/route.ts:208-210 `['subsidy_payment'].includes(t.status)` and :213-216 include 'document_complete' in inProgressTasks, vs app/api/weekly-reports/realtime/route.ts:65-71 `['document_complete','subsidy_payment','as_completed'].includes(task.status)`.)
recommendation: Get a product decision on whether 'document_complete' should count as completed, then make isTaskCompleted/inProgress logic identical (ideally extracted into one shared helper) across route.ts, generate-all/route.ts, and realtime/route.ts so completion_rate never disagrees by page for the same user/week.

title: Wiki 목차/서식 목록 페이지가 브라우저 anon 클라이언트로 조회하는데 RLS는 auth.role()='authenticated'를 요구해 항상 빈 결과
description: 이 앱의 로그인은 app/api/auth/login/route.ts에서 bcryptjs+jsonwebtoken으로 employees 테이블을 직접 검증하는 자체 JWT 방식이며, 코드베이스 전체에서 supabase.auth.signInWithPassword 등 Supabase Auth 세션 발급/설정(setSession, setAuth) 호출이 전혀 없다(grep 결과 0건). lib/supabase.ts의 브라우저용 supabase 클라이언트는 NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY로 생성되고 persistSession:false라서 auth.role()은 항상 'anon'이다. 그런데 wiki_read 정책(create_dpf_tables.sql 360-361행)과 form_templates_read 정책(390-391행)은 `auth.role() = 'authenticated'`를 요구한다. app/dpf/wiki/page.tsx의 loadTree()(supabase.from('wiki_nodes')...)와 forms/page.tsx의 supabase.from('form_templates')... 조회 모두 RLS에 막혀 항상 빈 배열을 받으므로, Wiki 목차는 항상 '관리자에서 지침서를 업로드하세요' 빈 상태, 서식 목록은 항상 '서식이 등록되지 않았습니다' 경고가 뜬다. (evidence: app/dpf/wiki/page.tsx:25-29 (anon 클라이언트로 wiki_nodes 조회), app/dpf/wiki/forms/page.tsx:32-36 (anon 클라이언트로 form_templates 조회), supabase/migrations/20260424_create_dpf_tables.sql:360-361/390-391 (auth.role()='authenticated' 요구), lib/supabase.ts:10-13 (persistSession:false, anon key), grep -rn 'setSession|signInWithPassword' 전체 프로젝트 → DPF/로그인 관련 매칭 없음(무관한 forgot-password/UrlDataManager만 존재).)
recommendation: Since the app uses a custom bcrypt/JWT login (not Supabase Auth sessions), don't try to satisfy the `auth.role()='authenticated'` RLS policies from the browser anon client — move wiki_nodes/form_templates reads behind a server-side API route that verifies the app's own JWT and queries with the service-role client, then update wiki/page.tsx and wiki/forms/page.tsx to call that route instead of querying Supabase directly; this is an architectural decision (RLS policy redesign vs. server-route indirection) best made alongside item 19 and the DPF auth gap in item 17.

title: 서식 작성 페이지 차량정보 자동입력이 동일한 RLS 불일치로 항상 실패
description: loadData()가 브라우저 anon 클라이언트로 supabase.from('dpf_vehicles').select('*').eq('vin', vin).single()을 호출하지만(113행), dpf_vehicles_read RLS 정책(create_dpf_tables.sql 286-287행)이 auth.role()='authenticated'를 요구하므로 위와 동일한 이유로 항상 필터링되어 vehicle이 null로 남는다. 227-232행의 `hasTemplate && !vehicle` 분기로 빠져 annex_2/annex_3/annex_6/annex_7처럼 실제 템플릿이 있는 서식에서도 '차량 데이터를 불러올 수 없습니다' 메시지만 표시된다.
