(evidence: app/dpf/wiki/forms/[code]/page.tsx:112-113 (anon 클라이언트로 dpf_vehicles 조회), 227-232 (hasTemplate && !vehicle 분기), supabase/migrations/20260424_create_dpf_tables.sql:286-287 (dpf_vehicles_read: auth.role()='authenticated').)
recommendation: Apply the same fix as item 18 to the vehicle auto-fill lookup in forms/[code]/page.tsx — move the dpf_vehicles read behind an authenticated server route rather than the anon browser client, since it hits the identical `auth.role()='authenticated'` RLS mismatch; implement together with item 18 to avoid solving the same architecture problem twice.

title: AI-analyzed guideline content is published live immediately; the 'review_needed' workflow never actually gates or resolves
description: After Gemini analysis, the guideline_uploads row status is set to 'review_needed' (line 178), but createWikiNodes() is called unconditionally right after (line 186) and upserts every chapter with `is_published: true` (lines 218, 254) — content goes live before any human reviews it. Grep across app/api/wiki confirms no code ever sets status to 'applied' or 'rejected', and app/wiki/admin/page.tsx only renders a '원본 보기' link for review_needed items with no approve/reject action — the applied/rejected entries in statusConfig (lines 110-111) are dead states. (evidence: app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts lines 177-186 (status='review_needed' then unconditional createWikiNodes call) and lines 209-219, 244-255 (`is_published: true` on both root and chapter upserts). `grep -rn "applied\|rejected" app/api/wiki/` returned no matches. app/wiki/admin/page.tsx lines 107-112 define statusConfig for applied/rejected but lines 257-264 only ever render a 'view original' link, never a status-changing action.)
recommendation: This needs a product decision: change the chapter/root upserts in upload-guideline/route.ts to `is_published: false` while status is 'review_needed', then add an approve/reject action in app/wiki/admin/page.tsx that flips nodes to is_published:true and the upload row to 'applied'/'rejected'.

title: '대기' 설치 건이 기간지정(4w/8w) 뷰에서 집계 윈도우 밖으로 스킵되어 완료율이 부풀려짐
description: installation_date가 없는 사업장은 project_year의 1월 1일을 fallbackDate로 삼아 집계 키를 계산한다(159-161행). 이 키가 aggregationData 맵에 없으면(163-166행) total/waiting 어느 쪽에도 반영되지 않고 조용히 스킵된다. 각 차트의 기본 periodPreset='8w'는 최근 약 8주 구간만 aggregationData 키로 만들어 두므로, project_year 1월 초 구간이 아닌 한 fallback 키는 항상 이 윈도우 밖에 위치한다. (evidence: installations/route.ts L154-161: installation_date 없으면 `new Date(`${projectYear}-01-01`)`로 fallbackDate 생성 후 getAggregationKey 호출. L163-166: `if (!aggregationData.has(aggregationKey)) return;`로 조용히 스킵. InstallationChart.tsx L37: `useState<PeriodPresetKey>('8w')` 기본값, chart-kit.tsx L49-56에서 8w는 최근 55일 weekly 윈도우만 생성.)
recommendation: Before touching app/api/dashboard/installations/route.ts L152-166, get a product decision on how installation_date-less '대기' sites should be represented in windowed views (e.g. an 'out-of-window' overflow bucket or making waiting totals period-independent) since this directly drives the displayed 완료율 KPI.

title: 매출 API '최근 N개월' 기본 조회에서 setMonth() day-overflow로 월 버킷이 누락되어 해당 월 매출이 통째로 사라짐
description: 월 버킷 초기화 시 date.setMonth(date.getMonth()-i)가 오늘의 day-of-month를 유지한 채 월만 뺀다. 오늘이 29~31일이고 i개월 전 달이 그보다 짧으면(2월 등) JS Date가 다음 달로 롤오버되어 monthKey가 중복 생성되고, 원래 있어야 할 달의 키는 aggregationData Map에 전혀 생성되지 않는다. 실제 집계 단계(L275)는 `if (!aggregationData.has(aggregationKey)) continue;`로 그 달의 매출/매입/이익을 전부 스킵한다. (evidence: revenue/route.ts L199-202: `const date = new Date(); date.setMonth(date.getMonth() - i); const monthKey = ...`. L275: `if (!aggregationData.has(aggregationKey)) continue;`로 스킵 확인. 예: 오늘이 8/31이면 i=2 계산 시 setMonth(5)가 '6/31' 무효 → '7/1'로 롤오버되어 monthKey가 i=1과 동일한 '연-07'로 중복, '연-06' 키는 Map에 없음.)
recommendation: Fix the duplicated date.setMonth(date.getMonth()-i) day-overflow bug in revenue/route.ts L199-202 by normalizing to day 1 first (date.setDate(1); date.setMonth(...)), and land it together with the identical fixes for items 13 and 14 so the three financial/installation dashboards don't diverge mid-rollout; test explicitly with today = 29/30/31.

title: 미수금 API '최근 N개월' 기본 조회에서 setMonth() day-overflow로 월 버킷 누락
description: revenue/route.ts와 동일한 패턴: date.setMonth(date.getMonth()-i)가 오늘의 day를 유지한 채 월만 감소시켜, 대상 월이 오늘의 day보다 짧으면 다음 달로 롤오버되어 그 달의 키가 Map에서 아예 빠진다. 이 파일은 asOf 스냅샷 방식이라, 해당 시점의 사업장은 애초에 버킷 자체가 순회 대상에서 빠지므로 그 시점의 미수금/회수금이 결과에서 통째로 누락된다. (evidence: receivables/route.ts L131-133: `const date = new Date(); date.setMonth(date.getMonth() - i); const monthKey = ...`. L179 for-loop가 aggregationData.entries()를 순회하므로 애초에 Map에 없는 월은 순회 대상에서 제외됨(installations/revenue와 동일한 근본 원인).)
recommendation: Apply the identical date.setDate(1) normalization fix as item 7 to receivables/route.ts L131-133 in the same change, since it's live financial data and the three duplicated instances (7/13/14) should not be fixed independently.

title: 설치 현황 API '최근 N개월' 기본 조회에서 setMonth() day-overflow로 월 버킷 누락
description: receivables/revenue와 동일한 코드 패턴이 존재한다. date.setMonth(date.getMonth()-i)가 day-overflow로 롤오버되면 해당 월 키가 aggregationData Map에서 빠지고, 148행 근처의 if (!aggregationData.has(aggregationKey)) return;에 걸려 그 달에 설치된 사업장(대기/진행중/완료 전체)이 차트와 요약 수치에서 사라진다. (evidence: installations/route.ts L131-133: `const date = new Date(); date.setMonth(date.getMonth() - i); const monthKey = ...` (else 분기, '최근 N개월' 모드). L163-166: `if (!aggregationData.has(aggregationKey)) { return; }`로 스킵.)
recommendation: Apply the identical date.setDate(1) normalization fix to installations/route.ts L131-133 alongside items 7 and 13, and add a regression check asserting all 12 month buckets exist for a today=29/30/31 fixture.

title: /api/departments and /api/departments/[id] compute employee counts and delete-guards from employees.department_id, while real department assignment writes employees.department (text)
description: GET builds employee_count/total_employees from an implicit `employees(id, name, email, role, is_active)` join keyed on department_id, and DELETE in departments/[id]/route.ts blocks deletion only if `employees.department_id = departmentId` finds active rows. The actual employee-edit endpoint (app/api/employees/[id]/route.ts) only ever writes the free-text `department` column (`if (department !== undefined) updateData.department = department;`), never department_id. Consistent with checkDevDepartment in dev-work-log/route.ts, which also reads the text `department` column as the real source of truth. Because normal department reassignment never populates department_id, these counts/guards are unreliable. (evidence: Read departments/route.ts lines 22-43 (implicit employees join, presumably on department_id FK) and departments/[id]/route.ts lines 136-155 (`.eq('department_id', departmentId)` delete guard). Read app/api/employees/[id]/route.ts lines 95-151: the employee update handler only sets `updateData.department` (text), never department_id. Cross-checked project memory note confirming this same dual-schema divergence was previously identified.)
recommendation: Get a product decision on which field (department_id FK vs department text) is canonical, then either backfill department_id from department on employee writes or switch the count/delete-guard queries in both departments routes to key off the text column.

title: 소셜 로그인 관리 페이지가 승인/정책 데이터를 전혀 조회하거나 처리하지 않음(전부 목업)
description: loadData()는 어떤 API도 호출하지 않고 setApprovals([]); setPolicies([]);만 실행한다(주석: 'Mock data for now since API endpoints don't exist'). handleApprovalAction과 handleCreatePolicy도 실제 API 호출 없이 loadData()를 다시 부르고 alert만 띄운다. (evidence: 62-119행을 직접 읽음: loadData()의 fetch 호출이 전무하고 주석 그대로 목업 상태임을 확인. handleApprovalAction(83-92행), handleCreatePolicy(94-119행) 모두 fetch/axios 호출 없이 즉시 alert만 띄움을 확인.)
recommendation: Treat this as an unbuilt feature: design and implement real approval/policy API endpoints and DB-backed state before wiring loadData/handleApprovalAction/handleCreatePolicy to them, since none exist today.

title: commission-closing eligible의 미수금 계산이 receivables-engine과 발산 — extra 계산서 매출 반영 누락으로 미수금 과소평가
description: computeReceivable()는 contractAmount = calculateContractAmount(row, officialPrices)만으로 기준매출을 계산하는데, 이 함수(19-37행)는 기기수량×고시가 + additional_cost - negotiation + revenue_adjustments만 반영하고 extra(추가) 계산서의 supply_amount는 전혀 더하지 않는다. 그런데 totalPayments(44-54행)에는 extraPayment(=extra_payment_total, invoice_records의 invoice_stage='extra' 입금 합계, 127행 JOIN)가 그대로 더해진다. 반면 SSOT인 lib/receivables-engine.ts의 computeBusinessReceivableNow는 extraSupplyTotal을 contractAmountWithExtra에 반영해(154-159행 `contractAmountWithExtra = contract_amount + extraSupplyTotal*1.1`) 기준금액과 입금액 양쪽 모두 extra를 포함시킨다. eligible/route.ts는 입금 쪽만 extra를 반영하므로 raw = contractAmount - totalPayments가 실제보다 작게(심하면 음수로) 나오고 Math.max(0, raw)로 0 클램프된다. (evidence: eligible/route.ts 19-37행 calculateContractAmount()는 EQUIPMENT_FIELDS×officialPrices + additional_cost - negotiation + revenue_adjustments만 계산하며 extra 관련 필드를 전혀 참조하지 않음. 42-54행에서 extraPayment는 totalPayments에 무조건 가산됨. receivables-engine.ts 147-159행과 비교하면 SSOT는 allPayments와 invoicedFallback/contractAmountWithExtra 양쪽에 extra 입금·발행액을 모두 반영하는 반면 eligible/route.ts는 입금 측에만 반영해 비대칭이 확인됨. 이 receivableAmount는 267-275행(신규 대상 eligible_new 분류)과 255-260행(on_hold→eligible 자동전환) 및 app/api/commission-closing/process/route.ts:62 `const isOnHold = (receivable_amount ?? 0) > 0;`를 통해 영업비 지급 보류 여부를 실제로 결정한다.)
recommendation: Replace the local `calculateContractAmount`/`computeReceivable` logic in eligible/route.ts with a call to the SSOT `computeBusinessReceivableNow` in lib/receivables-engine.ts so extra-invoice supply amounts are included on both the base-amount and payment side before this ships, since it currently zero-clamps understated receivables that gate 영업비 지급 보류.

title: 첨부파일 signed-url 발급 API가 대상 문서에 대한 접근 권한을 검증하지 않아 임의 문서 폴더에 스토리지 업로드가 가능함
description: POST 핸들러는 인증 토큰만 검증하고(32-40줄), body의 documentId(56줄, `const folder = documentId || temp_${userId}`)에 대해 요청자가 작성자/결재선/총무팀인지 전혀 확인하지 않은 채 Supabase Storage signed upload URL을 발급한다(59-61줄). 로그인한 임의 직원이 다른 사람의 documentId를 넘기면 그 문서의 스토리지 폴더에 파일을 직접 업로드할 수 있다. 다만 app/api/approvals/[id]/route.ts의 PUT(124줄 `if (doc.requester_id !== userId) return 403`)이 form_data.attachments 갱신 자체는 작성자 본인으로 제한하므로, 이 취약점만으로 피해 문서의 결재 화면에 첨부파일이 자동으로 표시되지는 않는다. 그러나 documentId를 아는 제3자가 임의 파일을 해당 스토리지 경로에 써넣을 수 있다는 권한 검증 누락 자체는 실재한다. 동일한 부류의 접근권한 누락이 app/api/approvals/attachments/route.ts의 POST(멀티파트 업로드, documentId 검증 없음)에도 존재한다. (evidence: signed-url/route.ts 30-61줄 전체를 확인한 결과 documentId에 대한 approval_documents 조회/권한 검사 쿼리가 전혀 없고 인증 토큰 검증(32-40줄) 이후 바로 storageClient.storage.createSignedUploadUrl(56-61줄)을 호출함을 확인. attachments/route.ts 30-46줄도 동일하게 documentId 접근권한 검사가 없음을 대조 확인. 다만 app/api/approvals/[id]/route.ts 124줄에서 PUT(form_data 갱신)은 requester_id 소유자 검증이 있어 실제 결재문서에 파일이 '첨부'되는 경로는 별도로 보호됨을 확인했으므로, 순수 스토리지 쓰기 권한 누락으로 범위를 한정.)
recommendation: Add an authorization check in the signed-url endpoint (verify requester ownership, step-approver status, or 총무팀/admin, with an explicit rule for not-yet-created `temp_` documents) before issuing the storage upload URL — needs a security/product decision since this endpoint is shared by every attachment upload across all document types.

title: Modal/dialog chrome is hand-rolled per domain instead of using components/ui/Modal
description: A canonical components/ui/Modal exists (isOpen/onClose, size presets, closeOnOverlayClick, showCloseButton, ModalActions.Cancel/Confirm, ConfirmModal helper) but the large majority of domains ignore it and hand-roll their own `fixed inset-0 ...` overlay + white panel, each reinventing backdrop opacity/blur, z-index, corner radius, and close behavior slightly differently. Concretely: business-core's BusinessDetailModal uses `bg-black bg-opacity-60 backdrop-blur-sm` with inline `zIndex: 9999`, while its own InstallationBreakdownModal in the same domain uses a separate `bg-black/50` div at `z-[70]` with no blur. air-permit's permit-delete flow uses the real ConfirmModal, but the same page's 'Add permit' form is a hand-rolled `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm` overlay with no shared base. facility's ExportDialog, tasks' create/edit modals, approvals' every confirm dialog, as-management's AsRecordModal/AsExcelUpload, order-management's OrderDetailModal/RouterAddModal/RouterEditModal, document-automation's PurchaseOrderModal/ContractPreviewModal (explicitly noted: no backdrop-click-to-close exists anywhere in that domain), subsidy's three modals (each redefining `<style jsx>` fadeIn/slideUp keyframes), revenue-closing's installation-closing/commission-closing dialogs, dashboard's two full generations of hand-rolled modals, and blueon-ai's CalendarModal (mixing backdrop-blur and solid black/70 for nested dialogs) all repeat this pattern. Only dpf (VehicleFormModal, SubRecordFormModal, plus list/detail pages) and parts of revenue-closing (revenue/page.tsx, pricing/page.tsx) actually build on the shared Modal. The shared-ui domain review confirms this directly: none of the 8 modals in components/modals/ reuse components/ui/Modal, and as a result Escape-to-close and body-scroll-lock are missing everywhere except one file (CalendarModal.tsx).
recommendation: Standardize all overlay dialogs on components/ui/Modal (dpf is the working reference implementation). Migrate the hand-rolled overlays domain by domain, starting with the highest-traffic ones (business-core, tasks, approvals, order-management), and delete the duplicated `<style jsx>` keyframe blocks in subsidy in favor of Modal's built-in transition. This also fixes the missing ESC/backdrop-click/scroll-lock behavior in one place instead of N places.

title: Modal/dialog: canonical components/ui/Modal.tsx is bypassed by hand-rolled overlay divs in nearly every domain
description: components/ui/Modal.tsx (with ModalActions and ConfirmModal) is the canonical modal, and it is used correctly in a handful of places (dpf's VehicleFormModal/SubRecordFormModal, revenue-closing's revenue/page.tsx and pricing/page.tsx, air-permit's permit-deletion ConfirmModal, admin-misc's mail viewer and data-history). But at least 12 other domains independently reimplement the same 'fixed inset-0 backdrop + centered/bottom-sheet panel' markup from scratch: business-core (BusinessDetailModal, InstallationBreakdownModal), facility (ExportDialog), air-permit's own 'add permit' modal, tasks (page.tsx create/edit, TaskMobileModal), approvals (every screen), as-management (AsRecordModal, AsExcelUpload, price-list, revenue via createPortal), order-management (all 5 modal components), document-automation (4 modal components — and page.tsx even imports ConfirmModal but never calls it, a dead import left over from an abandoned migration), subsidy (3 modal components), meeting-minutes and dashboard (all modals, falling back to window.confirm() for delete confirmations instead of ConfirmModal), and blueon-ai-misc (CalendarModal, CalendarBoard's day/filtered-events modals). The shared-ui domain review independently confirms this: all 8 modals under components/modals/ skip the canonical component entirely.
recommendation: Standardize on components/ui/Modal.tsx (+ ModalActions, ConfirmModal) for every new/edit dialog and delete-confirmation across the app. Prioritize migrating the highest-traffic offenders first: approvals (all screens use native overlays), order-management (5 modals), and document-automation (delete the dead ConfirmModal import in page.tsx and actually wire it in, then convert the other 4 modals). Replace window.confirm()/window.alert() confirmation flows in meeting-minutes, dashboard, and as-management with ConfirmModal.

title: PUT /api/facility-tasks에서 스코프 밖 변수 참조로 ReferenceError, task_type 변경 시 메모 제목 동기화가 항상 조용히 실패
description: currentCategory is declared with const inside the block `if (task_type && TASK_TYPE_TO_PROGRESS[task_type]) {...}` (lines 829-861) and referenced again at line 865, which is outside that block (same level as the if-statement, still inside the outer try). Confirmed by directly running the TypeScript compiler. (evidence: npx tsc --noEmit reproduced: app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts(865,28): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'currentCategory'. next.config.js:18 sets `typescript: { ignoreBuildErrors: true }`, so this ships to production. The throw is swallowed by the surrounding try/catch at lines 807/881 ('업무 수정은 성공했으므로 계속 진행'), so the task update itself succeeds but updateMemoTaskType() at line 867-878 never runs whenever a task's task_type is changed.)
recommendation: Hoist the currentCategory computation (declare with let) above the `if (task_type && TASK_TYPE_TO_PROGRESS[task_type])` block at line 829 so it's still in scope at line 865, then confirm with `npx tsc --noEmit`.

title: 측정기기 조회 API가 businessName→businessId 변환 시 is_deleted 필터 누락
description: When businessId is absent, GET resolves business_info by name via `.eq('business_name', businessName).single()` with no is_deleted filter, so a coexisting soft-deleted and active row with the same name causes `.single()` to error, and the handler falls back to returning an empty device list with '사업장을 찾을 수 없습니다' even though the active business has registered devices. (evidence: app/api/measurement-devices/route.ts lines 32-36: `.from('business_info').select('id').eq('business_name', businessName).single()` with no is_deleted condition.)
recommendation: Add `.eq('is_deleted', false)` to the business_info name lookup at line 32-36 before `.single()`.

title: 라우터 재고 목록 검색어에 콤마가 포함되면 PostgREST .or() 필터 구문이 깨짐
description: The `search` query param is interpolated unescaped directly into a PostgREST `.or()` filter string. Since PostgREST's or-filter syntax uses comma as the condition separator, a search value containing a comma (e.g. part of a serial number or business name) splits the filter into malformed fragments like `serial_number.ilike.%AB` and `CD%`, which PostgREST cannot parse as valid column.operator.value conditions, causing the query to error and the whole GET request to return a 500. (evidence: app/api/router-inventory/route.ts lines 97-99 (and 102-104) build `.or(\`serial_number.ilike.%${search}%,mac_address.ilike.%${search}%,imei.ilike.%${search}%...\`)` with `search` taken directly from `searchParams.get('search')` at line 61, with no escaping of comma or other PostgREST-reserved characters.)
recommendation: Strip/escape commas (and other PostgREST-reserved characters) from `search` before interpolating it into the `.or()` filter string at both call sites in this handler.

title: Creating a permit for a business other than the one currently open desyncs the detail panel
description: openAddModal never locks the modal's business selection to the currently open business, and the post-create refresh reloads permits for whichever business was picked inside the modal — leaving the header showing one business while the list underneath shows another's permits. (evidence: openAddModal (738-767) sets `business_id: ''` and resets searchTerm/selectedBusinessName, giving the modal its own independent search with no pre-fill from `selectedBusiness`. handleCreatePermit's success path (926-933) calls `await loadAirPermits(newPermitData.business_id)` — the business chosen inside the modal. The header (line 1143) reads `{selectedBusiness.business_name} - 대기필증 목록`, which is not updated to match, so after creating a permit for a different business, the header and the underlying `airPermits` list refer to two different businesses.)
recommendation: In openAddModal, pre-fill and lock business_id/business_name to the currently open selectedBusiness (or disable business switching in the create modal), and refresh the header/business context after handleCreatePermit succeeds so it stays consistent with the reloaded permit list.

title: Custom DateInput accepts invalid dates like day/month '00' as 'complete' and submits them
description: isCompleteDate only checks string length; handleMonthChange/handleDayChange clamp only the upper bound, never rejecting 0, so a date like '2024-00-00' is accepted as complete and sent to the server, which fails the INSERT with only a generic error. (evidence: Line 94-96: `isCompleteDate = (y,m,d) => y.length===4 && m.length===2 && d.length===2` — no numeric check. handleMonthChange (120-138): the clamp/pad branch is skipped only when val is exactly the single char '0' (`val !== '' && val !== '0'`); typing a second '0' makes val='00', which enters the branch, computes numVal=0 (not >12), and since length===2 sets `monthVal = '00'.padStart(2,'0')` = '00' — never rejected. handleDayChange (140-161) has the identical pattern for day. Once all three fields reach required length, `updateParentIfComplete` (99-107) fires `onChange('2024-05-00')`. The server's `validateDate` regex in app/api/air-permit/route.ts (line 250, `/^\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}$/`) also has no range check and passes it to the INSERT, which Postgres rejects, surfacing only the generic '대기필증 생성에 실패했습니다' alert.)
recommendation: In DateInput's handleMonthChange/handleDayChange, reject numVal === 0 (not just >12/>31) before padding, since DateInput is defined locally in app/admin/air-permit/page.tsx and used nowhere else, so the fix is fully contained to this one file.

title: 전자결재 공용 DOC_TYPE_LABEL에 commission_closing(영업비마감) 매핑 누락
description: 이 컴포넌트가 export하는 DOC_TYPE_LABEL은 목록 페이지의 유형 배지/필터, 상세 페이지의 타이틀·결재라인 헤더 문서명에 공통 사용되는데 commission_closing이 빠져 있다. 반면 백엔드 4개 라우트(submit/reject/approve/express-approve)의 DOC_TYPE_LABEL에는 모두 포함되어 있다. (evidence: components/approvals/ApprovalStatusBadge.tsx 31-40줄에 expense_claim부터 inspection_report까지 8종만 있고 commission_closing 없음을 확인. app/api/approvals/[id]/submit/route.ts 94-104줄과 express-approve/route.ts 75-80줄에는 `commission_closing: '영업비마감'`이 포함되어 있음을 확인. app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx가 이 DOC_TYPE_LABEL을 513줄(타이틀), 550줄(결재라인 헤더)에서 그대로 사용함을 확인.)
recommendation: Add `commission_closing: '영업비마감'` to DOC_TYPE_LABEL in components/approvals/ApprovalStatusBadge.tsx, matching the entry already present in the four backend route files.

title: AS건 수정 저장 시 굴뚝번호(chimney_number)가 매번 null로 초기화됨
description: PATCH 핸들러는 chimney_number = $14로 직접 대입하며(COALESCE 없음) 바인딩 값은 chimney_number !== undefined ? (chimney_number || null) : null이다. AsRecordModal.tsx에는 굴뚝번호 입력 UI가 없고 handleSave()의 payload에도 chimney_number 키가 전혀 없으므로, 모달을 통한 모든 저장 요청은 이 필드가 undefined로 도착해 항상 null로 덮어써진다. 엑셀 업로드로 저장된 굴뚝번호가 모달에서 다른 필드만 수정해도 사라진다. (evidence: as-records/[id]/route.ts:177 chimney_number = $14 (COALESCE 미사용, status(176)/dispatch_count(178)/manufacturer(181)는 COALESCE 사용과 대조). 200행 바인딩 로직 확인. AsRecordModal.tsx:377-398 payload 객체에 chimney_number 키가 없음을 확인. bulk-upload/route.ts:201,228에서 chimney_number가 저장됨을 확인해 모달 경유 시 덮어써짐이 실질적 데이터 손실로 이어짐을 확인.)
recommendation: Change line 177 to `chimney_number = COALESCE($14, chimney_number)`, matching the pattern already used for status/dispatch_count/manufacturer in the same UPDATE, so an omitted field from the modal preserves the existing value instead of nulling it.

title: AS 매출관리 상세 모달의 '총 원가' 컬럼이 매입 조정만 제외해 '총 매출'과 비대칭적으로 계산됨
description: 건별 내역 표에서 '총 매출' 셀은 revenue_adjustment가 이미 합산된 rec.total_revenue를 그대로 표시하지만, 바로 옆 '총 원가' 셀은 rec.total_cost - rec.cost_adjustment로 매입 조정을 다시 빼서 표시한다. 매출 쪽은 조정 포함, 원가 쪽은 조정 제외라는 비대칭 계산이며, 표시된 순이익(rec.profit)과 정확히 cost_adjustment 금액만큼 검산이 어긋난다. (evidence: revenue/page.tsx:254 fmt(rec.is_free ? rec.dispatch_revenue : rec.total_revenue) — 조정 포함. 255행 fmt(rec.total_cost - rec.cost_adjustment) — 조정 재차감. as-revenue/route.ts:204,206에서 total_cost = dispatch_cost+material_cost+cost_adjustment, profit = total_revenue - total_cost로 정의됨을 확인, 이를 근거로 255행 표시값이 실제 total_cost와 다름을 확인.)
recommendation: Change the '총 원가' cell (revenue/page.tsx L255) from `rec.total_cost - rec.cost_adjustment` to `rec.total_cost` so it mirrors the '총 매출' cell's adjustment-inclusive treatment and reconciles with rec.profit; confirm with whoever owns AS accounting which side (cost or revenue) should include adjustments before picking the fix.

title: AS 매출관리 상세 모달의 '순이익 − 담당자 지급 합계 = 회사 실수익' 표시가 실제 계산식과 불일치
description: 화면은 '순이익' 아래 '−담당자 지급'을 표시하고 구분선 뒤 '회사 실수익'을 보여줘 순이익−담당자지급=회사실수익으로 읽히도록 구성돼 있으나(662행 캡션도 동일 문구), 실제 net_profit은 profit - incentive_pay만 계산하고 dispatch_pay는 다시 빼지 않는다(이미 profit에 원가로 반영돼 있다는 설계 의도). 화면에 보이는 두 숫자(순이익, 담당자지급)를 그대로 빼면 표시된 회사 실수익과 dispatch_pay 금액만큼 차이가 난다. (evidence: revenue/page.tsx:202-218 CalcRow로 순이익 → −담당자지급 → 구분선 → 회사실수익 레이아웃 확인. 662행 '순이익 - 담당자 지급 합계' 캡션 확인. as-revenue/route.ts:241 totalManagerPay = incentivePay + dispatchPay, 254행 recNetProfit = recProfit - recIncentivePay(dispatchPay 미차감)를 확인해 표시 레이아웃과 실제 계산식의 불일치를 수치로 재현 가능.)
recommendation: Fix the display/caption (revenue/page.tsx L198-221, 662) rather than the formula: since as-revenue/route.ts intentionally does not re-subtract dispatch_pay (it's already embedded in cost), relabel the row so it reads '순이익 − 인센티브 지급 = 회사 실수익' and show dispatch_pay as a separate informational line rather than implying it's subtracted in the same equation.

title: 발주 단계 완료일 입력에서 존재하지 않는 날짜(2월 30일 등)가 JS Date 롤오버 때문에 클라이언트 검증을 통과함
description: handleDateFieldChange/handleDateFieldBlur 모두 `new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`)`를 만든 뒤 `!isNaN(date.getTime())`로만 유효성을 판단한다. node로 직접 검증한 결과 new Date('2024-02-30')는 3월 1일로 롤오버되어 유효한 Date를 반환하므로(반면 월=13처럼 범위를 벗어나면 정상적으로 Invalid Date가 됨), 사용자가 연=2024/월=02/일=30을 입력하면 경고 없이 초록 체크로 바뀌고 롤오버되지 않은 원본 문자열 '2024-02-30'이 stepDates에 그대로 저장된다. 이 값이 저장(handleSave → PUT)될 때 DATE 컬럼 UPDATE에서 거부되어 500으로 이어진다는 원 클레임의 서술은, 현재 PUT 자체가 어떤 요청이든 TDZ 크래시로 항상 500을 반환하는 별개의 더 심각한 버그로 가려져 있어 지금 이 정확한 실패 경로가 관찰되지는 않는다. 다만 클라이언트 검증이 실제로 잘못된 달력 날짜를 통과시킨다는 결함 자체는 독립적으로 유효하며, 상위 PUT 버그가 수정되면 그대로 재현된다. (evidence: OrderDetailModal.tsx lines 148-157 및 183-190 (assembled 문자열 생성 후 new Date(assembled) 기반 isNaN 검증만 수행). node로 직접 실행: new Date('2024-02-30') → Fri Mar 01 2024 (isNaN=false), new Date('2024-13-01') → Invalid Date (isNaN=true), 비대칭 검증 확인.)
recommendation: In both handleDateFieldChange and handleDateFieldBlur, after constructing the Date, verify date.getFullYear()/getMonth()+1/getDate() equal the parsed year/month/day (or use a daysInMonth(year,month) check) so a rollover like Feb 30 is rejected instead of silently accepted.

title: 착공신고서 계약서(지자체 제출용)에서 제4조 계약이행보증보험 비율이 사용자가 선택한 값과 무관하게 '10%'로 하드코딩됨
description: 제4조(239행)는 '10%의 비율로 정한다'는 고정 문자열이며 data.contract_bond_rate를 참조하지 않는다. 바로 아래 제5조(251행)는 `{data.contract_bond_rate || '5'}%`로 동적 출력한다. ConstructionReportManagement.tsx의 폼(1016-1043행)에서 5%/10% 토글로 contract_bond_rate를 선택할 수 있으므로, 5%를 선택해도 제4조는 항상 10%로 표시되어 같은 문서 내에서 제4조와 제5조가 서로 다른 비율을 표기하게 된다. (evidence: ContractGovernmentTemplate.tsx 238-239행 '10%의 비율로 정한다' 고정 문자열, 251행 `{data.contract_bond_rate || '5'}%` 동적 참조를 직접 대조 확인. ConstructionReportManagement.tsx 1023-1036행에서 handleFormChange('contract_bond_rate', '5'/'10') 토글 버튼 존재 확인.)
recommendation: Change the hardcoded '10%의 비율로 정한다' text at line 239 to interpolate {data.contract_bond_rate || '10'}% the same way line 251 (제5조) already does, so 제4조 and 제5조 stay consistent with the user's selected bond rate.

title: 사업장 보관용 계약서(ContractBusinessTemplate) 제4조 계약이행보증보험 비율도 사용자가 선택한 값과 무관하게 10%로 하드코딩됨
description: 제4조(290-292행)는 '10%의 비율로 정한다' 고정 문자열이며 data.contract_bond_rate를 참조하지 않는다. 바로 아래 제5조(300행)는 `{data.contract_bond_rate || '5'}%`로 사용자가 선택한 비율을 반영한다. ContractGovernmentTemplate.tsx(지자체 제출용)와 동일한 결함이 사업장 보관용 계약서에도 별도로 존재한다. (evidence: ContractBusinessTemplate.tsx 289-292행 '10%의 비율로 정한다' 고정 문자열과 300행 `{data.contract_bond_rate || '5'}%` 동적 참조를 직접 대조 확인.)
recommendation: Same fix as item 8 but in ContractBusinessTemplate.tsx: change the hardcoded '10%의 비율로 정한다' at line ~291 to interpolate {data.contract_bond_rate || '10'}%, consistent with 제5조 at line 300; fix both templates together since they share the same root cause.

title: 계약서 템플릿 편집기에서 보조금/자비 템플릿을 빠르게 전환하면 stale 응답이 다른 유형의 폼을 덮어쓸 수 있음
description: loadTemplate()은 [isOpen, contractType]이 바뀔 때마다 useEffect로 재호출되지만 이전 요청 취소(AbortController)나 응답이 최신 요청인지 검증하는 가드가 없다. ContractManagement.tsx에서 이 컴포넌트는 조건부 마운트가 아니라 항상 마운트된 채 isOpen/contractType props만 바뀌므로(776-784행), 보조금 편집을 열었다가 닫고 곧바로 자비 편집을 열면 두 fetch가 인플라이트로 공존할 수 있다. 응답 순서가 뒤바뀌면 헤더(122행, contractType prop 기반이라 항상 최신)는 'Self-Pay Contract Template Editor'를 보여주지만 setTemplate/setFormData는 먼저 요청했던 subsidy 응답으로 덮어써져, handleSave(87-97행)가 template.id(subsidy ID)로 PUT을 보내게 된다. (evidence: ContractTemplateEditor.tsx 41-45행 useEffect에 취소/가드 로직 없음을 확인. ContractManagement.tsx 776-784행에서 ContractTemplateEditor가 `{isTemplateEditorOpen && ...}`가 아니라 항상 렌더링되며 isOpen/contractType만 props로 바뀜을 확인(520-531행에서 두 버튼이 각각 setEditingTemplateType 후 setIsTemplateEditorOpen(true) 호출). ContractTemplateEditor.tsx 122행이 contractType prop을 직접 참조(항상 정확)하는 반면 74-97행 handleSave는 state인 template.id를 사용함을 확인.)
recommendation: Add an AbortController (or a request-id/ref guard) in ContractTemplateEditor's loadTemplate effect so a stale fetch response for the previous contractType is discarded if a newer request has since started, before setTemplate/setFormData run.

title: AI verification summary card is permanently hidden due to API/frontend field-name mismatch
description: GET's aiSummary object uses keys total_verifications, ai_verified_count, disagreement_count, agreement_rate. app/admin/subsidy/monitoring/[runId]/page.tsx declares a completely different shape (total_verified, ai_relevant, ai_irrelevant, keyword_only_match, ai_only_match, both_match, avg_confidence, total_cost_usd) and only renders the '🤖 AI 검증 요약' card when `ai_verification_summary.total_verified > 0` (line 183). Since the API response never contains a total_verified key, this is always `undefined > 0` → false, so the card never renders for any run, regardless of whether AI verification actually occurred. (evidence: runs/[runId]/route.ts:79-86 returns {total_verifications, ai_verified_count, disagreement_count, agreement_rate}. monitoring/[runId]/page.tsx:60-68 types ai_verification_summary with unrelated field names, and page.tsx:183 gates the whole section on `ai_verification_summary.total_verified > 0`, a key that is never present in the API payload.)
recommendation: Change page.tsx's ai_verification_summary type and the L183 gate to match the API's actual keys (total_verifications, ai_verified_count, disagreement_count, agreement_rate) instead of the never-present total_verified/ai_relevant fields.

title: Main crawler increments relevant_announcements for every saved record, ignoring Gemini's is_relevant verdict
description: In the GOVERNMENT_SOURCES loop, after upserting a row the code does `if (!error) { results.new_announcements++; results.relevant_announcements++; }` unconditionally, never checking `analysisResult.is_relevant` even though that value is computed and stored on the row moments earlier. The same pattern recurs for Phase 2: crawlPhase2SourceWithRetry's savedCount (line 470-471, `if (!error) { savedCount++; }`) also ignores analysisResult.is_relevant, and the caller does `results.new_announcements += savedCount; results.relevant_announcements += savedCount;` (709-710). This makes crawl_runs.relevant_announcements always equal new_announcements for both crawl paths, regardless of actual Gemini relevance verdicts. (evidence: route.ts:632-645 sets insertData.is_relevant = analysisResult.is_relevant, then the `if (!error)` block at 642-645 increments relevant_announcements without checking that flag. crawlPhase2SourceWithRetry (route.ts:460-471) sets insertData.is_relevant = analysisResult.is_relevant then savedCount++ unconditionally on successful upsert (line 470-471); caller at 709-710 adds savedCount to both new_announcements and relevant_announcements.)
recommendation: Guard both relevant_announcements++ sites (main GOVERNMENT_SOURCES loop and crawlPhase2SourceWithRetry/savedCount) with `if (analysisResult.is_relevant)` so the counter reflects Gemini's actual verdict instead of every successful save.

title: URL health statistics and pagination total are computed from the paginated page, not the full dataset
description: GET builds the query with `.range(offset, offset+limit-1)` (limit defaults to 50) without `{count: 'exact'}`, then derives all stats fields and `pagination.total` from `healthMetrics.length`/filtered lengths — i.e., from at most `limit` rows, not the true row count. The frontend at /admin/subsidy/url-health calls the endpoint without any limit param, so it always receives the default 50-row page; once direct_url_sources/vw_url_health_summary exceeds 50 rows, the stat cards and pagination silently reflect only the first 50 (sorted unhealthy-first) with no indication more rows exist. (evidence: url-health/route.ts:30-35 query uses `.range()` with no `{count:'exact'}` option; lines 53-65 compute stats from `healthMetrics.length`/`.filter().length`; line 74 sets `pagination.total: healthMetrics?.length || 0` (page size, not true count). url-health/page.tsx:65 calls fetch without a limit param, so limit defaults to 50 server-side (route.ts:26).)
recommendation: Add `{count: 'exact'}` to the Supabase query in url-health/route.ts and use the returned count for pagination.total and the aggregate stats instead of healthMetrics.length, which only reflects the current page.

title: crawlGGEEA() computes a keyword-relevance flag but never applies it, letting all announcements through unfiltered
description: Inside crawlGGEEA(), the loop computes `hasKeyword = keywords.some(...)` (line 1208) right after a comment about keyword filtering, but the following `if (id && title.length > 5 && !items.find(...))` (line 1210) that gates the push into `items` never references hasKeyword — the variable is dead code. Every sibling Phase-2 crawler (crawlGEC_Gnuboard, crawlGEC_CMS, crawlGEC_IGEC, crawlGEC_JNGEC, crawlMetroDaegu, crawlMetroGyeongbuk, crawlMetroChungnam, crawlMetroGeneric) gates the equivalent push with `isRelevantTitle(title)`, confirmed at 8 call sites (lines 1545,1626,1708,1790,1875,1950,2025,2113). GGEEA is the outlier — every announcement title on that source's news page, unrelated or not, is added, fetched, and Gemini-analyzed. (evidence: route.ts:1207-1208 computes `hasKeyword` from title text; line 1210 push condition `if (id && title.length > 5 && !items.find(i => i.id === id))` does not reference hasKeyword anywhere. Confirmed 8 other Phase-2 crawler functions use `&& isRelevantTitle(title)` in their equivalent gate (grep matches at lines 1545,1626,1708,1790,1875,1950,2025,2113), confirming GGEEA is the sole outlier missing the gate.)
recommendation: Add `&& isRelevantTitle(title)` to the item-push condition in crawlGGEEA (line 1210), matching the same gate already used by the other 8 Phase-2 crawler functions.

title: saveAnnouncements() counts duplicate/already-saved announcements toward relevant_count before checking for duplicates
description: For each crawled announcement, the code runs Gemini analysis and does `if (isRelevant) relevantCount++` (lines 283-288) BEFORE querying for an existing row with the same source_url and `continue`ing past the insert if found (lines 290-298). Since the direct-URL crawler re-runs periodically over the same registered URLs, any run that re-encounters a previously-saved relevant announcement still increments relevantCount even though zero rows are written (newCount unchanged). This value flows into the API response and crawl_logs.relevant_announcements via updateCrawlLog, misrepresenting a run with 0 new saves as having found N 'relevant' announcements. (evidence: direct/route.ts:283-288 increments relevantCount immediately after Gemini analysis; lines 290-298 perform the dedup check and `continue` (skipping newCount increment) only afterward — relevantCount is never decremented or guarded for the duplicate case. Line 342 returns relevant_count=relevantCount; caller (line 616) accumulates totalRelevantAnnouncements and updateCrawlLog (line 386,651) persists it to crawl_logs.relevant_announcements.)
recommendation: Move the source_url duplicate-check (and its `continue`) before the Gemini relevance analysis and relevantCount++ in saveAnnouncements, so duplicates are skipped before being counted (and before spending a Gemini call).

title: 송금건 매칭 상세 조회 API가 권한 레벨을 검증하지 않아 낮은 권한자도 사업장별 지급액 열람 가능
description: GET 핸들러는 토큰 유효성만 확인하고(17-25행) permissionLevel 체크가 없다. 형제 라우트 transfers/route.ts GET/POST, transfers/[id]/reconcile PUT은 모두 permissionLevel < 3을 요구한다. 결과적으로 권한 레벨 1~2 직원도 유효 토큰만 있으면 특정 송금건에 매칭된 사업장명, 영업점, 실지급액을 조회할 수 있다. (evidence: transfers/[transferId]/payments/route.ts 17-27행에 permissionLevel 체크 부재. transfers/route.ts 24-25행/108-109행에 동일 체크 존재하는 것과 대비.)
recommendation: Add the same `permissionLevel < 3` check used in transfers/route.ts and transfers/[id]/reconcile to GET /api/installation-closing/transfers/[transferId]/payments.

title: GET /api/meeting-templates/[id] has no privacy check despite claiming RLS handles it
description: The comment at line 81 claims '템플릿 조회 (RLS로 권한 자동 체크)' (access auto-checked via RLS), but the query uses the service-role Supabase client created at module scope (line 13: `createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey)`), which bypasses RLS entirely. There is no is_public/created_by check in code. Any authenticated user who knows or guesses a template UUID can fetch a private template's full contents regardless of ownership. (evidence: Line 13 constructs the client with supabaseServiceKey (service role, bypasses RLS). Lines 82-93 select the row by id with no is_public/created_by predicate and no post-fetch ownership check before returning it in the response.)
recommendation: After fetching the template in meeting-templates/[id]/route.ts GET, add an explicit `if (!template.is_public && template.created_by !== user.id) return 404` check since the service-role client bypasses RLS.

title: PUT /api/meeting-minutes/[id] spreads the raw request body into the update with no field whitelist
description: `const updateData: any = { ...body, updated_by: user.id }` spreads the entire parsed JSON body verbatim into the Supabase update. Unlike POST /api/meeting-minutes (field-by-field construction, per the sibling file pattern) and the /sections PATCH endpoint (which whitelists fields per section, see sections/route.ts's explicit destructuring in each case block), this PUT accepts any key the client sends since UpdateMeetingMinuteRequest is a compile-time-only TypeScript type with no runtime validation. A user who already passes canAccessMeetingMinute for one meeting (line 154) can include extra fields like created_by, created_at, or id in the body and have them written straight to the row. (evidence: Lines 161-167: `const body: UpdateMeetingMinuteRequest = await request.json(); const updateData: any = { ...body, updated_by: user.id }` — no field allowlist is applied before this object is passed to `.update(updateData)` at line 171.)
recommendation: Replace `{ ...body, updated_by: user.id }` in meeting-minutes/[id]/route.ts PUT with an explicit field allowlist (title, meeting_date, meeting_type, location, etc.); no frontend currently calls this PUT endpoint so the change is safe to make immediately.

title: Imported recurring business issues get a new random id, breaking already-added de-duplication and allowing duplicate imports
description: handleAddAllToMeeting (100-142) and handleAddToMeeting (144-178) build the new BusinessIssue with `id: crypto.randomUUID()` (lines 123, 164) instead of reusing the original recurring issue's id, in contrast to the agenda_item branch which correctly reuses `id: issue.id` (lines 106, 146). The parent page (app/admin/meeting-minutes/create/page.tsx line 502) passes `addedIssueIds={businessIssues.map(issue => issue.id)}` back into the panel, and the panel filters with `!addedIssueIds.includes(issue.id)` (line 52) comparing against the ORIGINAL recurring-issue id. Since the imported copy has a different random id, it's never present in addedIssueIds, so the panel never removes the already-imported issue from its own list — clicking '이슈 가져오기' twice on the same card produces two duplicate BusinessIssue entries. (evidence: RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx line 123 (`id: crypto.randomUUID()`) and line 164 (same) for the business-issue branch, vs line 106/146 (`id: issue.id`) for the agenda_item branch; filter at line 52 (`!addedIssueIds.includes(issue.id)`); create/page.tsx line 502 confirms `addedIssueIds={businessIssues.map(issue => issue.id)}` is derived from the (now-mismatched) stored issue ids.)
recommendation: In RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx, set `id: issue.id` (not crypto.randomUUID()) when building the imported BusinessIssue in both handleAddAllToMeeting and handleAddToMeeting, matching the existing agenda_item branch.

title: BusinessIssueCard ignores the response of the cross-meeting completion PUT, silently swallowing failures
description: In BusinessIssueCard.handleToggle, after the per-meeting PATCH succeeds, marking an issue complete fires `await fetch('/api/meeting-minutes/business-issues/complete', {method: 'PUT', ...})` (lines 635-643) but the response is never read (no .json(), no .ok/.success check), and fetch() does not reject on 4xx/5xx so the surrounding try/catch never sees a failure either. `onToggle(issue.id, newValue)` (line 645) runs unconditionally right after, marking the UI as completed regardless of whether cross-meeting propagation actually succeeded — with no error shown to the user even though the panel's confirm dialog promises propagation to all meetings. (evidence: Lines 634-644: the second fetch's result is never awaited-and-checked (no `const propResult = await response.json()` or `.ok` check exists for this call, contrasting with the first fetch at lines 622-631 which does check `result.success`); line 645 calls onToggle unconditionally right after.)
recommendation: In BusinessIssueCard.handleToggle, check response.ok/result.success on the business-issues/complete PUT and surface an error (or revert the toggle) if it fails, instead of unconditionally calling onToggle.

title: GET /api/meeting-minutes/recurring-issues parses limit/offset but never applies them
description: limit and offset are parsed from query params (lines 83-84) and echoed back in the JSON response (lines 230-231), but neither is passed to the Supabase query (no .range()/.limit() call anywhere in the query builder at lines 88-102) nor used to slice uniqueIssues/groupedIssues before returning (lines 194, 220-221 build these with no slicing). RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx calls this with ?limit=100 expecting a bounded result, but the endpoint always returns every unresolved business issue and every sub-100%-progress agenda item from every accessible, non-archived 정기회의 in the system's entire history — the payload is unbounded and grows with data volume. (evidence: Lines 83-84 parse `limit`/`offset` into variables that are only used at lines 230-231 to echo them back in the response object; the Supabase query at lines 88-102 has no `.range()` or `.limit()` call, and uniqueIssues (line 194) / groupedIssues (lines 220-221) are never sliced by limit/offset before being returned.)
recommendation: Apply the already-parsed limit/offset to the query (or slice groupedIssues/uniqueIssues) in recurring-issues/route.ts before returning the response, so the ?limit=100 the panel sends is actually honored.

title: PresentationMode's generateSummary treats a failed PATCH as a successful save
description: generateSummary awaits the PATCH fetch (lines 595-599) then unconditionally calls setLocalSummary(summary) and setGenerated(true) (600-601) inside the try block, with no check of response.ok or any success field in a parsed body. fetch() only rejects on network failure, not on 4xx/5xx responses, so a server-side failure (deleted meeting, transient 500, merge error) leaves the UI showing '요약 재생성' as done and displaying the generated summary as if persisted, while the actual DB record was never updated — invisible until the page reloads and the summary reverts, with no error surfaced to the presenter. (evidence: Lines 594-604: `try { await fetch(...); setLocalSummary(summary); setGenerated(true) } finally { setGenerating(false) }` — no `if (!response.ok)` or `.json()`/`.success` check exists between the fetch and the state updates.)
recommendation: In PresentationMode.tsx generateSummary, check response.ok before calling setLocalSummary/setGenerated and show an error state on failure.

title: PresentationMode's saveComment (debounced autosave) has no error handling
description: saveComment wraps its PATCH fetch in try { ... } finally { setSavingId(null) } (lines 565-574) with no catch clause and no check of response.ok. If the request fails (offline, agenda item deleted concurrently, transient 500), the rejection is unhandled beyond a console warning, and even a resolved-but-erroring response is treated as success. The UI's placeholder text ('자동 저장됨' / auto-saved) misleads the user; on failure the comment only survives in local component state and is lost on remount (comments are re-derived from minute.agenda[].comment on mount, line 552-556), with no indication anything went wrong. (evidence: Lines 564-575: `const saveComment = useCallback(async (itemId, text) => { setSavingId(itemId); try { await fetch(...) } finally { setSavingId(null) } }, [minute.id])` — no catch, no response.ok/success check.)
recommendation: Add a catch clause and response.ok check to saveComment in PresentationMode.tsx and surface a 'save failed' indicator instead of silently treating the request as saved.

title: Edit page's new business issues are marked dirty with the same key as edits, and handleSave has no 'business-add' emission path
description: handleAddBusinessIssue marks a new issue dirty via `markDirty(\`business-${newIssue.id}\`)` (line 423) — the identical key format used for edits to existing issues — instead of a distinct key, unlike handleAddAgenda which correctly uses `agenda-add-${newItem.id}` (line 375), tracked and emitted separately in handleSave (lines 521-525). handleSave's only business-issue serialization loop (532-536) is `for (const issue of businessIssues) { if (dirtySections.has(\`business-${issue.id}\`)) operations.push({section:'business', itemId: issue.id, data: issue}) }` — there is no counterpart to the agenda's 'agenda-add' emission loop, so a new business issue would always be sent as a 'business' UPDATE, never 'business-add'. Server-side (app/api/meeting-minutes/[id]/sections/route.ts bulk 'business' case, lines 266-274), `idx = issues.findIndex(...)` with no else branch means idx===-1 is silently a no-op — nothing is added, no error is returned. This bug is currently unreachable through the UI because (per a separate confirmed finding) the edit page never renders any business-issue add/edit controls, so these handlers cannot presently be triggered by a real user; the defect is latent in already-existing code that would misbehave the moment the corresponding UI is wired up. (evidence: edit/page.tsx line 423: `markDirty(\`business-${newIssue.id}\`)` (same key as handleUpdateBusinessIssue's line 447: `markDirty(\`business-${issueId}\`)`). handleSave's business loop at lines 532-536 has no 'business-add' equivalent to the agenda-add loop at lines 521-525. sections/route.ts lines 266-274 (bulk 'business' case): `const idx = issues.findIndex(b => b.id === op.itemId); if (idx !== -1) { issues[idx] = {...}; content = {...} }` — no else branch, so idx===-1 silently no-ops.)
recommendation: In edit/page.tsx use a distinct key like `business-add-${newIssue.id}` (mirroring handleAddAgenda's `agenda-add-${id}` pattern), track new-issue ids in a separate Set, add a 'business-add' emission loop in handleSave, and add an else branch in sections/route.ts's bulk 'business' case to push the new issue when idx===-1; since the add UI isn't wired up yet this is currently unreachable, so ship the fix without urgency but before exposing the add controls.

title: Clearing the search/assignee filter (X button) re-fetches with the stale (pre-clear) filter value
description: fetchRealtimeReports (line 162) is a plain const redefined every render, closing over that render's searchQuery/assigneeFilter. The clear buttons (lines 277, 295) do `onClick={() => { setSearchQuery(''); setTimeout(fetchRealtimeReports, 0) }}`. The `fetchRealtimeReports` reference passed to setTimeout is resolved immediately at click time — i.e. the closure from the render that produced this JSX, which still has the old (pre-clear) searchQuery baked in — not a fresh closure created after the state update commits. Clicking X empties the input visually but the fetch still sends the old filter value. (evidence: app/admin/weekly-reports/admin/page.tsx:162 (`const fetchRealtimeReports = async () => {...}`, not useCallback/memoized) and :277/:295 (`setSearchQuery(''); setTimeout(fetchRealtimeReports, 0)`) — the function reference is captured before the state clear takes effect.)
recommendation: Replace the `setTimeout(fetchRealtimeReports, 0)` calls with a fetch that takes the cleared value as an explicit argument (e.g. `fetchRealtimeReports({ search: '' })`) or drive the fetch from a useEffect keyed on searchQuery/assigneeFilter so it always runs against the just-committed state.

title: Default "this week" date computed via toISOString() shifts by one day during early-morning KST hours
description: `const today = new Date(); ...; const monday = new Date(today.setDate(diff)); setSelectedWeek(monday.toISOString().split('T')[0])`. setDate/getDay operate in the browser's local (KST) time, but toISOString() converts to UTC before truncating to the date part. Between local 00:00 and 08:59 KST, the UTC conversion rolls the date back one calendar day, so the default selectedWeek (and thus the fetched week range) is wrong for roughly 9 hours every day. (evidence: app/weekly-reports/page.tsx:74-78 exact pattern: local Date components (getDay/setDate) combined with `.toISOString().split('T')[0]`.)
recommendation: Replace `monday.toISOString().split('T')[0]` with a local-date formatter (e.g. manually build `${y}-${m}-${d}` from getFullYear/getMonth/getDate, or a date-fns `format`) so the default week doesn't roll back a day during 00:00-08:59 KST.

title: Search query filter is not applied to tasks discovered via task_status_history, polluting search results
description: searchCondition/$3 (title/business_name/description ILIKE) is built and applied only to the first `tasks` query (lines 142-157). The statusHistories query (lines 161-172) has no search filter at all, and any task_id found there that isn't already in taskIds is unconditionally pushed into `tasks` (lines 190-208) regardless of whether it matches searchQuery — so an unrelated task that merely had a stage change this week appears in filtered search results. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/realtime/route.ts:142-147 build searchCondition/taskParams used only in the first query at :150-157; the statusHistories query at :161-172 has no equivalent WHERE clause, and the merge loop at :190-208 pushes matches unconditionally.)
recommendation: Apply the same searchCondition/ILIKE filter to the statusHistories query (or filter the merged task list by the search term before pushing back-filled entries) so unrelated tasks that only had a stage change this week don't leak into search results.

title: POST /api/weekly-reports reports email_sent:true even though no email is ever actually sent
description: When sendEmail && recipients.length > 0, the handler builds `emailContent = generateEmailContent(weeklyReport)` and does nothing else with it — only a comment '// 여기에 실제 이메일 발송 로직 구현' remains, no send call exists. The response still returns `email_sent: sendEmail && recipients.length > 0`, unconditionally true whenever the caller requested it, regardless of whether anything was sent. Grep confirms no current caller in app/ passes sendEmail=true to this route (the only other `sendEmail` symbol in the repo is an unrelated function in app/api/email-notification/route.ts), so this is presently latent rather than actively misleading users, but the endpoint is live and directly callable. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/route.ts:417-423 builds emailContent and discards it with only a comment; line 428 `email_sent: sendEmail && recipients.length > 0` always true under that condition; grep -rn "sendEmail" app/ shows no call site targeting this endpoint with sendEmail=true.)
recommendation: Either implement the actual email-sending call using the already-built emailContent, or until that's done, always return `email_sent: false` with a clear 'not implemented' note in the response instead of echoing back the request flag as if it succeeded; no live caller currently sets sendEmail=true, so this is safe to fix without urgency.

title: Default "this week" date via toISOString() shifts to the wrong week during early-morning KST hours — duplicated in two more files
description: The same root-cause pattern reported for app/weekly-reports/page.tsx is independently re-implemented here (`const monday = new Date(today.setDate(diff)); setSelectedWeek(monday.toISOString().split('T')[0])`) and again in app/admin/weekly-reports/[userId]/page.tsx:152-156 with the Sunday variant (`const sunday = new Date(today.setDate(today.getDate() - today.getDay())); setSelectedWeek(sunday.toISOString().split('T')[0])`). Between 00:00-08:59 KST, toISOString() returns the previous UTC day, rolling the default week back one day in both the admin dashboard and the per-user detail page. (evidence: app/admin/weekly-reports/admin/page.tsx:153-157 and app/admin/weekly-reports/[userId]/page.tsx:153-155 both directly verified to use local Date arithmetic combined with `.toISOString().split('T')[0]`.)
recommendation: Apply the same local-date-formatting fix as item 5 to app/admin/weekly-reports/admin/page.tsx and app/admin/weekly-reports/[userId]/page.tsx's Sunday variant; consider extracting a single shared `getLocalDateString(date)` helper used by all three files to prevent future re-duplication of this bug.

title: Wiki search breaks (500 error) whenever the query contains a comma
description: The query is interpolated unescaped into a PostgREST `.or()` filter string: `.or(`title.ilike.%${query}%,content_md.ilike.%${query}%`)`. PostgREST's `.or()` syntax uses top-level commas to separate `column.operator.value` conditions; a comma inside the user's own search text (plausible for Korean list-style queries) splits the string into invalid fragments, causing Supabase to return a filter-parse error, which is then surfaced as a 500 at line 35. (evidence: app/api/wiki/search/route.ts line 23: raw string interpolation of `query` into `.or(...)` with no escaping of commas; line 33-35 catches `error` and returns `NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 })` — any PostgREST filter-parse failure (which a stray comma in `query` would trigger) reaches this path.)
recommendation: Apply the same comma/parenthesis-escaping fix as item 3 to the `.or()` filter string built from `query` in app/api/wiki/search/route.ts.

title: Print button (인쇄) produces a blank page in the App Router app
description: The print stylesheet's first rule is `body > *:not(#__next) { display: none !important; }`, a leftover Pages-Router selector. This is an App Router project (app/ directory); repo-wide grep shows no element with id `__next` anywhere except this file and its app/dpf/wiki sibling. Since nothing matches `#__next`, the `:not(#__next)` exception never applies, so the rule hides every direct child of `<body>`, including the ancestor tree containing `#form-print-area` (lines 294-298 only set width/margin/padding, never restore display). (evidence: app/wiki/forms/[code]/page.tsx line 291: `body > *:not(#__next) { display: none !important; }`. `grep -rn "__next" app components` returned only this file and app/dpf/wiki/forms/[code]/page.tsx (line 292) — no element with id `__next` exists in the app tree to satisfy the exception.)
recommendation: Replace the leftover Pages-Router `body > *:not(#__next) { display: none !important; }` print rule with an App-Router-correct one, e.g. hide `body > *` except the element wrapping `#form-print-area`, and verify by actually printing the page in-browser after the change.

title: Upload-status polling stops after the first check and never restarts for a newly started upload
description: The mount-only useEffect starts a 5s poll of /api/wiki/guideline-uploads but self-clears the interval the first time it sees no row with status 'analyzing' (lines 34-36). If the admin page loads with nothing currently analyzing (the common case), the interval is torn down ~5s after mount. A subsequent PDF upload via handleUpload sets a row to 'analyzing', but nothing re-arms the interval, so the UI won't auto-refresh to show progress until the user manually clicks '새로고침'. (evidence: app/wiki/admin/page.tsx lines 28-39: `useEffect(() => { loadUploads(); const interval = setInterval(async () => {...; if (!rows.some(r => r.status === 'analyzing')) { clearInterval(interval); } }, 5000); return () => clearInterval(interval); }, [])` — empty dependency array (runs once), and handleUpload (lines 46-70) never creates a new interval or references this one.)
recommendation: Extract the 5s polling logic into a function callable both from the mount useEffect and from handleUpload (after it sets a row to 'analyzing'), so the interval re-arms whenever a new upload starts instead of only running once at mount.

title: Wiki sidebar search ignores the selected domain filter, leaking cross-domain results
description: The frontend appends a `domain` query param to the search request whenever a non-'all' tab is selected, but GET /api/wiki/search only reads `q` and `type` from searchParams (lines 12-13) — `domain` is never read or applied to the query, so results are never scoped by domain server-side. (evidence: app/wiki/page.tsx lines 106-108: `if (domainFilter !== 'all') params.set('domain', domainFilter);` then fetches `/api/wiki/search?${params}`. app/api/wiki/search/route.ts lines 11-27: only `query = searchParams.get('q')` and `nodeType = searchParams.get('type')` are read; `domain` is never referenced anywhere in the file.)
recommendation: Read `domain = searchParams.get('domain')` in the search route and add `.eq('domain', domain)` (when not 'all') to the Supabase query alongside the existing q/type filters.

title: GET /api/wiki/guideline-uploads has no authentication, exposing internal AI analysis summaries and document URLs
description: The GET handler returns the last 20 guideline_uploads rows (version_label, status, diff_summary, wiki_changes, file_url, domain) with no auth check, in contrast to the sibling DELETE handler in [id]/route.ts which correctly requires a level-4 JWT. (evidence: app/api/wiki/guideline-uploads/route.ts lines 8-17: `export async function GET() { const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('guideline_uploads').select('*')...}` — no token/session check anywhere, vs. guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts lines 14-28 which does `jwt.verify` + `permission_level >= 4` before the equivalent DELETE.)
recommendation: Copy the jwt.verify + permission_level>=4 check from guideline-uploads/[id]/route.ts's DELETE handler into this GET handler before it queries guideline_uploads.

title: "Delete all notifications" endpoint always operates on a hardcoded demo-user, silently no-oping for real users
description: getUserFromToken() in this file ignores the Authorization header entirely and always returns `{id:'demo-user', name:'데모 사용자', email:'demo@example.com'}` (comment: "임시 인증 우회"). Both DELETE and POST handlers then filter `.eq('user_id', user.id)` against `user_id:'demo-user'`, which never matches any real employee row, so `deletedCount` is always 0 while the response is `success:true`. contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:798-829/832-863 and contexts/TierNotificationContext.tsx:382-449 call this route with a real Bearer token expecting their own notifications to be deleted, and on success clear their local `notifications` state to []/filter it — so the UI briefly shows notifications gone even though nothing was deleted server-side, and they reappear on next fetch/reload. Reachability caveat: in the current build, the only UI element wired to call deleteAllNotifications/deleteReadNotifications is components/notifications/TierNotificationBell.tsx (onClick={deleteAllNotifications} at line 236), and that component itself is not imported/rendered anywhere in the live app (not in AdminLayout.tsx, not in any app/ page) — the live bell (components/notifications/NotificationBell.tsx, used by AdminLayout.tsx) and the live app/notifications/page.tsx do not call these functions at all. So this defect is real and would immediately manifest the moment either 'delete all/read' UI is wired up (or via direct API call), but it is not currently reachable through any rendered UI. (evidence: delete-all/route.ts:5-12 hardcodes the returned user id regardless of the auth header; :35 and :106 both filter on this hardcoded id. contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:808-823 and TierNotificationContext.tsx:389-405 call this endpoint with a real token and clear/filter local state on any 2xx response. grep across the non-worktree tree shows deleteAllNotifications/deleteReadNotifications are referenced only inside TierNotificationBell.tsx, which itself has zero importers anywhere in app/ or components/ (only NotificationBell.tsx, without these functions, is actually rendered via AdminLayout.tsx).)
recommendation: Replace the hardcoded demo-user getUserFromToken() stub in delete-all/route.ts with a real jwt.verify-based implementation (same pattern as settings/route.ts) so DELETE/POST operate on the actual authenticated user's rows.

title: Task-notification read endpoint has no ownership check (IDOR)
description: When the id has a `task-` prefix, the handler looks up and updates task_notifications filtered only by `.eq('id', notificationId)` (lines 72-76, 101-104) — there is no `.eq('user_id', user.id)` anywhere in this branch, unlike the non-task branch just below (lines 125-130) which does filter user_notifications by user_id. This is live: contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:484 formats task notification ids as `task-${notif.id}` for display in the real NotificationBell.tsx/app/notifications/page.tsx UI, and clicking one calls markAsRead(id) → POST /api/notifications/${id}/read. Any authenticated employee (permission_level 1+) who obtains another employee's task_notifications row UUID can call this endpoint with their own valid JWT and flip that other user's notification to is_read=true. (evidence: [id]/read/route.ts:72-76 and :101-104 filter only by `.eq('id', notificationId)` with no user_id check, contrasted with the non-task branch at :125-130 which does `.eq('notification_id', notificationId).eq('user_id', user.id)`. contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:484 confirms task- prefixed ids reach the live UI.)
recommendation: Add `.eq('user_id', user.id)` to both the task_notifications lookup (L72-76) and update (L101-104) in the task-prefixed branch, matching the ownership filter already applied in the non-task branch just below.

title: 서버 레이아웃 초기화 DEFAULT_LAYOUT에 monthly-leads 위젯 누락으로 리셋 직후 위젯 사라짐
description: 서버 DEFAULT_LAYOUT은 5개 위젯만 포함하고 'monthly-leads'가 빠져있다. handleResetLayout(app/admin/page.tsx L247-264)은 DELETE 응답의 result.data(서버 DEFAULT_LAYOUT)를 그대로 setLayout에 반영하므로, '기본값으로 초기화' 클릭 시 영업 인입 건 위젯이 즉시 사라진다. 새로고침 시에만 loadLayout의 병합 로직이 누락 위젯을 채워 다시 나타난다. (evidence: layout/route.ts L7-15: DEFAULT_LAYOUT.widgets = [weekly-scorecard, organization, revenue, receivable, installation] (monthly-leads 없음). admin/page.tsx L29-38의 클라이언트 DEFAULT_LAYOUT은 monthly-leads 포함 6개. admin/page.tsx L255-256: `setLayout(result.data || DEFAULT_LAYOUT)`이 서버 응답을 그대로 사용.)
recommendation: Add the missing monthly-leads entry to the server-side DEFAULT_LAYOUT array in app/api/dashboard/layout/route.ts L7-15 so it matches the 6-widget client DEFAULT_LAYOUT in admin/page.tsx L29-38.

title: 주간 브리핑 referenceDate가 toISOString() UTC 절단으로 자정~오전9시(KST) 사이 잘못된 주로 이동 가능
description: referenceDate 계산이 d.toISOString().split('T')[0]을 사용해 로컬 Date를 UTC 날짜 문자열로 변환한다. KST 00:00~08:59 구간에는 계산된 날짜가 실제보다 하루 이르며, 이 값이 그대로 서버의 주 경계 계산에 전달되므로 주 경계 근처에서 '이전주' 이동 시 의도한 주가 아닌 그 전 주 데이터가 표시될 수 있다. (evidence: WeeklyScorecard.tsx L177-182: `const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - weekOffset*7); return d.toISOString().split('T')[0]`. L191-193에서 이 값을 referenceDate 쿼리파라미터로 그대로 API에 전달.)
recommendation: Reuse the same KST-safe date helper from item 2's fix in WeeklyScorecard.tsx L177-182's referenceDate calculation instead of toISOString(), keeping week-boundary math consistent with the other dashboard widgets.

title: DashboardCustomizer가 layout prop을 useState 초기값으로만 받아, 저장된 실제 레이아웃 로드 후에도 위젯 목록이 동기화되지 않음
description: useState<Widget[]>(layout.widgets)로 초기화되고 layout prop 변경을 반영하는 useEffect가 없다. admin/page.tsx에서 DashboardCustomizer는 auth 통과 직후(layout이 아직 DEFAULT_LAYOUT일 때) mount되고, loadLayout()의 실제 저장된 레이아웃은 이후 비동기로 도착해 layout prop만 갱신한다. 이미 마운트 시점에 내부 state가 고정되어, 사용자가 이전에 저장한 커스텀 레이아웃이 커스터마이징 패널에 반영되지 않고, 이 상태에서 저장을 누르면 서버의 실제 커스텀 레이아웃이 DEFAULT_LAYOUT으로 덮어써진다. (evidence: DashboardCustomizer.tsx L37: `const [widgets, setWidgets] = useState<Widget[]>(layout.widgets);` — layout prop 변경을 구독하는 useEffect 부재(파일 전체에서 확인). admin/page.tsx L62-67: loadLayout()이 mounted && !authChecking 이후 비동기로 layout state를 나중에 갱신, DashboardCustomizer는 그 이전부터 이미 렌더링되어 있음(L426-430).)
recommendation: Add a useEffect(() => setWidgets(layout.widgets), [layout]) in DashboardCustomizer.tsx so the internal widgets state resyncs when the parent's async-loaded layout prop arrives after mount; fix together with item 11 in the same file.

title: DashboardCustomizer 드래그 정렬이 위젯 객체를 직접 mutate해 부모의 layout.widgets까지 오염시키고 '취소'해도 되돌아가지 않음
description: handleDragOver는 배열만 얕은 복사([...widgets])하고 내부 Widget 객체는 부모 admin/page.tsx의 layout.widgets와 동일한 참조를 공유한다. 이어서 newWidgets.forEach(w => { w.order = i+1 })가 그 공유 객체를 직접 mutate한다. widgets state 초기값이 layout.widgets 그 자체(참조 공유, L37)이므로, 드래그만 하고 저장하지 않아도 부모의 layout.widgets 원소들의 order가 이미 바뀐다. handleCancel의 setWidgets(layout.widgets)는 이미 오염된 동일 객체를 다시 대입할 뿐이라 원래 순서로 복구되지 않으며, 부모가 재렌더링되면 저장하지 않은 드래그 순서가 실제 대시보드에도 반영될 수 있다. (evidence: DashboardCustomizer.tsx L54-62: `const newWidgets = [...widgets]; ... newWidgets.forEach((w, i) => { w.order = i + 1; });`는 배열 원소 객체를 직접 mutate(스프레드로 새 객체 생성 없음). L37: widgets 초기값이 layout.widgets(부모 prop, 참조 공유). L84-86 handleCancel: `setWidgets(layout.widgets)`가 이미 mutate된 동일 참조 재사용.)
recommendation: In DashboardCustomizer.tsx's handleDragOver (L54-62), build newWidgets via .map((w,i)=>({...w, order:i+1})) instead of mutating the shared widget objects in place, so an unsaved drag never leaks into the parent's layout.widgets reference; bundle with item 8's fix in the same file.

title: 영업 인입 차트 요약이 일별 집계 구간에서 '월평균'으로 잘못 표시됨
description: 요약 카드 라벨이 aggLevel === 'weekly' ? '주평균 인입' : '월평균 인입'으로 daily 레벨을 처리하지 않는다. FilterPanel 기간지정 모드로 7일 이하 범위(예: '오늘' 빠른 필터)를 선택하면 determineAggregationLevel이 'daily'를 반환하고, 서버(monthly-leads/route.ts L177)는 totalLeads / (months || finalData.length)로 실질적인 '일평균'을 계산하는데 UI는 이를 '월평균 인입'/'건월'로 표시한다. (evidence: MonthlyLeadsChart.tsx L526-528: `{aggLevel === 'weekly' ? '주평균 인입' : '월평균 인입'}` ... `건/${aggLevel === 'weekly' ? '주' : '월'}`. monthly-leads/route.ts L38: `level = determineAggregationLevel(startDate, endDate)` (7일 이하면 'daily' 반환, dashboard-utils.ts L35). L177: `avgMonthly = totalLeads / (months || finalData.length)`이며 이 경로에서 months는 null.)
recommendation: Extend the ternary at MonthlyLeadsChart.tsx L526-528 to branch on aggLevel === 'daily' as well, showing '일평균 인입'/'건/일' for daily-aggregation periods -- purely a UI label fix, the underlying server-computed average is already correct.

title: 매출 API 평균 이익률이 적자(0% 이하) 월을 평균 계산에서 제외해 실제보다 낙관적으로 산출됨
description: validProfitRates = dataArray.filter(d => d.profitRate > 0) 이후 avgProfitRate를 이 부분집합의 평균으로 계산한다. profitRate가 0 이하(적자)인 달은 평균 계산에서 완전히 제외되므로, 적자 달이 있을수록 화면(RevenueChart 요약 카드)에 노출되는 '평균 이익률'이 실제 전체 평균보다 높게 표시된다. (evidence: revenue/route.ts L492: `const validProfitRates = dataArray.filter(d => d.profitRate > 0);`. L496-498: `avgProfitRate = validProfitRates.length > 0 ? validProfitRates.reduce(...)/validProfitRates.length : 0;`로 0 이하 값 제외 확인.)
recommendation: Get a quick product decision on whether loss months should count as their true negative rate rather than being excluded, then remove/adjust the `.filter(d => d.profitRate > 0)` at revenue/route.ts L492 accordingly -- isolated to one summary figure.

title: 미수금 API 평균 회수율이 회수금 0원인 기간을 평균 계산에서 제외해 실제보다 낙관적으로 산출됨
description: validCollectionRates = dataArray.filter(d => d.collectionRate > 0)로 필터링 후 평균을 낸다. 미수 잔액(outstanding)은 있지만 그 기간에 회수금이 전혀 없었던(collected=0) 버킷도 실질 데이터가 있는데 평균 계산에서 제외되어, revenue/route.ts의 avgProfitRate와 동일한 패턴으로 회수 부진 기간일수록 '평균 회수율'이 실제보다 낙관적으로 표시된다. (evidence: receivables/route.ts L254: `const validCollectionRates = dataArray.filter(d => d.collectionRate > 0);`. L255-257: `avgCollectionRate = validCollectionRates.length > 0 ? validCollectionRates.reduce(...)/validCollectionRates.length : 0;`.)
recommendation: Apply the same fix and same stakeholder decision as item 15 to receivables/route.ts L254-257's avgCollectionRate filter, so the two dashboards' averaging semantics stay consistent.

title: Google OAuth 'state' parameter received but never validated on the callback GET handler (login CSRF)
description: The GET handler reads `state` from the query string and only console.logs it with a comment admitting a real implementation would compare it to a session-stored value -- no such comparison exists. Combined with the route accepting `code` unconditionally, a classic OAuth login-CSRF is possible: attacker completes their own OAuth flow to get a valid code, then lures a victim to this URL to bind the victim's browser session to the attacker's identity. Note: exhaustive grep of app/ and components/ found no frontend code that currently opens this OAuth flow or references this endpoint, so exploitation requires the attacker to independently know the app's public GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and this exact redirect_uri and have it registered as valid with Google -- a real but non-trivial precondition, matching the original 'medium' rating. (evidence: Lines 260-264: `if (state) { console.log(...) }` -- no comparison against any stored value; grep across app/ and components/ for accounts.google.com or window.open referencing this flow returned nothing.)
recommendation: Store a random state value in an httpOnly cookie when the Google OAuth redirect is initiated and compare it to the callback's state query param before exchanging the code; contained to this route and no live UI currently drives the flow.

title: app/change-password page never sends the Authorization header the API requires
description: The fetch() call only sets Content-Type and sends {email, currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword} in the body -- no Authorization header. app/api/auth/change-password/route.ts:12-16 (getUserFromToken) only reads the authorization header, no cookie/body fallback, so it always 401s. The page's own status mapping (line 80-81) then shows '현재 비밀번호가 틀렸습니다' (wrong current password) which is factually incorrect. Severity kept at medium rather than high because the page itself already carries a static disclaimer (lines 241-244) stating the feature doesn't work due to a schema issue, so real users are pre-warned rather than being actively misled into thinking their password is genuinely wrong. (evidence: app/change-password/page.tsx:48-59 fetch options have no Authorization key; app/api/auth/change-password/route.ts:12-16,44-49 only checks request.headers.get('authorization'); app/change-password/page.tsx:80-81 maps 401 to '현재 비밀번호가 틀렸습니다.'; lines 241-244 show the pre-existing disclaimer.)
recommendation: Add an Authorization: Bearer header (read via TokenManager/localStorage) to the fetch call in app/change-password/page.tsx, mirroring the working pattern in app/admin/page.tsx:80-88 — single-file change on an already-nonfunctional page.

title: app/api/employees/[id]/route.ts GET/PUT/DELETE are unreachable due to verifyToken() return-shape mismatch
description: All three handlers do `const authResult = await verifyToken(token); if (!authResult.success) {...}`, but verifyToken imported from @/utils/auth (utils/auth.ts) is synchronous and returns either the raw decoded JWT payload or null -- never {success,data}. With a valid token, authResult.success is undefined so the handler always 401s, echoing the caller's own decoded token; with an invalid token, `null.success` throws, caught by the outer try/catch as a 500. The sibling list-GET in app/api/employees/route.ts:21-24 uses the correct pattern (`if (!authResult)`), confirming this is a copy-paste divergence. Downgraded from the claimed 'high' to 'medium': exhaustive grep of app/, components/, lib/, hooks/ for '/api/employees/${' or template-literal calls to this route found zero frontend callers -- this endpoint is currently dead code, not actively breaking a live feature. (evidence: app/api/employees/[id]/route.ts:24-27 (GET), 74-79 (PUT), 211-217 (DELETE) all destructure authResult.success/authResult.data; utils/auth.ts verifyToken() returns `jwt.verify(...)` or null, no success/data wrapper; app/api/employees/route.ts:21-24 shows the correct working pattern used elsewhere in the same route family; grep found no frontend caller of /api/employees/[id].)
recommendation: Change the GET/PUT/DELETE handlers' `if (!authResult.success)` checks to `if (!authResult)` and use authResult directly, copying the already-correct pattern from app/api/employees/route.ts:21-24; confirmed dead code today (no frontend caller), so no live regression risk.

title: POST /api/employees has the identical verifyToken() shape mismatch
description: Same bug as the [id] route: `if (!authResult.success)` against a verifyToken() that returns the raw payload or null, so a valid admin token always yields a 401 that echoes the decoded token before reaching the insert logic. Grep found only GET usages of /api/employees in the frontend -- this POST path is currently unreferenced/dead code, so it fails silently the moment something starts calling it rather than breaking a live flow today. (evidence: app/api/employees/route.ts:105-108 destructures authResult.success/data; same utils/auth.ts verifyToken() contract as the [id] route; grep for '/api/employees' usages in app/, components/ shows only GET calls (TaskManagement.tsx:61, ProjectDashboard.tsx:55, dev-work-log/page.tsx:1003).)
recommendation: Apply the identical `if (!authResult)` fix to the POST handler in app/api/employees/route.ts:105-116, reusing the same pattern as the working GET handler in the same file; confirmed no live caller currently hits this path.

title: GET /api/auth/me primarily reads a cookie name ('auth_token') the standard login flow never sets
description: request.cookies.get('auth_token') is checked first; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:196 sets 'session_token' (plus 'auth_ready'), never 'auth_token'. The route does fall back to an Authorization header (lines 17-22), and in the one confirmed live caller (app/admin/page.tsx:80-88) that header IS populated correctly, because AuthContext's emailLogin() calls TokenManager.setToken() (lib/api-client.ts, TOKEN_KEY='auth_token') to persist the token to localStorage under the same key name admin/page.tsx reads -- so in the traced normal flow this does not actually 401 real users. It remains a genuine latent bug for any client that relies on cookie-only auth without also populating that specific localStorage key (e.g. localStorage cleared/blocked while the session_token cookie persists), and reflects real cookie-naming drift across the codebase (session_token / auth-token / auth_token used inconsistently by different auth code paths). (evidence: app/api/auth/me/route.ts:14-22; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:196,205 sets session_token + auth_ready only; lib/api-client.ts:4-16 TokenManager.TOKEN_KEY='auth_token'; contexts/AuthContext.tsx:63,96 calls TokenManager.setToken() inside emailLogin; app/admin/page.tsx:80-88 reads localStorage.getItem('auth_token') and sends it as Authorization header, which succeeds for users who logged in via the standard flow.)
recommendation: Have GET /api/auth/me additionally accept the 'session_token' cookie (in addition to the current 'auth_token' check and the working Authorization-header fallback) so the primary cookie check isn't silently dead for standard-login users; additive change, unlikely to disturb the header path that already works.

title: Google login popup calls a route with no POST handler, guaranteeing a 405 on every attempt
description: app/api/auth/social/google/callback/route.ts:63-69's popup script does `fetch('/api/auth/social/google', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({code})})`, but app/api/auth/social/google/route.ts only exports a GET handler (confirmed via grep -- no `export async function POST` or `export const POST` anywhere in the file); Next.js App Router auto-405s undefined methods, so this exchange would fail every time it's attempted. Downgraded from the claimed 'critical' to 'medium': exhaustive grep of app/ and components/*.tsx for any window.open/postMessage wiring targeting this popup flow, or any reference to SOCIAL_LOGIN_SUCCESS/ERROR, found zero results -- there is currently no button anywhere in the live UI that opens this popup, so today this defect affects zero real users, though it would immediately break Google login the moment such a button were added. (evidence: app/api/auth/social/google/callback/route.ts:63-69 POST call; `grep -n "^export async function POST\|^export async function GET" app/api/auth/social/google/route.ts` returns only the GET at line 231, no POST; grep for SOCIAL_LOGIN_SUCCESS/window.open across app/, components/ returned no matches.)
recommendation: Add an `export async function POST` to app/api/auth/social/google/route.ts that performs the code exchange the popup callback already expects; no live UI currently opens this popup so there's nothing to regress.

title: Kakao GET-flow callback sets only a cookie name ('auth_token') the page-auth middleware doesn't recognize, redirecting successfully-logged-in users straight back to /login
description: After a successful Kakao exchange this callback sets only response.cookies.set('auth_token', jwtToken, {httpOnly:true,...}) and redirects to /admin. middleware.ts's checkPageAuthentication (lines ~185-215) only accepts 'session_token' or the JS-readable 'auth_ready' cookie for page routes; seeing neither, it redirects to /login?redirect=/admin, undoing the login that just server-side succeeded. Downgraded from the claimed 'high' to 'medium': grep of app/, components/*.tsx found no reference at all to '/api/auth/kakao' (the GET entry point that leads here), so no confirmed live UI button currently drives users through this exact flow -- the defect is real and would manifest as a redirect loop the moment this flow is exposed, but is not observably breaking real user sessions today via any traced code path. (evidence: app/api/auth/social/kakao/callback/route.ts:274,303 only set 'auth_token'; middleware.ts checkPageAuthentication reads only 'session_token'/'auth_ready' (confirmed by reading that function, no 'auth_token' check present anywhere in middleware.ts); grep for 'api/auth/kakao' in app/*.tsx and components/*.tsx returned no matches.)
recommendation: Have the Kakao GET-flow callback also set a 'session_token' cookie (what middleware.ts actually checks) instead of only 'auth_token', matching app/api/auth/login/route.ts; isolated single file with no confirmed live caller of the entry point today.
