A business currently sitting in the product-order facility_task stage will therefore almost always still have order_date IS NULL, so it matches BOTH branches simultaneously - appearing in both '발주 필요' and '진행 전' tabs, and counted in both summary.in_progress and summary.not_started (lines 557-578), which sum into summary.total_orders (line 581), inflating the '전체' stat card. (evidence: route.ts lines 118-122 (in_progress query condition), line 330 (not_started query condition: order_date IS NULL), complete/route.ts lines 86-112 confirms order_date is only set on final completion. Lines 580-581 sum the three independently-queried counts into total_orders without deduplication.)
recommendation: Make the not_started query exclude business_ids already present in an active facility_tasks product-order row (and vice versa exclude businesses with order_date already set from in_progress), then compute total_orders as one deduplicated count instead of summing three independently-queried branches — validate against a handful of known businesses in each stage before deploying, since this changes the stats every order-management user sees daily.

title: getWeekRange() computes week boundaries in server-local (UTC) time, not KST, misattributing early-morning tasks to the wrong week
description: getWeekRange() (duplicated verbatim across route.ts, admin/route.ts, generate-all/route.ts, and realtime/route.ts) derives week start/end via date.getDay()/getDate()/setHours(0,0,0,0), all resolved in the JS runtime's local timezone. No TZ env var is set anywhere in the repo (checked package.json, next.config.js, vercel.json, .env.local), so Vercel's Node.js function runtime defaults to UTC, 9 hours behind KST — meaning 'midnight' as computed here is actually 09:00 AM KST. A task completed at 2026-07-26 03:00 KST (03:00 Sunday local, intended for the week starting that Sunday) is 2026-07-25T18:00:00Z in UTC, before the computed weekStart of 2026-07-26T00:00:00.000Z, so it's silently counted in the previous week's report instead. (evidence: app/api/weekly-reports/route.ts:64-80 getWeekRange() uses date.getDay()/getDate()/setHours (local-TZ-dependent) then .toISOString(); grep across package.json/next.config.js/vercel.json/.env.local found no TZ setting, so this runs in UTC on Vercel by default.)
recommendation: Compute week boundaries in KST explicitly (e.g. apply a fixed +9h offset before deriving day-of-week/date, or use an Intl/date-fns-tz based calculation) instead of relying on the server runtime's local timezone, and extract getWeekRange into one shared, tested utility used by all four routes; treat this as a data-correctness fix requiring careful before/after validation since already-cached weekly_reports rows may have been computed with the wrong boundaries.

title: Notification settings are never persisted — GET always returns hardcoded defaults and PUT never writes to the database
description: GET (lines 67-76) always returns the hardcoded `defaultSettings` object regardless of what the user previously saved (comment: "EMERGENCY FIX: 테이블이 존재하지 않으므로 항상 기본 설정 반환"), and PUT (lines 98-108) accepts the client's settings and echoes them back as `success:true` without writing anything to a database (comment: "테이블이 없으므로 설정을 받아서 그대로 반환"). app/notifications/settings/page.tsx:74-92 (handleSave, reachable via NotificationBell → '모든 알림 보기' → /notifications → settings link, all confirmed live) calls updateSettings() and on success shows "설정이 성공적으로 저장되었습니다" (line 211) — but any toggle change (e.g. turning off systemNotifications) is lost on next page load/reload, since GET always returns the defaults again. (evidence: settings/route.ts:67-76 (GET always returns defaultSettings, `isDefault:true`), :98-108 (PUT echoes clientSettings back with a 'table not available' warning, no DB write). app/notifications/settings/page.tsx:74-92 calls updateSettings then sets saveSuccess, and line 211 renders the Korean success message unconditionally on that path. Reachability chain confirmed: AdminLayout.tsx → NotificationBell.tsx (router.push('/notifications') at line 370) → app/notifications/page.tsx (href="/notifications/settings" at line 212) → settings page.)
recommendation: Create a `user_notification_settings` table via a Supabase migration and update GET/PUT to actually read/write per-user rows instead of returning hardcoded defaults/echoing input, since this needs a schema change and currently silently discards every user's saved preference.

title: revenue/business-summary API 내부에 세 번째로 발산된 매출/원가/영업비 계산 로직
description: calculateBusinessRevenue()는 lib/services/revenue-calculator.ts(정본)와 세 가지 지점에서 발산한다. (1) 560-561행에서 government_pricing.manufacturer_price/installation_cost를 직접 읽는데, 이 컬럼들은 sql/revenue_management_schema.sql 11-12행에 'DEFAULT 0 -- 추후 설정'으로 정의된 사실상 미사용 레거시 컬럼이며, 실제 제조사별 원가/설치비는 별도 테이블 manufacturer_pricing/equipment_installation_cost(sql/manufacturer_pricing_system.sql)에서 조회해야 한다(lib/services/revenue-calculator.ts 230,253행). (2) 573행 salesCommission = totalRevenue*(rate/100)는 negotiation 할인을 차감하지 않은 원시 매출 기준이며, 정본은 commissionBaseRevenue = totalRevenue - negotiationDiscount를 기준으로 한다(lib/revenue-calculator.ts:165, lib/services/revenue-calculator.ts:620). (3) revenue_adjustments/purchase_adjustments/operating_cost_adjustments/installation_extra_cost/as_cost/custom_additional_costs를 전혀 참조하지 않는다. (evidence: business-summary/route.ts 559-561행에서 priceMap(government_pricing 출처)의 manufacturer_price/installation_cost를 그대로 사용함을 확인. sql/revenue_management_schema.sql 6-21행에서 government_pricing.manufacturer_price가 DEFAULT 0으로 정의됨을 확인, 별도로 sql/manufacturer_pricing_system.sql에 manufacturer_pricing/equipment_installation_cost 테이블이 존재하고 lib/services/revenue-calculator.ts가 이를 조회함을 확인(grep 결과 230,253,866-867행). 573행 salesCommission 계산에 negotiationDiscount가 반영되지 않음을 확인(585행에서 adjustedRevenue는 별도 계산되지만 salesCommission 산식엔 미반영). 코드 전체에서 revenue_adjustments 등 6개 조정 필드에 대한 grep 결과 0건. 이 라우트를 호출하는 프론트엔드 코드가 없음을 grep으로 확인(examples/revenue-api-usage.ts와 lib/security/rate-limiter.ts에만 언급), 다만 permission_level>=2 인증 사용자가 직접 API를 호출하면 실제로 도달 가능.)
recommendation: Retire this route's standalone `calculateBusinessRevenue()` and delegate to the canonical lib/services/revenue-calculator.ts (which already sources manufacturer/installation cost from manufacturer_pricing tables, nets negotiation discount into the commission base, and applies the adjustment fields) rather than patching the three divergences independently.

title: 계산서 레코드 PUT 수정 시 record_type='revised' 레코드는 business_info 동기화가 스킵됨(POST와 상반)
description: POST의 동기화 조건(138행)은 `invoice_stage !== 'extra' && record_type !== 'cancelled'`로 'revised' 레코드도 포함해 business_info를 동기화한다. 반면 PUT의 동기화 조건(267행)은 `existing.record_type === 'original'`로 'revised' 레코드는 명시적으로 제외한다. 시나리오: subsidy_1st 원본 발행(동기화됨) → 금액 오류로 record_type='revised' 신규 레코드 생성(POST가 business_info를 새 금액으로 동기화) → 그 revised 레코드를 PUT으로 오타 정정하며 금액도 재조정하면 PUT 조건이 false가 되어 business_info는 갱신되지 않고, invoice_records의 최신 값과 business_info가 서로 다른 금액/날짜를 보이게 된다. (evidence: app/api/invoice-records/route.ts:138 (`if (invoice_stage !== 'extra' && record_type !== 'cancelled')` - revised 포함) vs :267 (`if (existing.invoice_stage !== 'extra' && existing.record_type === 'original')` - revised 제외) 직접 대조 확인.)
recommendation: Get a product decision on whether 'revised' invoice records should sync business_info on edit (as POST already does on creation), then align the PUT condition at line 267 accordingly — this is a financial-data consistency call, not a pure bug fix.

title: 결재완료 탭의 '미처리/처리완료' 배지가 서버 limit=100에 의해 잘린 부분집합으로 계산되어 전체 건수와 불일치
description: fetchDocs()는 결재완료 탭에서도 282줄 `params.set('limit', '100')`으로 100건까지만 조회하고, 그 total은 서버가 별도로 계산한 전체 COUNT(*)를 반환한다(app/api/approvals/route.ts 125-153줄: LIMIT과 무관하게 전체 카운트). renderCompletedTab()의 unprocessedCount/processedCount(454-455줄)는 서버 total이 아니라 화면에 로드된 docs(최대 100건)만 필터링한다. 서버 쿼리는 `ORDER BY d.is_processed ASC NULLS FIRST, d.completed_at DESC`로 정렬하므로 미처리 건수가 100건 미만이면 unprocessedCount는 대체로 정확하지만, 완료문서 총량이 100건을 넘는 순간부터 processedCount(및 미처리 건수가 실제로 100건을 넘는 극단적 경우엔 unprocessedCount도)는 실제보다 작게 표시되어 '전체 total건'과 '미처리+처리완료' 합이 어긋난다. (evidence: app/admin/approvals/page.tsx 282줄에서 completed 탭에도 limit=100이 무조건 적용됨을 확인. 454-455줄 `docs.filter(d => !d.is_processed)`/`docs.filter(d => d.is_processed)`가 클라이언트에 로드된 docs 배열(서버가 LIMIT $ci OFFSET $ci로 최대 100건만 반환, app/api/approvals/route.ts 133-148줄)만 대상으로 계산됨을 확인. total은 125-131줄의 별도 COUNT(*) 쿼리 결과(제한 없음)라 두 값의 소스가 다름을 확인.)
recommendation: Compute unprocessed/processed counts from a dedicated server-side aggregate query rather than the capped 100-row page, likely requiring a new count endpoint or extension of the existing total-COUNT query.

title: Three incompatible techniques solve the same 'table doesn't fit on mobile' problem across domains
description: (a) Full duplicate-JSX dual-render — a separate `hidden md:block` desktop `<table>` plus a fully independent `md:hidden` mobile card-list markup fed by the same data — is used in air-permit-detail's outlet/facility table, tasks (TaskCard/TaskCardList), order-management (RouterInventoryList and the main list page), weekly-reports ([userId]/page.tsx and admin/page.tsx), document-automation's execution-history table, subsidy's ActiveAnnouncementsModal, and approvals' forms. (b) Horizontal-scroll-only with no mobile-specific layout at all is used in as-management (all major tables, explicitly noted as having no card fallback), dpf's DpfVehicleTable (a fixed `min-width:1780px` table with an explicit 'scroll horizontally' hint label), and subsidy's monitoring-dashboard/regional-stats/url-health pages. (c) Single markup with progressive Tailwind breakpoint stacking only (no distinct mobile layout at all) is used in facility's page shell and components/ui/DataTable's own responsive ladder per the shared-ui review. A user comparing, say, as-management's revenue table (forced sideways scroll on a phone) against tasks' equivalent list (a real card view) experiences visibly different mobile ergonomics for the same kind of tabular data.
recommendation: Adopt components/ui/DataTable (already noted as having a well-tuned responsive breakpoint ladder in the shared-ui review) as the canonical responsive-table pattern, and migrate the scroll-only tables (as-management, dpf's vehicle table, subsidy's monitoring pages) and the hand-duplicated dual-JSX lists (tasks, order-management, weekly-reports) onto it rather than each maintaining a bespoke mobile strategy.

title: Data table: canonical components/ui/DataTable.tsx has near-zero adoption outside admin-misc/data-history
description: components/ui/DataTable.tsx offers built-in sort/search/pagination/selection and, per the shared-ui audit, is genuinely used in 9 files, but the only domain-review-confirmed real adopter is app/admin/data-history/page.tsx. Every other domain that renders tabular data hand-writes its own <table>/<thead>/<tbody> markup with no shared sorting/pagination logic: business-core (InstallationBreakdownModal), air-permit (permit summary + outlet/facility grid), approvals (bulk table, no sort/pagination), as-management (3 pages), order-management (page.tsx + RouterInventoryList, each also duplicating a separate mobile card layout), document-automation (page.tsx + EstimateManagement, again with duplicated mobile/desktop markup), subsidy (5 pages), revenue-closing (5 pages, one of which reimplements virtualization via @tanstack/react-virtual instead of DataTable), meeting-minutes, weekly-reports (2 pages), dpf (DpfVehicleTable with its own hand-rolled pagination), and dashboard (6 chart/table components).
recommendation: Treat components/ui/DataTable.tsx as the default for any admin listing that needs sort/search/pagination, and migrate the raw-<table> implementations that already reinvent pagination by hand (dpf/DpfVehicleTable, order-management's page.tsx, subsidy's monitoring pages) first since they get the most direct benefit. Where a table also needs virtualization (revenue/page.tsx), consider extending DataTable with a virtualized mode rather than maintaining a separate @tanstack/react-virtual implementation.

title: Business/site search-and-select is solved by 4 divergent canonical components plus at least 4 more fully ad-hoc reimplementations
description: The shared-ui review already flags that 4 independent canonical autocomplete components coexist: components/ui/AutocompleteInput.tsx, components/ui/AutocompleteSelectInput.tsx, components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx, and components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx (same name, different implementation). order-management correctly reuses components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete (in RouterEditModal), blueon-ai-misc reuses components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete (in CalendarModal), and meeting-minutes reuses components/ui/AutocompleteSelectInput. But beyond that split, several domains don't reuse any of the four — they reinvent the same 'search input + filtered dropdown + keyboard nav + click-outside handler' logic from scratch: air-permit/page.tsx (business search-and-select, keyed on a manually-managed 'business-dropdown-container' class), tasks/page.tsx (businessSearchTerm/showBusinessDropdown/selectedBusinessIndex state with its own handleBusinessKeyDown), as-management's AsRecordModal (businessSuggestions state + its own /api/businesses fetch), and document-automation's ContractManagement (its own filtered-array + ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape handling), while document-automation's EstimateManagement instead swaps to a paginated card grid rather than any autocomplete.
recommendation: Before adding any more reimplementations, first collapse the two BusinessAutocomplete components (components/ui/ vs components/inputs/) into one, then migrate the fully ad-hoc reimplementations in air-permit, tasks, as-management, and document-automation's ContractManagement onto that single canonical component — all four are solving the identical 'search businesses, arrow-key navigate, select' problem with independently-written and independently-buggy keyboard handling.

title: Manager/assignee picker logic is reimplemented per-domain instead of reusing MultiAssigneeSelector/AdminManagerPicker
description: components/ui/MultiAssigneeSelector.tsx and components/ui/AdminManagerPicker.tsx are the canonical pickers against the employees API, correctly used together in tasks/page.tsx. Elsewhere, the same underlying need — pick one or more people from the employee/approver list — is solved independently each time: approvals builds a fully separate ApproverSelector.tsx (grouped native <select> + its own /api/approvals/approvers fetch), revenue-closing builds CollectionManagerCell.tsx (a createPortal-based picker for '수금 담당자') instead of reusing AdminManagerPicker, admin-misc's dev-work-log DetailPanel builds a raw <select> by manually fetching and filtering /api/employees, and order-management's page.tsx only offers a raw <select> populated from already-loaded order data as a filter — with no actual assignee-editing UI in that domain at all despite the backend (app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts) fully supporting multi-assignee JSONB.
recommendation: Where the picker is choosing from the same employees/approvers pool (dev-work-log, CollectionManagerCell), migrate onto AdminManagerPicker rather than re-fetching and re-rendering the list independently. ApproverSelector has a genuinely different data shape (grouped approval-chain roles) so a full merge may not be warranted, but its dropdown/list rendering could still share the AdminManagerPicker search UI instead of a bare grouped <select>.

title: File upload widgets: the one shared UploadQueue/ProgressUploadCard/SmartFloatingProgress combo isn't reused by any bulk-upload feature reviewed
description: Per shared-ui, components/ui/UploadQueue.tsx + ProgressUploadCard.tsx + SmartFloatingProgress.tsx are combined for facility-photo uploads (ImprovedFacilityPhotoSection). Every other file-upload feature reviewed reimplements its own raw <input type="file"> handling with no shared progress UI: tasks' BulkUploadModal (Excel, manual FileReader/xlsx parsing), as-management's AsExcelUpload (custom dashed dropzone), wiki/admin's PDF uploader (Tailwind file: pseudo-classes, static 'uploading' text instead of a progress bar), dpf's DpfImportUploader (hand-rolled width-percentage progress div), and blueon-ai-misc's CalendarModal (hidden input + dashed-border label dropzone). order-management's RouterAddModal goes further and avoids a file input altogether, having users paste tab-delimited Excel data into a plain <textarea> parsed with string.split().
recommendation: Standardize bulk-upload UI (dropzone + progress) on the UploadQueue/ProgressUploadCard combo already proven in the facility-photo flow; migrate wiki's admin PDF uploader first since it currently has no real progress feedback at all (just static text), then dpf's DpfImportUploader (which hand-rolls a percentage bar that ProgressUploadCard already provides).

title: ExportDialog 다운로드 진행률 바가 항상 0%로 표시됨
description: handleExport only ever calls setProgress(0) (once at start, once in finally). Traced the onExport prop to ExportButtons.tsx's handleExport, which has no callback or shared state that could update ExportDialog's local progress state. No code path anywhere sets progress to a nonzero value. (evidence: components/facility/ExportDialog.tsx lines 35,46 both call setProgress(0); components/facility/ExportButtons.tsx handleExport (passed as onExport) never receives or calls any progress-reporting function, confirmed by grep across both files for setProgress.)
recommendation: Wire a real progress callback from ExportButtons.handleExport (or fetch/XHR progress events) into ExportDialog's setProgress instead of only ever calling setProgress(0).

title: Permit search predicate ignores the facility/location/pollutant fields its placeholder advertises
description: filterAirPermits only checks permit.id, permit.business_type, and a nonexistent permit.business_name field; facility name, installation location, and pollutant are never inspected despite the placeholder claiming otherwise. (evidence: filterAirPermits (290-306) checks `permit.id`, `permit.business_type`, `permit.business_name`. Per app/api/air-permit/route.ts's json_build_object (lines 46-54, 126-133), business info comes nested as `permit.business.business_name`, not a top-level `permit.business_name`, so that clause is always undefined. Placeholder (line 1157) says '대기필증 번호, 업종, 시설명, 설치장소, 오염물질로 검색...' but facility name/location/pollutant fields are never checked anywhere in the filter.)
recommendation: Update filterAirPermits to read permit.business?.business_name (matching the actual nested API shape) and add facility_name/location/pollutant checks so the search behaves as the placeholder text advertises.

title: Green link code casing is inconsistent between mobile and desktop discharge-facility inputs
description: Three of the four green-link-code onChange handlers call .toUpperCase(); the mobile discharge-facility one omits it, so the same field normalizes differently depending on device/facility type. (evidence: grep confirms: desktop discharge (line 1775) `.toUpperCase()`, desktop prevention (1935) `.toUpperCase()`, mobile prevention (2190) `.toUpperCase()`, mobile discharge (2076) — no `.toUpperCase()`, passes `e.target.value` raw.)
recommendation: Add .toUpperCase() to the mobile discharge-facility green-link-code onChange handler at line 2076 to match the other three handlers.

title: Unauthenticated leftover migration endpoint operates on columns that don't exist on air_permit_info
description: POST has no auth check and attempts blind writes/index creation against facility_number/green_link_code/memo, which are not real top-level columns in this schema (they live inside additional_info JSONB) — currently near-inert but still a reachable, unauthenticated production endpoint. (evidence: No auth check anywhere in the file. Lines 61-71 run `CREATE INDEX` via `supabase.rpc('exec', ...)` and lines 74-81 blanket-UPDATE `facility_number/green_link_code/memo` on air_permit_info. types/database.ts's AirPermitInfo interface (73-98) has no such top-level fields, and app/api/air-permit/route.ts's PUT/POST (lines 482-490, 275-280) confirm these are merged into the `additional_info` JSON column instead. The endpoint is currently mostly a no-op ending in 500, but remains a live, unauthenticated write-capable route.)
recommendation: Delete the unused add-pdf-fields route entirely (it targets non-existent top-level columns and has no callers), or at minimum add the same auth check used by other admin routes if it must stay.

title: 연장근무일지 요일 자동계산이 UTC 파싱을 사용해 UTC보다 뒤인 시간대에서 요일이 하루 밀림
description: getDayOfWeek(dateStr)가 `new Date(dateStr)`로 'YYYY-MM-DD'를 파싱하는데, 날짜 전용 문자열은 ECMAScript 스펙상 UTC 자정으로 해석된다. 이후 `.getDay()`는 로컬 타임존 기준이므로 브라우저 타임존이 UTC보다 뒤(미국/유럽 등)면 요일이 하루 앞당겨진 값으로 계산되어 items[].day_of_week에 저장된다. (evidence: components/approvals/forms/OvertimeLogForm.tsx 30-35줄: `const d = new Date(dateStr); return DAY_NAMES[d.getDay()]` 확인, dateStr을 split하지 않고 그대로 Date 생성자에 전달함. 74줄 `updated.day_of_week = getDayOfWeek(value as string)`에서 date 필드 변경 시 즉시 저장되어 결재 문서에 영구 반영됨을 확인. UTC보다 뒤인 시간대(예: UTC-5)에서 'YYYY-MM-DD' 형태는 UTC 자정 = 로컬 전날 저녁으로 해석되어 getDay()가 하루 이른 요일을 반환하는 것은 JS의 잘 알려진 동작.)
recommendation: In getDayOfWeek(), parse dateStr by splitting 'YYYY-MM-DD' into numeric parts and constructing the Date with those local components (or use noon UTC) instead of `new Date(dateStr)`, avoiding UTC-based day-shift in timezones behind UTC.

title: 무상(free) AS건의 '금액 조정' 탭이 실제 매출집계(as-revenue)와 다른 자재원가/매출 금액을 표시
description: '사용자재' 탭은 무상 건에서 단가/금액 컬럼을 숨기지만, totalMaterialCost/totalMaterialRevenue는 paid 여부와 무관하게 항상 계산되어 그대로 AsPricingAdjustmentTab에 전달된다. 반면 as-revenue/route.ts는 무상 건의 material_cost/material_revenue를 서버에서 강제로 0으로 계산한다. 담당자가 '금액 조정' 탭에서 잘못된 기준금액을 참고하게 된다. (evidence: AsRecordModal.tsx:282-294 totalMaterialCost/totalMaterialRevenue 계산에 displayedPaidStatus 조건 없음. 1083-1096행에서 이 값을 그대로 AsPricingAdjustmentTab의 materialCost/materialRevenue prop으로 전달. as-revenue/route.ts:97-141에서 is_free 조건일 때 material_cost/material_revenue를 0으로 강제하는 CASE 확인, 두 계산 경로가 서로 다름을 대조 확인.)
recommendation: Zero out totalMaterialCost/totalMaterialRevenue when displayedPaidStatus is free (AsRecordModal.tsx L282-294) before passing them into AsPricingAdjustmentTab, mirroring the is_free CASE logic already used server-side in as-revenue/route.ts.

title: 엑셀 일괄 업로드에서 출동횟수에 숫자로 변환 불가능한 값을 입력하면 NaN이 INSERT 파라미터로 전달되어 행 전체가 원인 불명의 실패로 처리됨
description: dispatchCount는 Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(dispatchCountRaw)))로 계산된다. '출동횟수' 컬럼에 순수 숫자가 아닌 값("2회", "두번" 등)을 입력하면 Number()가 NaN을 반환하고 Math.max/Math.round 모두 NaN을 그대로 전파해 dispatchCount가 NaN이 된다. 이 값이 INSERT 파라미터로 전달되면 정수 컬럼 바인딩 실패로 예외가 발생해 해당 행 전체가 '저장 실패'로 처리되며, 실제 원인(출동횟수 값 오류)은 사용자에게 노출되지 않는다. (evidence: bulk-upload/route.ts:198-200 dispatchCount 계산 로직에서 Number(dispatchCountRaw)가 NaN이면 Math.round/Math.max 모두 NaN 전파를 확인(Math.max는 인자 중 하나라도 NaN이면 NaN 반환). 233-236행 catch 블록이 모든 삽입 오류를 일괄적으로 '저장 실패' 메시지로만 반환함을 확인.)
recommendation: Validate dispatchCountRaw with `Number.isFinite(Number(dispatchCountRaw))` before computing dispatchCount (bulk-upload/route.ts L197-200); on invalid input default to 1 and record a specific per-row warning instead of letting NaN propagate into a generic '저장 실패'.

title: PurchaseOrderModal is rendered twice; the second instance is missing the required isOpen prop (currently dead/no-op, but a landmine for future edits)
description: When showPurchaseOrderModal is true, two separate JSX blocks both render <PurchaseOrderModal>: lines 650-657 (correctly passing isOpen={showPurchaseOrderModal}) and lines 711-717 (omitting isOpen entirely). Confirmed PurchaseOrderModal.tsx requires isOpen: boolean (line 12, not optional) and does `if (!isOpen) return null` at line 280, so the second instance currently renders nothing. Its internal useEffect (lines 35-39) is gated by `if (isOpen && businessId)`, so with isOpen undefined it also does not fire a second fetch today. It is dead/duplicate code that will start rendering a second, overlapping modal instance the moment someone adds the missing isOpen prop without noticing the first call site already exists. (evidence: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json reproduces exactly: 'OrderDetailModal.tsx(712,10): error TS2741: Property isOpen is missing in type ... required in type PurchaseOrderModalProps'. PurchaseOrderModal.tsx line 12 (isOpen: boolean, required) and line 280 (if (!isOpen) return null), lines 35-39 (effect gated on isOpen).)
recommendation: Delete the duplicate, dead <PurchaseOrderModal> block at OrderDetailModal.tsx L711-717 (missing the required isOpen prop); the correctly-wired instance at L650-657 already renders this modal.

title: PUT /api/order-management/[businessId]에서 5개 알려진 필드가 하나도 없으면 SET 절이 비어 SQL 문법 오류로 이어짐 (현재는 위의 TDZ 크래시가 더 먼저 발생해 도달 불가능하지만 별개의 실결함)
description: updateFields 배열은 body에 layout_date/order_form_date/ip_request_date/greenlink_ip_setting_date/router_request_date 중 하나라도 있을 때만 채워진다. 이 5개 키가 전혀 없는 요청 본문이 오면 updateFields.join(', ')가 빈 문자열이 되어 `UPDATE order_management SET  WHERE business_id = $1 RETURNING *`라는 문법 오류 SQL이 만들어진다. 현재 UI는 항상 5개 키를 모두 포함해 보내므로 정상 사용 흐름에서는 발생하지 않으며, 이 코드 경로 자체도 line 227의 TDZ 크래시(위에서 확인한 별개의 확정 버그) 때문에 지금은 절대 실행되지 않는다 - 그 문제가 수정된 이후에도 남는 잠재적 결함이다. (evidence: route.ts lines 249-278 (5개 필드에 대해서만 조건부로 updateFields.push), line 285 `SET ${updateFields.join(', ')}` - 빈 배열이면 빈 문자열. OrderDetailModal.tsx handleSave가 항상 stepDates 5개 키를 전송함을 확인(현재 UI에서는 미도달).)
recommendation: Add a guard right after building updateFields in the PUT handler: if updateFields.length === 0, return a 400 'no fields to update' response before constructing the SQL string, mirroring the empty-body validation pattern used elsewhere in the file.

title: BusinessQuickView의 z-60/z-61 Tailwind 클래스는 대괄호 없는 임의값이라 CSS가 생성되지 않음
description: Tailwind 기본 z-index 스케일은 0/10/20/30/40/50/auto뿐이며 tailwind.config.js에 zIndex 확장이 없음을 확인했다(grep 결과 없음). z-60(line 50), z-61(line 53)은 대괄호 문법(z-[60]) 없이 그대로 사용되어 어떤 CSS 규칙도 생성하지 않는다. z-61이 붙은 내부 div(line 53)는 position 관련 클래스가 전혀 없어 static이므로 z-index가 애초에 적용될 수 없는 요소이기도 하다. 현재는 부모(OrderDetailModal, z-50 fixed)의 자손으로만 렌더링되고 자신도 fixed(line 49-50)라서 DOM 순서상 우연히 위에 그려지지만, 의도한 z-index 제어는 전혀 동작하지 않는다. (evidence: BusinessQuickView.tsx line 50 (`z-60`), line 53 (`z-61`, position 클래스 없음). tailwind.config.js에 zIndex 확장 없음을 grep으로 확인.)
recommendation: Replace z-60/z-61 with bracket syntax (z-[60]/z-[61]) or the nearest standard scale value (z-50/z-40 relative to the parent's z-50), and ensure the line-53 div actually needs stacking (it's currently position:static so also add a position class if the layer is meant to be controlled).

title: 발주 상세 모달 헤더의 진행률/단계 완료 수가 실시간 입력을 반영하지 않고 저장 전까지 정체됨
description: 헤더의 'N/M 단계 완료' 텍스트(362-368행)와 진행률 바(379-392행)는 최초 로드시 서버에서 받은 data.workflow.completed_steps/total_steps/progress_percentage를 그대로 렌더링하며 loadOrderDetail() 재호출 전까지 갱신되지 않는다. 반면 각 단계 카드의 체크 아이콘/테두리(line 555, isStepCompleted = !!stepDates[step.field])는 로컬 state stepDates를 실시간 참조한다. 사용자가 날짜를 입력하면 단계 카드는 즉시 초록 체크로 바뀌지만 헤더 숫자와 진행률 바는 저장(handleSave→loadOrderDetail) 전까지 이전 값 그대로 남아 두 UI 요소가 모순된 정보를 보여준다. (evidence: OrderDetailModal.tsx lines 362-368, 385 (data.workflow.* 참조, data state는 loadOrderDetail에서만 갱신됨을 확인 - line 89), line 555 (isStepCompleted가 로컬 stepDates 참조).)
recommendation: Compute completed_steps/total_steps/progress_percentage for the header from the local stepDates state (e.g. Object.values(stepDates).filter(Boolean).length) instead of the stale data.workflow snapshot, so the header updates in lockstep with the per-step check icons.

title: 타 제조사 발주서 생성 시 이력 저장 API의 응답 상태를 확인하지 않아 실패해도 성공 메시지가 표시됨
description: 244-260행의 fetch('/api/document-automation/history', ...) 호출은 response.ok를 검사하지 않는다. fetch는 401/500 등 HTTP 오류 상태에서 예외를 던지지 않으므로 261-263행의 catch(console.error만 수행)는 실행되지 않고, 곧바로 265행에서 '발주서 PDF가 생성되었습니다.' 성공 알림이 무조건 표시된다. (evidence: 244-260행에서 fetch 응답을 await만 하고 response.ok/status 검사 코드가 전혀 없음을 확인. 265행 alert가 fetch 결과와 무관하게 무조건 실행됨을 확인.)
recommendation: Check response.ok (or response.status) on the history-save fetch before showing the '발주서 PDF가 생성되었습니다' alert, and show an error alert instead when it fails, matching the existing catch-block pattern already present just below.

title: 제5조 품질보증 비율의 fallback 기본값('5')이 신규 착공신고서 폼의 기본값('10')과 불일치
description: ConstructionReportManagement.tsx는 새 착공신고서 작성 시 contract_bond_rate 초기값을 항상 '10'으로 설정한다(147, 352행). 반면 ContractGovernmentTemplate.tsx(251행)와 ContractBusinessTemplate.tsx(300행)의 제5조는 `data.contract_bond_rate || '5'`로 폴백 기본값을 '5'로 사용한다. 이 필드가 없는(도입 이전) report_data를 이력에서 재조회하여 미리보기(1269, 1280행에서 selectedReport.report_data를 그대로 템플릿에 전달, 폼의 '10' 폴백을 거치지 않음)할 경우 제4조(항상 10% 하드코딩)와 제5조(폴백 5%)가 서로 다른 비율을 표시한다. (evidence: ConstructionReportManagement.tsx 147행, 352행에서 contract_bond_rate 기본값 '10' 확인. ContractGovernmentTemplate.tsx 251행, ContractBusinessTemplate.tsx 300행에서 폴백 '5' 확인. ConstructionReportManagement.tsx 1269, 1280행에서 이력 미리보기 시 selectedReport.report_data를 그대로(폼의 '10' 기본값 경유 없이) 템플릿에 전달함을 확인.)
recommendation: Change the fallback in both templates' 제5조 (`data.contract_bond_rate || '5'`) to `|| '10'` to match the form's actual default in ConstructionReportManagement.tsx (lines 147, 352); this is a one-word fallback-value fix in two files, low risk since it only affects records with an unset contract_bond_rate.

title: 죽은 코드 lib/invoice-receivables.ts가 'Single Source of Truth'를 자처하지만 실제로는 미사용이며 receivables-engine.ts와 로직이 갈라져 있음
description: 헤더 주석(1-11행)은 '테이블과 모달 모두 이 함수를 사용'한다고 주장하나 grep 결과 저장소 어디에서도 import되지 않는 완전한 죽은 코드다. computeReceivables()는 contractAmount>0으로 호출되면(122행 if(!baseAmount) 스킵) extra 계산서 금액을 baseAmount에 더하지 않아(149행에서만 fallback 분기 한정 반영), receivables-engine.ts의 computeBusinessReceivableNow(항상 extraSupplyTotal 반영, 154-160행)와 값이 갈라진다. (evidence: grep -rln "invoice-receivables" 결과 lib/invoice-receivables.ts 자기 자신 외 참조 없음(완전 미사용 확인). 122-150행: contractAmount가 0이 아니면 baseAmount=contractAmount 그대로 사용, extra 계산서는 fallback(!baseAmount) 분기에서만 144-146행에 반영.)
recommendation: Since grep confirms lib/invoice-receivables.ts has zero importers, either delete the dead file or fix its header comment and extra-invoice handling to match receivables-engine.ts — either way there are no live call sites to regress.

title: 매출 계산 조회 API가 limit/offset 파라미터를 파싱만 하고 실제 쿼리에는 적용하지 않음
description: GET 핸들러는 limit/offset을 쿼리 파라미터에서 읽지만(180-181행) 실제 SQL은 LIMIT/OFFSET 절 없이 전체 필터 결과를 반환한다(214-219행). 응답의 pagination.has_more: calculations.length === limit(272행)도 실제 페이지네이션과 무관하게 계산되어 부정확하다. 현재 프런트(app/admin/revenue/page.tsx)는 limit/offset을 보내지 않아 당장은 영향이 적다. (evidence: calculate/route.ts 180-181행 limit/offset 파싱, 214-219행 SQL에 LIMIT/OFFSET 부재, 272행 has_more 계산이 실제 페이지네이션과 무관.)
recommendation: Append parameterized LIMIT/OFFSET clauses to the raw SQL in app/api/revenue/calculate/route.ts and compute has_more by fetching limit+1 rows (or a separate COUNT) instead of comparing calculations.length to limit.

title: Participant role fallback order differs between create and edit pages for the same feature
description: toggleInternalParticipant in create/page.tsx sets `role: employee.position || employee.department || ''` (position preferred), while the equivalent function in app/admin/meeting-minutes/[id]/edit/page.tsx sets `role: employee.department || employee.position || ''` (department preferred, confirmed at line 326). For an employee with both fields set, the stored participant.role text depends on whether they were added while creating vs. editing a meeting, producing inconsistent role labels for the same employee across different meetings' participant cards. (evidence: create/page.tsx line 143: `role: employee.position || employee.department || ''`. edit/page.tsx line 326: `role: employee.department || employee.position || ''`. Both are the only role-assignment lines for internal-participant toggling in their respective files.)
recommendation: Pick one canonical fallback order (position || department, matching create/page.tsx) and apply it in both create/page.tsx and edit/page.tsx's participant-role-assignment code.

title: Negative days-elapsed produces a nonsensical '-N일 전' label for future-dated regular meetings
description: daysElapsed = Math.floor((today.getTime() - meetingDate.getTime()) / (1000*60*60*24)) has no clamp at 0 and no guard for meetings scheduled in the future. A pre-created future-dated 정기회의 (status draft, not archived) with an incomplete business issue or sub-100% agenda item produces a negative daysElapsed. I confirmed getDaysElapsedLabel in RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx (lines 24-30) has no negative-number branch: for days=-1, `days===0` is false, `days===1` is false, `days<7` is true (since -1<7), so it renders `${days}일 전` = '-1일 전', a nonsensical label. The same pattern exists in RecurringIssueCard.tsx (confirmed getDaysElapsedLabel/getDaysElapsedColor both consume days_elapsed directly with no negative guard). (evidence: recurring-issues/route.ts line 134: `const daysElapsed = Math.floor((today.getTime() - meetingDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))` with no Math.max(0, ...) guard. RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx lines 24-30: `if (days === 0) return '오늘'; if (days === 1) return '1일 전'; if (days < 7) return \`${days}일 전\`; ...` — negative values fall into the `days < 7` branch.)
recommendation: Clamp daysElapsed with Math.max(0, ...) in recurring-issues/route.ts and add a matching negative-value guard to getDaysElapsedLabel/getDaysElapsedColor in both RecurringIssuesPanel.tsx and RecurringIssueCard.tsx.

title: Third StatCard on the detail page shows in_progress_tasks count under an "average days" label
description: `<StatCard icon={Clock} label={`평균 ${report.average_completion_time_days}일`} value={report.in_progress_tasks} color="yellow" />`. StatCard (lines 98-125) renders `value` as the large headline number and `label` as the small caption. So the big number shown is the in-progress task COUNT while the caption reads '평균 X일' (average days) — a completely different metric — and there is no card labeled '진행중' on its own. (evidence: app/admin/weekly-reports/[userId]/page.tsx:305 swaps in_progress_tasks into the `value` prop under an average-days `label`; StatCard's render at lines 112-124 confirms value is the headline number.)
recommendation: Swap the StatCard props so `value={report.in_progress_tasks}` is paired with a '진행중' label, and give the average-completion-time metric its own StatCard with `value={report.average_completion_time_days}`.

title: 임포트 오류 행 번호가 실제 청크 크기(200)와 다른 상수(1000)로 계산됨
description: components/dpf/DpfImportUploader.tsx 28행의 CHUNK_SIZE는 200인데, app/api/dpf/import/route.ts 30행은 row_index: chunkIndex * 1000 + i 로 계산한다. 두 번째 청크(chunkIndex=1, 실제 행 201~400번)에서 오류가 나면 row_index가 1000~1199 값으로 저장되어 DpfImportUploader.tsx 303행의 오류 내역("행 {e.rowIndex}")에 잘못된 행 번호가 그대로 노출된다. (evidence: components/dpf/DpfImportUploader.tsx:28 (CHUNK_SIZE = 200), app/api/dpf/import/route.ts:30 (chunkIndex * 1000 + i), components/dpf/DpfImportUploader.tsx:303 (행 {e.rowIndex} 그대로 노출).)
recommendation: Change app/api/dpf/import/route.ts:30 to use `chunkIndex * 200 + i` (or import a shared CHUNK_SIZE constant) so row_index matches the client's actual 200-row chunk size.

title: 'prev_plate' 렌더링 분기가 COLUMNS 목록에 없어 절대 표시되지 않는 죽은 코드
description: cellValue()의 switch문 95행에 case 'prev_plate'가 정의되어 있지만, 실제 렌더링에 쓰이는 COLUMNS 배열(22-42행)에는 'prev_plate' 키가 없다. 209-213행은 COLUMNS.map(col => cellValue(v, col.key))만 호출하므로 이 case는 절대 실행되지 않으며, raw_data의 '이전 차량번호' 값을 목록 화면에서 볼 방법이 없다. (evidence: components/dpf/DpfVehicleTable.tsx:22-42 (COLUMNS에 prev_plate 없음), 95 (case 'prev_plate' 존재), 209-213 (COLUMNS.map으로만 렌더링, 도달 불가).)
recommendation: Decide with the product owner whether '이전 차량번호' should be visible, then either add a 'prev_plate' entry to the COLUMNS array in DpfVehicleTable.tsx or delete the unreachable case 'prev_plate' branch.

title: 차량 생성/수정 API가 vendor 값을 'fujino'|'mz'로 검증하지 않음
description: POST의 `vendor: vendor || 'fujino'`(vehicles/route.ts 33행)와 PUT의 `if (vendor !== undefined) updateData.vendor = vendor;`(vehicles/[vin]/route.ts 32행) 모두 vendor 값이 'fujino'|'mz' 두 값인지 검증하지 않는다. app/dpf/[vin]/page.tsx의 ALL_TABS 필터(`tabs.vendors.includes(vehicle.vendor ?? 'fujino')`)는 정확히 이 두 문자열만 매칭하므로, API를 직접 호출해 다른 문자열을 저장하면 탭 필터 결과가 빈 배열이 되어 탭 바가 통째로 사라진다. UI(VehicleFormModal.tsx)는 라디오 버튼으로 두 값만 보내지만 서버 계층에 방어가 없다. (evidence: app/api/dpf/vehicles/route.ts:33 (vendor 검증 없이 저장), app/api/dpf/vehicles/[vin]/route.ts:32 (vendor 검증 없이 업데이트), components/dpf/VehicleFormModal.tsx:24,249-252 (UI는 타입으로 제한하지만 서버 미검증), app/dpf/[vin]/page.tsx:142 (vendor 값에 의존하는 탭 필터).)
recommendation: In both app/api/dpf/vehicles/route.ts (POST) and app/api/dpf/vehicles/[vin]/route.ts (PUT), validate vendor is one of ['fujino','mz'] and return 400 otherwise, matching the UI's radio-button restriction.

title: 임포트 처리 전 카운트 쿼리 오류가 무시되고 '처리할 데이터 없음'으로 오표시됨
description: batchId에 해당하는 대기 행 수를 조회하는 supabaseAdmin.from('dpf_import_staging').select(...).eq(...).eq('status','pending') 호출(19-23행)에서 반환값 중 error가 구조분해되지 않고 버려진다. 쿼리 자체가 실패하면 count는 null이 되고 `if (!count)`(25행)가 참이 되어 실제 원인과 무관한 '처리할 데이터가 없습니다' 메시지가 노출되며 실제 DB 오류는 로그에도 남지 않는다. (evidence: app/api/dpf/import/process/route.ts:19-23 (error 구조분해 없이 count만 사용), 25-27 (!count 시 '처리할 데이터가 없습니다' 반환, 실제 오류 원인 미기록).)
recommendation: In app/api/dpf/import/process/route.ts, destructure and log `error` from the pending-count query, and only return the '처리할 데이터가 없습니다' message when error is null and count is exactly 0.

title: Sidebar tree 'active' highlighting uses substring match, causing the parent root node to always be highlighted alongside any open chapter
description: `const isActive = pathname.includes(node.slug ?? node.id)` uses substring containment. Because chapter slugs are generated as `${rootSlug}-ch${i+1}-${titleSlug}` (app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts line 233), the root node's slug is structurally always a literal prefix of every one of its children's slugs. So whenever a user is on any chapter page (e.g. /wiki/guideline-2026-dpf-ch3-신청절차), `pathname.includes(rootNode.slug)` is also true, causing the root tree entry to render with the same active/highlighted styling as the actually-open chapter — a guaranteed, reproducible mis-highlight, not just an edge case. (The specific ch1-vs-ch10 numeric-prefix example given in the original report does not actually collide, since the divergent character after 'ch1' is '-' in the ch1 slug vs '0' in the ch10 slug — but the root/child collision described here is real and easily reproduced.) (evidence: components/wiki/WikiNodeTree.tsx line 24: `pathname.includes(node.slug ?? node.id)`. app/api/wiki/upload-guideline/route.ts line 206 (`rootSlug = ...`) and line 233 (`chSlug = \`${rootSlug}-ch${i + 1}-...\``) confirm rootSlug is always a literal string prefix of every chSlug, and WikiNodeTree recursively renders both root and child TreeNode components from the same nodes tree (app/wiki/page.tsx buildTree + components/wiki/WikiNodeTree.tsx lines 50-54), so both are independently subject to the same `isActive` check.)
recommendation: Replace the substring check `pathname.includes(node.slug ?? node.id)` in WikiNodeTree.tsx with an exact match like `pathname === `/wiki/${node.slug ?? node.id}`` so the root node no longer highlights alongside its open chapters.

title: Unauthenticated diagnostic endpoint triggers real embedding API calls and leaks internal DB counts
description: POST /api/wiki/debug has no authentication check despite the file's own comment calling it a temporary diagnostic endpoint. Every call generates a live Gemini embedding and performs Supabase RPC + raw fetch calls with the service-role key, returning internal published/unpublished node counts and RPC error details. (evidence: app/api/wiki/debug/route.ts line 1 comment ('임시 진단 엔드포인트') and lines 9-91: POST handler has no auth check; line 34 calls `getEmbedding(question, 'query')` (real API call) and lines 74-90 return `nodes: { published, unpublished }` and `rpc_error` details in the JSON response with no auth gate.)
recommendation: Either delete this diagnostic route entirely (it's explicitly labeled temporary) or gate it behind the same JWT + permission_level>=4 check used elsewhere in the wiki API, to stop unauthenticated callers from triggering billed embedding calls and leaking node counts.

title: Notification history search/type/priority/days filters are parsed but never applied to the query
description: GET parses search, type, priority, and days from query params (lines 54-57) and computes startDate, but the actual task_notifications query at lines 92-98 (`.eq('user_id', user.id).order('created_at', {ascending:false})`) applies none of them — no date range, no text search, no type/priority filter. The response nonetheless echoes back `filters: {search, type, priority, days}` (line 195), making it look like filtering happened. This route is reachable via lib/hooks/useSimpleNotifications.ts:317,340, but that hook is only imported by components/ui/StableNotificationButton.tsx and components/notifications/RealtimeNotificationBell.tsx, neither of which is rendered anywhere in the current app (no importers found in app/ or components/ outside themselves), so this is currently dead code with no live user impact. (evidence: history/route.ts:54-57 parses filters; the query at :92-98 uses only `.eq('user_id', user.id)` with no date/search/type/priority clause; :195 echoes the unused filters back to the client. grep confirms useSimpleNotifications.ts's only importers (StableNotificationButton.tsx, RealtimeNotificationBell.tsx) are themselves unreferenced anywhere in app/ or components/.)
recommendation: Apply the already-parsed search/type/priority/days filters to the task_notifications query (ilike on title/message, .eq on type/priority, and a computed startDate .gte on created_at) instead of only returning them unused in the response metadata.

title: /api/notifications/simple GET excludes notifications with no expiration date (NULL expires_at)
description: The general-notifications query uses `.gte('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())` (line 116). In PostgREST/Postgres, a NULL column value never satisfies a `>=` comparison, so any notification row with expires_at = NULL is silently excluded from results — every other live notifications query in this codebase (app/api/notifications/route.ts:232,394; lib/hooks/useSimpleNotifications.ts) instead uses `.or('expires_at.is.null,expires_at.gt....')` specifically to include never-expiring notifications. No frontend code in this repo currently calls /api/notifications/simple (no importer found for this path), so this is presently dead code with no live user impact; it would surface immediately if any client started using this endpoint. (evidence: simple/route.ts:116 `.gte('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())` on the `notifications` select at :96-118, contrasted with the null-inclusive `.or('expires_at.is.null,expires_at.gt.${now}')` pattern used at app/api/notifications/route.ts:394. grep across the repo found no fetch() call to '/api/notifications/simple' anywhere outside its own route file.)
recommendation: Change `.gte('expires_at', now)` to `.or('expires_at.is.null,expires_at.gt.' + now)` to match the null-inclusive pattern already used in app/api/notifications/route.ts, so never-expiring notifications aren't silently dropped if this endpoint is ever wired up.

title: /api/notifications/simple read/delete endpoints report success even when zero rows were actually affected
description: POST (individual read) and DELETE both treat a Promise.allSettled 'fulfilled' status as success (lines 363, 434), but a Supabase update()/delete() whose WHERE clause matches 0 rows (e.g. wrong id, or a notification owned by a different user) still resolves as 'fulfilled' with empty data and no error — so updatedCount is incremented / deleteSuccess is set true even when nothing was changed, and the client receives a misleading '읽음 처리되었습니다'/'삭제되었습니다' success message. This endpoint currently has no live frontend caller in the repo (same reachability gap as the other /api/notifications/simple issues), so it has no active user-facing impact today. (evidence: simple/route.ts:363 `if (generalResult.status === 'fulfilled' || taskResult.status === 'fulfilled') updatedCount++;` and :434 `const deleteSuccess = generalResult.status === 'fulfilled' || taskResult.status === 'fulfilled';` — neither checks the actual affected-row count from the Supabase response. No caller of this route found elsewhere in the repo.)
recommendation: Check the actual `data`/row count returned by each Promise.allSettled result (not just its 'fulfilled' status) before incrementing updatedCount or setting deleteSuccess, so a 0-row match doesn't get reported as a successful read/delete.

title: Default tier-notification category 'general' is not a recognized NotificationCategory, so its label renders blank
description: createTierNotification's caller defaults `category: category || 'general'` (line 481) when POST /api/notifications is called with notification_tier set but no category. 'general' is not a member of the NotificationCategory union in contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:12-19, nor a key in categoryLabels in app/notifications/page.tsx:28-47, so `categoryLabels[notification.category]` (page.tsx:424) renders undefined/blank for such a notification in the list UI. In the current codebase this path is currently masked: the same createTierNotification INSERT also references the nonexistent 'created_by' column (see the companion high-severity finding), so the insert fails with a 500 before a 'general'-category row could ever actually be persisted — this bug would only start manifesting for real users once the created_by/created_by_id mismatch is fixed. (evidence: route.ts:481 `category: category || 'general'`. contexts/NotificationContext.tsx:12-19 NotificationCategory union has no 'general' member. app/notifications/page.tsx:28-47 categoryLabels map has no 'general' key, and line 424 does `categoryLabels[notification.category]` with no fallback.)
recommendation: Change the default category fallback from 'general' to an existing member of the NotificationCategory union (and matching key in categoryLabels), and apply this alongside the fix for finding #7 so the corrected insert path doesn't immediately introduce a blank-label regression.

title: Push subscription settings panel would show "Invalid Date" for last update (field never returned by the API) — currently dead code
description: PushNotificationSettings renders `formatDate(subscriptionInfo.updated_at)` (line 179) for '마지막 업데이트', but GET /api/push-subscription (app/api/push-subscription/route.ts:171-181) only ever returns `{created_at, last_used_at, endpoint}` on subscriptionInfo — there is no updated_at field. formatDate does `new Date(undefined).toLocaleString('ko-KR')` with no guard (line 89-91), which renders the literal string "Invalid Date". However, this component is not imported/rendered anywhere in the live app — grep across app/ and components/ (excluding the component's own file) found zero importers, and it is not wired into app/notifications/settings/page.tsx, so no real user currently sees this defect. (evidence: PushNotificationSettings.tsx:179 `formatDate(subscriptionInfo.updated_at)`; push-subscription/route.ts:171-181 GET response only includes created_at/last_used_at/endpoint. formatDate at :89-91 has no undefined guard. grep found no importer of PushNotificationSettings anywhere in app/ or components/ outside itself, and app/notifications/settings/page.tsx does not reference it.)
recommendation: Either add `updated_at` to the GET /api/push-subscription response or change the component to display the already-returned `last_used_at`/`created_at` field instead, and add an undefined guard in formatDate so it never renders the literal 'Invalid Date' string.

title: Push subscription status check can under-report as unsubscribed due to an unawaited init race — currently dead code
description: isSubscribed() returns false immediately if `this.registration` is still null (line 227-229), and registration is only set inside requestPermission() or ensureSubscription() (line 266). components/providers/ClientProviders.tsx:25-27 fires `pushNotificationManager.ensureSubscription()` from inside a dynamic import `.then()` with no await, and usePushNotifications()'s effect (lines 313-319) calls isSubscribed() once on mount with no retry. If a component using this hook mounts before ensureSubscription()'s internal `await navigator.serviceWorker.ready` resolves, isSubscribed() reads a still-null registration and reports not-subscribed even though a real subscription exists. This hook (usePushNotifications) is currently only consumed by PushNotificationSettings.tsx, which — as noted in the companion finding — is not rendered anywhere in the live app, so this race has no current user-facing effect. (evidence: push-notifications.ts:226-233 `if (!this.registration) return false;`; ClientProviders.tsx:25-27 calls ensureSubscription() unawaited inside a .then(); usePushNotifications():313-319 calls isSubscribed() once on mount with no retry. grep confirms usePushNotifications is imported only by PushNotificationSettings.tsx, which has no live importers.)
recommendation: In lib/push-notifications.ts, make isSubscribed() await service-worker readiness (or an explicit init Promise set by ensureSubscription()/requestPermission()) before reading this.registration, and address it opportunistically since usePushNotifications currently has no live renderer.

title: 차트 loadData()에 요청 취소/순서 보장이 없어 빠른 연속 클릭 시 오래된 응답이 최신 응답을 덮어쓸 수 있음
description: RevenueChart/ReceivableChart/InstallationChart/MonthlyLeadsChart/WeeklyScorecard의 loadData()는 모두 AbortController나 요청 세대 체크 없이 fetch→setState 패턴을 쓴다. periodPreset 버튼을 빠르게 연속 클릭하면 여러 fetch가 동시에 진행되어, 네트워크 타이밍에 따라 마지막 클릭이 아닌 마지막 도착 응답이 최종 화면을 결정할 수 있다. (evidence: grep 결과 components/dashboard/ 전체에서 AbortController/signal 사용 0건. RevenueChart.tsx L46-74, ReceivableChart.tsx L45, InstallationChart.tsx L45, MonthlyLeadsChart.tsx L303 모두 동일하게 취소 로직 없는 `await fetch(...).then(setState)` 패턴.)
recommendation: Add an AbortController (or an incrementing request-id ref checked before setState) to loadData() in RevenueChart, ReceivableChart, InstallationChart, MonthlyLeadsChart, and WeeklyScorecard so a stale response from a rapid preset click can't overwrite a newer one; this is purely additive and doesn't change existing business logic.

title: Social account unlink API reads a cookie name ('auth-token') no live login path sets, making it always 401
description: DELETE reads only request.cookies.get('auth-token') (hyphen) with no Authorization header fallback. The standard login sets 'session_token'; the Kakao callback sets 'auth_token' (underscore). Only the kakao-simple/google-simple/naver-simple routes set 'auth-token' (hyphen). Grep of app/ and components/ found zero frontend callers of this endpoint, so this is confirmed dead code rather than an active outage; kept at low rather than medium given no live user path is affected either way. (evidence: Line 13 `request.cookies.get('auth-token')?.value` with no Authorization fallback; app/api/auth/login/route.ts:196 sets session_token; app/api/auth/social/kakao/callback/route.ts:274,303 sets auth_token (underscore); grep for '/api/auth/social/unlink' across app/ and components/ returned no results.)
recommendation: Change the DELETE handler to read 'session_token' (or accept an Authorization header) instead of the unused 'auth-token' cookie name; confirmed dead code with no frontend caller today.

title: handleUserToggle silently does nothing on failure
description: handleUserToggle only has `if (response.ok) { ...update state...; alert(success) }` with no else branch, unlike handleUserEdit and handleApprovalAction-adjacent handlers in the same file that alert() on failure paths. (evidence: Read the function directly: after the fetch, only `if (response.ok)` is present; there is no else clause, so a 401/403/500 response produces zero UI feedback.)
recommendation: Add an else branch to handleUserToggle that alert()s the error text on non-ok responses, matching the pattern used elsewhere on this page.

title: 담당자 변경 히스토리 삭제 시 count 옵션 누락으로 삭제 건수가 항상 null로 표시됨
description: DELETE 핸들러는 `.delete()`에 count 옵션(`{ count: 'exact' }`)을 지정하지 않고 `const { error, count } = await query`로 count를 사용해 응답 메시지와 deleted_count를 채운다. supabase-js는 count 옵션 없이는 count를 항상 null로 반환하므로 삭제 자체는 정상 수행되지만 응답은 항상 'null개의 담당자 변경 히스토리가 정리되었습니다.'와 deleted_count: null을 반환한다. (evidence: 376-400행을 직접 읽음: `.delete().eq('change_type', 'assignment_change')` 체인에 count 옵션이 없고, 389행 `const { error, count } = await query`, 397-400행에서 이 count를 그대로 메시지/응답에 사용함을 확인.)
recommendation: Add `{ count: 'exact' }` to the .delete() call in the DELETE handler so the returned count reflects actual deleted rows instead of always being null.

title: InvoiceManagement.tsx gates invoice-card rendering on business_category instead of progress_status, so cards never render for real data (dead code)
description: Lines 273 and 308 render subsidy/self-pay invoice cards via `business.business_category === '보조금'` / `=== '자비'`. app/api/business-invoices/route.ts (the actual data source, line 70) contains the explicit comment 'progress_status(진행구분)를 사용 (business_category는 대기필증 종별이므로 무관)' -- confirming business_category holds air-permit-type classification, not the subsidy/self-pay distinction. Since business_category will essentially never literally equal '보조금' or '자비' for real records, neither branch matches and the invoice card list silently renders nothing, even though invoiceData/totalReceivables load correctly. Confirmed via grep that InvoiceManagement.tsx is not imported by any other file in the codebase (`grep -rl InvoiceManagement app components` returns only the file itself), so this is currently dead code with no live user impact. (evidence: components/business/InvoiceManagement.tsx lines 273 and 308 use `business.business_category === '보조금'/'자비'`; app/api/business-invoices/route.ts line 70 comment explicitly states business_category is unrelated to subsidy/self-pay classification and that progress_status is the correct field. grep -rl 'InvoiceManagement' over app/ and components/ returns only the component's own file.)
recommendation: Change the two gating conditions in InvoiceManagement.tsx to check business.progress_status === '보조금'/'자비' instead of business_category, per the comment in business-invoices/route.ts; low impact since the component is currently unused/unimported anywhere.

title: business-contacts POST upserts business_info using Korean keys that are not real column names (always fails, dead code)
description: The POST handler upserts into `business_info` using keys 주소, 담당자명, 담당자연락처, 사업장연락처, 사업자등록번호, 대표자, 업종 (lines 164-170). Confirmed via lib/supabase-business.ts, business-info-direct/route.ts's selectFields, and the db-schema skill that business_info's real columns are the English equivalents (address, manager_name, manager_contact, business_contact, business_registration_number, representative_name, business_type). A Supabase upsert with nonexistent column keys will fail at the DB layer (Postgrest returns a 'column does not exist' style error), which the catch block (lines 201-217) will surface as a generic 500 unless it happens to match the PGRST205 'table not found' branch (which it will not, since business_info exists). Confirmed via grep that this route is not referenced anywhere in app/components/hooks/lib, so it is currently dead code with no live impact. (evidence: app/api/business-contacts/route.ts lines 160-176 (upsert object literal with Korean keys 주소/담당자명/담당자연락처/사업장연락처/사업자등록번호/대표자/업종 against the business_info table). db-schema skill and app/api/business-info-direct/route.ts's selectFields (lines 171-252) confirm business_info's actual columns are address/manager_name/manager_contact/business_contact/business_registration_number/representative_name/business_type. grep -rl 'business-contacts' over app/components/hooks/lib found only the route file itself, no callers.)
recommendation: Rename the Korean upsert keys in business-contacts/route.ts POST to the real English column names (address, manager_name, manager_contact, business_contact, business_registration_number, representative_name, business_type); safe since the route has no current callers.

title: business-equipment-counts PUT overwrites additional_info wholesale instead of merging (currently unreferenced by frontend)
description: The update object sets `additional_info: { equipment_summary: {...} }` directly (lines 38-44) as the entire new column value, without first reading and spreading the existing additional_info JSONB. Confirmed that other live code paths store/read other keys under the same column: app/admin/business/hooks/useBusinessData.ts line 22 and app/api/business-unified/route.ts line 127 both do `business.additional_info?.contacts || []`. If this PUT endpoint were invoked for a business whose additional_info.contacts is already populated, that data would be silently replaced and lost. Confirmed via grep that this route is currently referenced only in lib/security/csrf-protection.ts's exclusion list (comment '공개 사용') and nowhere in any frontend fetch call, so there is no live user impact today, but the defect is real if the route is ever wired up or called externally. (evidence: app/api/business-equipment-counts/route.ts lines 25-49: the Supabase .update() call sets additional_info to a brand-new object `{equipment_summary: {...}}` with no spread of prior additional_info. app/admin/business/hooks/useBusinessData.ts:22 and app/api/business-unified/route.ts:127 both read `business.additional_info?.contacts`, confirming other keys are expected to coexist under additional_info. grep -rl 'business-equipment-counts' over app/components/lib/hooks found only the route file and its CSRF-exclusion-list entry in lib/security/csrf-protection.ts:106 -- no frontend fetch callers.)
recommendation: In business-equipment-counts/route.ts PUT, first read the existing additional_info for the business and spread it before overwriting, e.g. `additional_info: {...existing, equipment_summary: {...}}`; safe since the route is currently unreferenced by any frontend caller.

title: Bulk-upload chunk progress message is set but never rendered; type mismatch on setIsUploading
description: isUploading is declared as boolean state (useState(false)) but line 266 calls setIsUploading with a template-literal progress string during sequential chunk upload. Reproduced with `npx tsc --noEmit`: TS2345 'string' not assignable to 'SetStateAction<boolean>'. Confirmed next.config.js sets typescript.ignoreBuildErrors:true, masking this at build/deploy. At runtime the string is stored but the button JSX at line 511 only ever renders the static text '업로드 중...', never reading the stored progress string, so per-chunk progress feedback never reaches the user. (evidence: Read components/tasks/BulkUploadModal.tsx line 26 (`useState(false)`), line 266 (`setIsUploading(\`업로드 중... (${chunkNumber}/${chunks.length})\`)`), line 511 (`{isUploading ? '업로드 중...' : ...}`). Ran `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and got the exact reported error at BulkUploadModal.tsx(266,24). Confirmed next.config.js line 18 `ignoreBuildErrors: true`.)
recommendation: Split state into `isUploading: boolean` plus a separate `uploadProgress: string` state, set the latter during chunk upload, and render `uploadProgress` in the button text instead of the static '업로드 중...' label.

title: SSE /api/tasks/stream never removes disconnected clients due to wrong `this` binding in cancel()
description: cancel() is a shorthand method on the object literal passed to new ReadableStream({...}), so `this` refers to that source object, not the controller instance added to the module-level clients Set inside start(controller). `clients.delete(this as any)` is therefore always a no-op on clean disconnect; stale controllers remain in the Set until broadcastToClients's enqueue() throws and removes them via its own catch block. The route also has zero authentication and mutates a shared in-memory mock array across all callers, though grep confirms no active frontend code currently calls this endpoint (only stale .next type-generation output under a worktree), limiting practical exposure. (evidence: Read app/api/tasks/stream/route.ts lines 91-116: `clients.add(controller)` inside start(), `cancel() { clients.delete(this as any) ... }` at 111-115 — `this` inside a shorthand method on the ReadableStream source object binds to that object literal, never the controller. Grepped repo-wide for 'api/tasks/stream' and found no active frontend fetch/EventSource usage, only .next generated type files under .claude/worktrees/.)
recommendation: Capture the controller in a local closure variable inside `start(controller)` and reference that variable (not `this`) inside `cancel()` so `clients.delete(...)` actually removes the disconnected client.

title: lib/invoice-receivables.ts — 참조되지 않는 죽은 코드에 'Single Source of Truth' 주석이 오도됨
description: 파일 헤더(1-12행)는 '미수금 계산 핵심 로직 — 단일 진실 공급원(SSOT)... 테이블(revenue page)과 모달(business-invoices API) 모두 이 함수를 사용합니다'라고 명시하지만, export async function computeReceivables()(51행)는 app/, lib/, components/ 전체에서 어디에서도 import되지 않는 완전한 dead code다. 실제 SSOT는 lib/receivables-engine.ts의 computeBusinessReceivableNow/AsOf이며, business-invoices/batch, dashboard/receivables, dashboard/weekly-scorecard가 이를 사용한다. (evidence: grep -rn "invoice-receivables|computeReceivables" (파일 자신 제외)를 app/lib/components 전역에 실행한 결과 0건 — 어디서도 import되지 않음을 확인. grep -rln "receivables-engine" 결과 app/api/business-invoices/batch/route.ts, app/api/dashboard/receivables/route.ts, app/api/dashboard/weekly-scorecard/route.ts, lib/revenue-tools.ts에서 실제로 사용됨을 확인해, 헤더 주석이 가리키는 '테이블/모달' 소비처가 실제로는 receivables-engine.ts를 쓰고 있음을 검증.)
recommendation: Delete the unused `computeReceivables()` export (and file, if nothing else lives in it) since grep confirms zero importers and lib/receivables-engine.ts is the actual consumed SSOT; safe to remove with no functional impact.

title: ProjectCard의 ⋮ 드롭다운 메뉴에 외부 클릭 닫기 핸들러가 없어 메뉴가 계속 열려있음
description: showMenu 상태(29행)를 토글하는 드롭다운(134-176행)이 외부 클릭을 감지해 닫는 useEffect+mousedown 리스너를 전혀 갖고 있지 않다. 같은 프로젝트의 components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx(89-103행)나 components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx(62행 이하)는 동일한 패턴을 useRef+document.addEventListener('mousedown', ...)로 구현하고 있어 이 컴포넌트에서만 누락된 것이 확인된다. 재현: ⋮ 버튼으로 메뉴를 연 뒤 메뉴 바깥을 클릭해도 메뉴가 닫히지 않고 계속 표시된다. (evidence: ProjectCard.tsx 전체에서 'useEffect|mousedown|useRef|addEventListener' grep 결과 0건 확인(29행 showMenu state, 134-176행 드롭다운 렌더링부와 대조). 동일 도메인 컴포넌트(inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx 89-103행)에는 정상적으로 외부 클릭 핸들러가 구현되어 있음을 확인해 대비.)
recommendation: Add a useRef + document mousedown listener to close the ⋮ dropdown on outside click, copying the existing pattern from components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx.

title: BulkUploadModal의 청크 업로드 진행률 텍스트가 boolean state에 저장되어 화면에 표시되지 않음
description: line 28 `useState(false)`로 isUploading을 boolean으로 선언했는데, 청크 업로드 루프의 line 266에서 `setIsUploading(\`업로드 중... (${chunkNumber}/${chunks.length})\`)`처럼 문자열을 대입한다. 렌더링부인 line 511은 `{isUploading ? '업로드 중...' : ...}`로 값이 아닌 truthy 여부만 사용하므로, 계산된 청크 진행률 문자열('업로드 중... (2/5)' 등)은 화면에 전혀 노출되지 않고 항상 고정된 '업로드 중...' 문구만 보인다. CHUNK_SIZE(50) 초과 업무를 업로드하는 사용자는 몇 번째 청크가 처리되는지 알 수 없다. BulkUploadModal은 app/admin/tasks/page.tsx에서 실사용 중인 컴포넌트다. (evidence: components/tasks/BulkUploadModal.tsx:28 `useState(false)` (boolean 타입); line 266 `setIsUploading(\`업로드 중... (${chunkNumber}/${chunks.length})\`)`(string 대입); line 511 `{isUploading ? '업로드 중...' : ...}`(truthy 체크만, 실제 문자열 미사용); app/admin/tasks/page.tsx에서 BulkUploadModal import 확인(실사용 컴포넌트).)
recommendation: Change `isUploading` to a `string | boolean` type (or add a separate `uploadProgress` string state) and render that value in the progress UI instead of only checking truthiness.

title: AmountInput에서 금액을 0으로 입력하면 저장 후 재렌더링 시 표시값이 빈 문자열로 초기화됨
description: AmountInput의 초기 state(line 148-151)와 value prop 동기화 useEffect(line 153-156)가 모두 `value && !isNaN(n) ? n.toLocaleString() : ''` 형태로 truthy 체크를 사용한다. 사용자가 '0'을 입력하면 setAmount(line 496-498)가 `v ? parseInt(v) : null`로 저장하는데 문자열 '0'은 truthy이므로 draft에 숫자 0이 저장된다. getAmt(line 505-508)가 이 0을 그대로 반환해 부모 리렌더링 시 AmountInput에 value={0}이 다시 내려오는데, useEffect의 `value &&` 조건에서 숫자 0은 falsy로 취급되어 display가 즉시 빈 문자열로 초기화된다. 실제 draft 값(0)은 보존되어 저장 자체는 되지만, 입력창이 스스로 비워지므로 사용자는 값이 저장되지 않았다고 오인할 수 있다. BusinessInfoPanel은 app/admin/tasks/page.tsx에서 실사용 중이다. (evidence: components/tasks/BusinessInfoPanel.tsx:148-151, 153-156 `value && !isNaN(n) ? n.toLocaleString() : ''`; line 496-498 `setAmount`가 `v ? parseInt(v) : null`로 문자열 '0'(truthy)을 숫자 0으로 저장; line 505-508 `getAmt`가 `typeof v === 'number'`로 0을 그대로 반환; 숫자 0은 JS에서 falsy이므로 useEffect 재실행 시 display가 ''로 초기화됨.)
recommendation: In `AmountInput`, replace the `value && !isNaN(n)` truthy checks with explicit null/undefined/empty-string checks so a saved amount of 0 doesn't render as a blank field.

title: 결재라인 미리보기가 대표이사(ceo) 작성 문서에서도 팀장/중역/부사장 칸을 표시함
description: steps가 없는 draft 미리보기 상태에서 showTeamLeader/showExecutive/showVicePresident 계산식이 'ceo' role을 제외 목록에서 빠뜨렸다. requesterRole='ceo'일 때 showTeamLeader = ('ceo'!=='executive' && 'ceo'!=='team_leader' && 'ceo'!=='vice_president') = true, showExecutive/showVicePresident도 동일 로직으로 true가 된다. 반면 lib/approval-line.ts의 getRequiredApprovalSteps()와 ApproverSelector.tsx의 getRequiredSteps()는 role==='ceo'를 'vice_president'와 동일하게 취급해 모든 단계를 불필요로 처리한다(needTeamLeader/needExecutive/needVicePresident 모두 false). app/admin/approvals/new/page.tsx 315-325에서 ApprovalLineHeader는 steps를 전달하지 않고 requesterRole만 넘기므로, 대표이사가 새 문서를 작성할 때 '양식 미리보기' 섹션에는 팀장/중역/부사장 칸이 빈 상태로 표시되지만 바로 위 ApproverSelector에는 해당 입력란이 아예 렌더링되지 않는 모순이 생긴다. app/admin/approvals/[id]/page.tsx 549-553에서도 doc.steps가 빈 배열인 draft 문서에서 동일하게 재현된다. (evidence: ApprovalLineHeader.tsx:44-52의 세 삼항식 모두 requesterRole !== 'vice_president' 계열 조건만 검사하고 'ceo'를 별도 제외하지 않음. 반면 lib/approval-line.ts:10 `if (role === 'vice_president' || role === 'ceo') return {needTeamLeader:false, needExecutive:false, needVicePresident:false}`와 ApproverSelector.tsx:37 `if (role === 'vice_president' || role === 'ceo') {...}`는 'ceo'를 명시적으로 제외해 두 로직이 어긋남을 직접 확인.)
recommendation: Add `'ceo'` to the exclusion conditions in `ApprovalLineHeader.tsx` alongside `'vice_president'`, matching the already-correct logic in `lib/approval-line.ts` and `ApproverSelector.tsx`.

title: components/ui/ 내 8개 컴포넌트가 앱 어디에서도 사용되지 않는 죽은 코드
description: app/, components/, lib/, hooks/ 전체(worktree 제외)에서 파일명 문자열로 grep한 결과 AdvancedUploadProgress.tsx, GoogleSheetsImporter.tsx, InlineProgressIndicator.tsx, MobileStickyProgress.tsx, NotificationButton.tsx, OptimizedUploadDemo.tsx, SmartLoadingStates.tsx, StableNotificationButton.tsx 8개 파일 모두 자기 자신 외 어디서도 import되지 않는다. OptimizedUploadDemo.tsx만 AdvancedUploadProgress를 import하는 고립된 쌍을 이루고, StableNotificationButton.tsx 내 'NotificationButton' 매치는 StableNotificationButtonProps 등 자기 자신 이름의 부분 문자열일 뿐 실제 import가 아님을 확인했다. SmartLoadingStates.tsx는 파일 내 이름이 등장하지 않아 named export(SkeletonLoader, ImageSkeletonGrid, AdaptiveLoader, StatusIcon, UploadStatusIndicator, BatchOperationStatus, NetworkStatus) 각각을 개별 검색했으며, StatusIcon과 이름이 겹치는 외부 사용처(app/admin/tasks/[id]/page.tsx, components/FileUpload.tsx 등)는 모두 로컬 getStatusIcon 함수/변수였고 이 파일의 export를 import하는 곳은 전무했다. components/ui/ 목록만 보고 재사용 가능한 정본 컴포넌트로 오인해 죽은/미검증 코드를 새 기능에 끌어다 쓸 위험이 있다. (evidence: 각 파일명에 대해 grep -rln을 app/, components/, lib/, hooks/ 전체(node_modules, .next, .claude worktree 제외)에서 실행한 결과 자기 자신의 파일 및 OptimizedUploadDemo↔AdvancedUploadProgress 쌍 외 매치 없음을 직접 확인. SmartLoadingStates.tsx의 named export 7개도 각각 별도로 grep해 외부 import가 없음을 확인(StatusIcon 관련 매치는 전부 로컬 getStatusIcon()/const StatusIcon=...icon 패턴이었음).)
recommendation: Delete all 8 files (AdvancedUploadProgress.tsx, GoogleSheetsImporter.tsx, InlineProgressIndicator.tsx, MobileStickyProgress.tsx, NotificationButton.tsx, OptimizedUploadDemo.tsx, SmartLoadingStates.tsx, StableNotificationButton.tsx) from components/ui/ in one commit — grep confirms zero external imports (including tests/stories) and no barrel index.ts re-exports them, so removal cannot affect any runtime code path.

title: components/sections/ 내 5개 컴포넌트가 앱 어디에서도 사용되지 않는 죽은 코드
description: grep으로 확인한 결과 EquipmentFieldCheckSection.tsx, FacilityOverviewSection.tsx, FacilityPhotoUploadSection.tsx, GatewayInfoSection.tsx, SupabasePhotoUploadSection.tsx 5개 컴포넌트는 어느 페이지에서도 import되지 않는다. EquipmentFieldCheckSection은 EnhancedFacilityInfoSection.tsx 안에서 60번째 줄과 207번째 줄에 등장하지만 두 곳 모두 '// 측정기기 수량 계산 로직은 EquipmentFieldCheckSection 컴포넌트에서 독립적으로 처리'식 주석일 뿐 실제 import 구문이 아님을 직접 확인했다. (evidence: 각 파일명에 대해 grep -rln을 저장소 전체(node_modules, .next, .claude worktree 제외)에서 실행한 결과 FacilityOverviewSection, FacilityPhotoUploadSection, GatewayInfoSection, SupabasePhotoUploadSection은 자기 자신의 파일 외 매치가 전혀 없었다. EquipmentFieldCheckSection은 EnhancedFacilityInfoSection.tsx에서 매치되었으나 grep -n으로 해당 줄(60, 207)을 직접 열람해 둘 다 한글 주석 텍스트임을 확인했고 import 문은 없었다.)
