title: Currency display: dominant '원'-suffix convention vs a minority Intl.NumberFormat '₩'-symbol style, plus duplicated local formatters
description: The overwhelming convention across the codebase is `Number(x).toLocaleString() + '원'` — used in business-core's InvoiceDisplayCard/InvoiceRecordForm/InvoiceManagement, as-management's revenue and pricing views, tasks (via a shared formatCurrency + literal '원' suffix), and most of document-automation. But two components diverge to `Intl.NumberFormat('ko-KR', {style:'currency', currency:'KRW'})`, which renders as '₩12,345' — a visibly different symbol/format from every surrounding invoice/amount display: business-core's InstallationBreakdownModal, and revenue-closing's app/admin/revenue/test/page.tsx. Separately, a shared formatCurrency already exists in utils/formatters.ts and is used by tasks/BusinessInfoPanel and document-automation's EstimateManagement, but most other domains (as-management, revenue-closing's pricing page, document-automation's SelfPayContractTemplate/ContractGovernmentTemplate/ContractBusinessTemplate/ConstructionReportTemplate) reimplement their own local currency/date formatter instead of importing the shared one — duplicate logic that can drift (e.g. rounding behavior) even when the visible output looks similar today.
recommendation: Standardize on toLocaleString()+'원' via the existing utils/formatters helper (it already matches the dominant convention and is already consumed by tasks/EstimateManagement); migrate InstallationBreakdownModal and revenue/test/page.tsx off the Intl currency-symbol format, and replace the locally-duplicated date/currency helpers in the document-automation templates with the shared one.

title: order-management inverts the primary-action color convention used everywhere else (green instead of blue)
description: Every other reviewed domain treats blue-600 as the primary/confirm action color: business-core, facility, air-permit, tasks ('새 업무'), approvals, as-management, document-automation, subsidy, revenue-closing, meeting-minutes, weekly-reports, dpf, wiki, notifications, dashboard, auth-session, and admin-misc all use `bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white` for their main CTA. order-management is the sole outlier: its primary/confirm actions (저장, 추가, 라우터 추가 submit, active-tab underline, focus rings) use green (`bg-green-600`/`text-green-600`/`focus:ring-green-500`), while blue is demoted to a secondary/informational role (발주 완료, 내보내기, 상세보기). A user moving from any other admin section into order-management sees the 'this is the button I should click' color signal flip, which is exactly the kind of cross-domain color-semantics break a returning user would notice.
recommendation: Either align order-management's primary CTA color to blue-600 to match the rest of the admin shell, or — if green is intentionally meant as this module's brand accent (as blueon-ai-misc already documents purple for the schedule sub-feature) — document that decision explicitly so it isn't mistaken for drift in a future pass.

title: facility page uses raw emoji as its icon system while every other domain uses lucide-react
description: app/facility/page.tsx, components/facility/ExportButtons.tsx, and components/facility/ExportDialog.tsx render plain emoji characters directly in JSX (🔄 새로고침, 📥 다운로드, 🔍 검색결과없음, 📋) with no lucide-react import anywhere in those files. Every other domain reviewed — business-core, air-permit, tasks, approvals, as-management, order-management, document-automation, subsidy, revenue-closing, meeting-minutes, weekly-reports, dpf, wiki, notifications, dashboard, auth-session, and admin-misc — uses lucide-react icon components consistently for the equivalent affordances (refresh, download, search, empty-state icons). This makes facility visually inconsistent with the rest of the admin shell in icon weight, sizing, and color-theming (emoji can't be recolored/sized via Tailwind text-color/size utilities the way lucide icons can).
recommendation: Replace the emoji in app/facility/page.tsx, ExportButtons.tsx, and ExportDialog.tsx with equivalent lucide-react icons (RefreshCw, Download, Search, ClipboardList) to match the icon language used across the rest of the admin pages.

title: Loading spinner: canonical components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx is used in ~3 places while every domain reinvents its own animate-spin markup
description: Per the shared-ui audit, components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx is a full-screen branded spinner but is only actually used in 3 places in the entire app. Every other domain reviewed independently reinvents a loading indicator, in one of two recurring but non-shared forms: a hand-copied `<div className="animate-spin rounded-full border-...">` (business-core, facility, air-permit, approvals, as-management, order-management, document-automation, subsidy, revenue-closing, meeting-minutes, dpf, auth-session, admin-misc, blueon-ai-misc), or lucide-react's Loader2/RefreshCw icon with an inline animate-spin class (tasks, weekly-reports, wiki, dashboard, order-management, document-automation). business-core alone mixes both approaches (canonical LoadingSpinner at the page level, ad-hoc animate-spin divs inside individual panels).
recommendation: Add a small inline/sized variant to components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx (most reimplementations are inline button/panel spinners, not full-screen ones, which is likely why it wasn't reused) and sweep the repeated animate-spin div markup — this is high-volume but low-risk, mechanical enough for a codemod (Morphllm-style bulk pattern replacement) rather than manual migration per file.

title: Realtime 이벤트로 트리거되는 목록 재조회에 취소/디바운스가 없어 응답 역전 가능
description: useAsRecordsRealtime은 as_records의 모든 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 이벤트마다 signal 없이 fetchRecords()를 호출한다. fetchRecords는 signal이 없으면 취소 로직이 동작하지 않으므로, 짧은 시간에 여러 이벤트가 연달아 발생하면(대량 엑셀 업로드 등) 여러 fetch가 동시에 인플라이트 상태가 되고, 응답 순서가 역전되면 오래된 응답이 최신 상태를 일시적으로 덮어쓸 수 있다. (evidence: page.tsx:210-215 onInsert/onUpdate/onDelete 콜백이 모두 인자 없이 fetchRecords() 호출. 162-183행 fetchRecords(signal?)는 signal이 undefined면 AbortController 연계 취소가 발생하지 않고 매 호출이 독립적인 fetch로 남음을 확인.)
recommendation: Thread an AbortController (or a monotonically increasing request-id guard) through fetchRecords and have onInsert/onUpdate/onDelete cancel any in-flight fetch before triggering a new one, so a burst of realtime events (e.g. bulk upload) can't let a stale response overwrite newer list state.

title: meeting_templates.usage_count increment is a non-atomic fire-and-forget read-then-write
description: `supabase.from('meeting_templates').update({ usage_count: template.usage_count + 1 }).eq('id', id).then()` reads template.usage_count from the earlier SELECT (line 82-86) and writes back +1 without awaiting the result or checking for errors, and without an atomic increment (RPC or SQL-level `usage_count = usage_count + 1`). Two concurrent GET requests for the same template read the same starting value and both write value+1, losing one increment. (evidence: Lines 95-100: `supabase.from('meeting_templates').update({ usage_count: template.usage_count + 1 }).eq('id', id).then()` — uses the value captured in the `template` variable from the prior SELECT at line 82-86, not an atomic SQL expression, and the promise is not awaited or error-checked.)
recommendation: Replace the read-then-write usage_count update in meeting-templates/[id]/route.ts with an atomic Postgres increment (a small RPC function added via migration), and await/log its result instead of firing-and-forgetting; low urgency since usage_count is only a soft display stat.

title: Telegram webhook accepts unauthenticated POSTs with no verification the caller is Telegram
description: The handler trusts any POST body shaped like a Telegram update; for '/start <token>' it binds the caller-supplied chat.id to whichever employee holds that telegram_connect_token, with no X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token check or signature verification, and middleware.ts lists '/api/telegram/' under isCSRFExemptAPI. The connect token (crypto.randomBytes(3).toString('hex').toUpperCase(), 6 hex chars) is short-lived (issued by /api/telegram/connect, cleared on use) but guessable within its pending window, allowing chat_id hijack of that employee's future approval notifications. (evidence: Read webhook/route.ts lines 17-68: no secret-token header check anywhere. Read middleware.ts line 133: '/api/telegram/' is explicitly in isCSRFExemptAPI. Read connect/route.ts line 34: token = `crypto.randomBytes(3).toString('hex').toUpperCase()`, confirming the 6-hex-char claim.)
recommendation: Add an X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token check against an env-configured secret registered via Telegram's setWebhook call, coordinating the secret rotation with the live webhook so notifications aren't interrupted.

title: components/modals/* 7개 파일이 공용 Modal.tsx를 재사용하지 않아 Escape 닫기·배경 스크롤 잠금이 누락됨
description: components/ui/Modal.tsx는 Escape 키 닫기(41-50행)와 body scroll lock(53-63행)을 제공하지만, MessageModal, AnnouncementModal, AllAnnouncementsModal, AllMessagesModal, DayEventsModal, FilteredEventsListModal, FacilityEditModal 7개 파일 모두 `@/components/ui/Modal`을 import하지 않고 자체 오버레이 div를 직접 구현했으며, 이 7개 파일에서 'Escape'/'body.style.overflow' 키워드가 각각 0건임을 grep으로 확인했다(CalendarModal.tsx만 Escape 처리 1건 보유). 재현: 홈 화면에서 전달사항/공지사항 모달을 열고 Esc를 눌러도 닫히지 않으며, 모달이 열린 채로 배경을 스크롤할 수 있다. (evidence: grep으로 components/modals/*.tsx 각 파일의 'Escape', 'body.style.overflow', '@/components/ui/Modal' 매치 수를 확인: AllAnnouncementsModal/AllMessagesModal/AnnouncementModal/DayEventsModal/FacilityEditModal/FilteredEventsListModal/MessageModal 모두 0/0/0, CalendarModal만 Escape 1건.)
recommendation: Add a local Escape-key listener and body-scroll lock to each of the 7 modal files (mirroring components/ui/Modal.tsx's implementation) rather than attempting a full migration to the shared Modal component, to limit regression surface across the many places these modals are used.

title: 동일한 이름 'BusinessAutocomplete'로 export되는 서로 다른 두 컴포넌트가 공존(components/ui vs components/inputs)하며 각각 다른 곳에서 실제 사용 중
description: components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx는 `value(business_id)/onChange(businessId,businessName)/businessList(외부주입)/allowCreate` props 계약을 갖고, components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx는 `value(사업장명 문자열)/businessId/onChange(businessId,businessName)` props 계약을 가지며 내부에서 자체적으로 `/api/business-list?includeAll=true`를 fetch하는 완전히 다른 구현이다. grep으로 실사용처를 확인한 결과 app/admin/order-management/components/RouterEditModal.tsx는 `@/components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete`를, components/modals/CalendarModal.tsx는 `@/components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete`를 각각 import해 실제로 프로덕션에서 병행 사용 중이다. 동일한 이름의 두 컴포넌트가 다른 API 계약으로 공존하므로, 향후 '사업장 자동완성 버그 수정'을 한쪽에서만 하고 반대쪽에는 반영되지 않을 위험이 있다(예: 현재는 정상 동작하지만 유지보수 시 혼동 유발 가능성이 높음). (evidence: components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx(1-38행)와 components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx(1-38행)의 props 인터페이스가 서로 다름을 직접 대조 확인. grep으로 RouterEditModal.tsx:9가 `@/components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete`를, CalendarModal.tsx:6이 `@/components/inputs/BusinessAutocomplete`를 각각 import함을 확인해 두 구현이 실제로 병행 사용되고 있음을 검증.)
recommendation: Rename one of the two same-named components (e.g. components/ui/BusinessAutocomplete.tsx → BusinessSelector.tsx) and update its single import site in RouterEditModal.tsx to remove the naming collision; do not attempt to merge the two differing prop contracts, since that would require reworking both consumers' logic.

title: handleOpenEditModal의 담당자/관리자 권한 체크가 isAdmin 하드코딩(true)으로 항상 무력화되는 죽은 코드
description: line 1757 `const currentUser = '관리자' // TODO`, line 1758 `isAssignee = task.assignee === currentUser`, line 1759 `const isAdmin = true // TODO`로 계산한 뒤, line 1761 `if (!isAssignee && !isAdmin) { alert(...); return }`로 게이트한다. isAdmin이 항상 true이므로 이 조건은 절대 참이 될 수 없어 alert/return 분기(line 1762-1763)는 도달 불가능한 죽은 코드이며, 함수 이름과 주석이 암시하는 것과 달리 실질적인 접근 제어를 전혀 수행하지 않는다. 서버 측 app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts:615의 `canEdit = user.permission_level >= 1`가 이미 동일하게 관대하므로 이 클라이언트 코드가 새로운 보안 구멍을 여는 것은 아니지만, 컴포넌트 상단(line 155)에서 이미 구조분해된 실제 `user`(useAuth()) 객체를 사용하지 않고 오해를 유발하는 가짜 체크를 남겨둔 상태다. (evidence: app/admin/tasks/page.tsx:1757 `const currentUser = '관리자'`; line 1759 `const isAdmin = true // TODO: 실제 사용자 권한 체크로 교체 필요`; line 1761 `if (!isAssignee && !isAdmin)`은 isAdmin이 상수 true라 항상 false; line 155 `const { user } = useAuth()`가 이미 스코프 내에 있으나 handleOpenEditModal에서 미사용; app/api/facility-tasks/route.ts:615 `const canEdit = user.permission_level >= 1`로 서버측도 동일하게 관대함을 확인.)
recommendation: Replace the hardcoded `currentUser`/`isAdmin = true` in `handleOpenEditModal` with the real `user` object already available from `useAuth()` in this heavily-used page, matching the intended assignee-or-admin check.

title: Loading-state visuals differ by domain despite a shared LoadingSpinner component existing
description: components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx is described in the shared-ui review as the 'branded' full-screen loader but is used in only about three places codebase-wide. Nearly every other domain hand-rolls its own spinner div with a different border treatment each time: facility uses `border-4 ... border-t-transparent`; air-permit and revenue-closing use `border-4 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent`; approvals, as-management, and meeting-minutes use `border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent`; auth-session mixes `border-b-2` and `border-t-transparent` variants across its own five pages; notifications alternates between `border-b-2` (dropdown) and `border-4 ... border-t-transparent` (full page); admin-misc explicitly notes two competing idioms coexisting (bare spinner div vs lucide Loader2/RefreshCw icon). Separately, a handful of domains use lucide `Loader2`/`RefreshCw` with `animate-spin` instead of a div spinner at all (order-management's modals, document-automation, weekly-reports, dpf's async buttons). A third group breaks from spinners entirely and uses skeleton placeholders on first load (dashboard's four charts, dpf's vehicle table SkeletonRow + ping-dot search indicator, tasks' TaskCardList pulse cards) — meaning the perceived 'is this page loading?' cue changes shape depending on which admin section a user is in.
recommendation: Consolidate the spinner-based cases (the majority) onto components/ui/LoadingSpinner with a size/inline prop, rather than each page defining its own border-width combination. For list-heavy pages that currently show a blank state before data arrives, adopt the skeleton pattern already proven in dashboard/tasks/dpf rather than leaving that decision per-page.

title: Filter panels use canonical MultiSelectDropdown/TwoStageDropdown in one domain but raw <select> or a third reimplementation elsewhere for the same filter shape
description: revenue-closing's app/admin/revenue/page.tsx uses the canonical components/ui/MultiSelectDropdown and components/ui/TwoStageDropdown for its 영업점/카테고리/연도 (sales-office/category/year) filters. dashboard's components/dashboard/FilterPanel.tsx solves the structurally identical problem — filtering by 지사/제조사/진행구분/영업점 (branch/manufacturer/progress-type/sales-office) — with plain native <select> elements instead. Separately, tasks/page.tsx and as-management/page.tsx each hand-roll their own checkbox-list-in-a-popover multi-select for filters (own useState/useRef, own styling) rather than reusing MultiSelectDropdown, even though that's exactly the component's purpose.
recommendation: Migrate components/dashboard/FilterPanel.tsx's branch/manufacturer/sales-office selects onto MultiSelectDropdown/TwoStageDropdown to match revenue-closing's already-working pattern (both are admin dimension-filter panels with the same UX need). Then replace the bespoke checkbox-popover implementations in tasks/page.tsx and as-management/page.tsx with MultiSelectDropdown to eliminate three independently-maintained multi-select popovers.

title: 일반 승인(approve) 처리가 step 갱신과 문서 상태 갱신을 트랜잭션으로 묶지 않아 중간 실패 시 결재가 멈출 수 있음
description: reject/route.ts는 step 반려와 문서 상태 변경을 transaction()으로 원자적으로 처리한다(159-180줄). approve/route.ts는 동일한 2단계 쓰기(approval_steps UPDATE 후 approval_documents UPDATE)를 각각 독립된 queryOne 호출로 순차 실행하며 transaction()으로 묶지 않는다(344-350줄과 369-374줄이 별개의 non-transactional 쿼리). 두 쿼리 사이에 DB 커넥션 오류나 서버 재시작이 발생하면 approval_steps.status='approved'만 반영되고 approval_documents.current_step은 갱신되지 않아, 다음 결재자가 승인/반려 시도 시 expectedStepOrder(=doc.current_step+1)가 실제 pending step의 step_order와 어긋나 403('아직 내 결재 차례가 아닙니다')이 계속 발생할 수 있다. (evidence: approve/route.ts 344-350줄(approval_steps UPDATE)과 369-374줄(approval_documents UPDATE)이 각각 독립된 queryOne 호출이며 사이에 transaction() 래핑이 없음을 확인. lib/supabase-direct.ts 73-91줄에서 queryOne/queryAll은 단발성 쿼리이고 transaction()만 BEGIN/COMMIT을 사용함을 확인. reject/route.ts 159줄 `await transaction(async (client) => {...})`와 대조해 approve만 이 보호가 빠져있음을 확인. 338-341줄의 expectedStepOrder 검증 로직이 실제로 doc.current_step에 의존함을 확인.)
recommendation: Wrap the `approval_steps` and `approval_documents` UPDATE statements in `approve/route.ts` in `transaction()`, mirroring `reject/route.ts` — this is the single most-traveled path in the whole approval workflow, so any partial-write inconsistency stalls every subsequent approver across the live system.
